  `busy = state === "loading" || data.adding || data.saving`.
  **Markup:** root `<div className="tp-page tp-page--narrow" data-component="BrainDumpView" data-testid="brain-dump-view" data-state={state}>`.
  - `state === "crisis"` → only: `<section className="tp-surface" aria-labelledby="bd-crisis-title"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title" id="bd-crisis-title">{crisis.title}</h1><p>{crisis.body}</p><ul>{resources.map((r) => <li key={r.label}><strong>{r.label}</strong><span className="tp-muted"> — {r.detail}</span></li>)}</ul><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={() => onLeaveCrisis()}>{copy.back}</button></section>` (crisis text is the fixed card `crisis.resourcesCard` returns; it is shown as given). Nothing else renders, not even the offline banner.
  - Otherwise, in order:
    1. `{online ? null : <StateOffline text={copy.offline} />}`.
    2. `<header className="tp-pagehead"><div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{copy.title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{copy.sub}</p></div></header>`.
    3. `<section className="tp-surface">` (no accessible name of its own; the textarea is named by its label) with `<Textarea id="brain-dump-text" label={copy.label} value={data.draft} onChange={onDraftChange} rows={7} help={copy.help} placeholder={copy.placeholder} disabled={busy} maxLength={12000} />` (12,000 = `BRAIN_DUMP_MAX_RAW_CHARS` in `convex/lib/brainDumpInput.ts`); then notices: `data.needText` → `<p role="alert" className="tp-notice" data-tone="caution"><span className="tp-notice__text">{copy.needText}</span></p>`; `data.added` → `<output className="tp-notice" data-tone="done"><span className="tp-notice__text">{(added.onToday > 0 ? copy.addedToday : copy.added).replace("{n}", String(added.created))}</span>{added.onToday > 0 ? <a className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm" href="/today">{copy.openToday}</a> : null}</output>`; `data.saved` → `<output className="tp-notice" data-tone="done" data-testid="brain-dump-saved"><span className="tp-notice__text">{copy.saved}</span><span className="tp-notice__action"><a className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary tp-btn--sm" href={\`/notes/${saved.pageId}\`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{copy.openPage}<span className="tp-sr-only"> {copy.newTab}</span></a>{saved.canUndo ? <button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm" disabled={saved.undoing} onClick={() => onUndoSave(saved.pageId)}>{copy.undoSave}</button> : null}</span></output>`; then `<div className="bd-actions"><button type="button" className={state === "review" ? "tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" : "tp-btn tp-btn--primary"} disabled={busy || !online} onClick={() => onSort()}><TpIcon name="sparkle" size="sm" /><span>{state === "loading" ? copy.sorting : copy.sort}</span></button>{data.draft ? <button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onClear()}>{copy.clear}</button> : null}</div>`. Sort is not disabled for a blank draft: pressing it is how `needText` appears (today's screen does the same).
    4. By state: `empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="inbox" size="lg" />} title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} />`; `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={3} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} />` (StateError, TFV2-0122, wires its button `onClick={onRetry}`; the wrapper keeps the click event out of `onRetry`, so the §13 log writes `onRetry:`); `review` → `<BrainDumpReview summary={data.summary} items={data.items} maxAccepted={data.maxAccepted} adding={data.adding} saving={data.saving} savedPage={data.saved !== null} online={online} onAccept={onAccept} onReject={onReject} onAddAccepted={onAddAccepted} onSavePage={onSavePage} />`; `default` → nothing more.
  One primary per screen: Sort (primary) outside review; in review Sort is secondary and BrainDumpReview's Add accepted is the primary.

  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/plan/PlanView.tsx
  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  import { TpIcon } from "@/components/tempo/TpIcon";
  import { Segmented } from "@/components/lists/Segmented";
  import { MonthGrid } from "@/components/calendar/MonthGrid";
  import { WeekColumns } from "@/components/calendar/WeekColumns";
  import { DayTimelineView } from "@/components/calendar/DayTimelineView";
  import { StateEmpty } from "@/components/states/StateEmpty";
  import { StateLoading } from "@/components/states/StateLoading";
  import { StateError } from "@/components/states/StateError";
  import { StateOffline } from "@/components/states/StateOffline";
  import type { MonthGridDay } from "@/components/calendar/MonthGrid";
  import type { WeekColumnsDay } from "@/components/calendar/WeekColumns";
  import type { DayTimelineItem } from "@/components/calendar/DayTimelineView";
  export type PlanState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type PlanMode = "day" | "week" | "month";
  export type PlanWeekDay = Omit<WeekColumnsDay, "dow">;  // the View adds the localised weekday
  export type PlanData = {
    mode: PlanMode;
    anchor: string;            // selected day "YYYY-MM-DD", or "" while the route is still loading the time zone
    weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6;
    dayItems: DayTimelineItem[];
    dayCols: number;           // ≥ 1, columns for overlapping items
    nowMinute: number | null;  // set only when anchor is today
    week: PlanWeekDay[];       // 7 days, first = weekStartsOn
    month: MonthGridDay[];     // whole weeks covering anchor's month
  };
  export type PlanViewProps = {
    state: PlanState;
    data: PlanData;
    online: boolean;
    onModeChange: (mode: PlanMode) => void;
    onPrev: () => void;
    onNext: () => void;
    onToday: () => void;
    onSelectDay: (date: string) => void;
    onOpenItem: (id: string) => void;
    onAddBlock: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  type CopyKey = "title" | "sub" | "prev" | "next" | "today" | "view" | "day" | "week" | "month" | "legend" | "addBlock" | "timeline" | "weekScroll" | "emptyTitle" | "emptyBody" | "openBrainDump" | "loading" | "error";
  // const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>> — its `en` and `he` objects hold every CopyKey with exactly the EN and HE cell of the COPY table below (no other keys, no other text)
  export function PlanView(props: PlanViewProps): React.JSX.Element; // first body line: const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];
  ```
  Helpers inside the file (not exported): `locale = lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-GB"`; `utc(date) = new Date(\`${date}T12:00:00Z\`)`; `dayTitle = anchor === "" ? "" : new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(utc(anchor))`; `weekTitle = week.length === 7 ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" }).formatRange(utc(week[0].date), utc(week[6].date)) : ""`; `monthTitle = anchor === "" ? "" : new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(utc(anchor))` (no title is formatted from a blank date or a short week: `Intl` throws `RangeError` on an invalid `Date`; the View never reads the clock); `DOW_SHORT` (index = JS weekday, 0 = Sunday) EN `["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"]` / HE `["א׳","ב׳","ג׳","ד׳","ה׳","ו׳","ש׳"]` (same lists as TFV2-0102's MonthGrid); `startHour = Math.min(8, ...dayItems.map((i) => Math.floor(i.startMinute / 60)))`, `endHour = Math.min(24, Math.max(18, ...dayItems.map((i) => Math.ceil(i.endMinute / 60))))` (design shows 08:00–17:00; items outside widen the range instead of being clipped).
  **Markup:** `<div className="tp-page tp-page--wide" data-component="PlanView" data-testid="plan-view" data-state={state} data-mode={data.mode}>` →
  1. `<header className="tp-pagehead"><div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{copy.title}</h1>{data.anchor === "" ? null : <p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{copy.sub.replace("{date}", dayTitle)}</p>}</div><div className="tp-pagehead__actions">{mode !== "month" ? <button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.prev} onClick={() => onPrev()}><TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" flip={lang !== "he"} /></button> : null}<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={() => onToday()}>{copy.today}</button>{mode !== "month" ? <button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.next} onClick={() => onNext()}><TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" flip={lang === "he"} /></button> : null}</div></header>` (in month mode MonthGrid's own Previous/Next month buttons call `onPrev` / `onNext`; the chevron points backward for Previous in both directions).
  2. `<div className="tp-toolbar"><Segmented label={copy.view} options={[{ value: "day", label: copy.day }, { value: "week", label: copy.week }, { value: "month", label: copy.month }]} value={data.mode} onChange={(v) => onModeChange(v as PlanMode)} />{data.mode === "day" ? <button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm" onClick={() => onAddBlock()} disabled={!online}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.addBlock}</span></button> : null}<p className="tp-toolbar__end tp-muted tp-small">{copy.legend}</p></div>`.
  3. `{online ? null : <StateOffline />}`.
  4. By state: `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={6} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} />`; `empty` (day mode only) → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="timeblock" size="lg" />} title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} action={<a className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/brain-dump"><TpIcon name="inbox" size="sm" /><span>{copy.openBrainDump}</span></a>} />`; `default` → the panel of `data.mode`:
     - day: `<section className="tp-surface" aria-labelledby="plan-day-h" data-testid="plan-panel-day"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="plan-day-h">{dayTitle}</h2><DayTimelineView label={copy.timeline} startHour={startHour} endHour={endHour} items={data.dayItems} cols={data.dayCols} nowMinute={data.nowMinute ?? undefined} onOpenItem={onOpenItem} /></section>`;
     - week: `<section className="tp-surface" aria-labelledby="plan-week-h" data-testid="plan-panel-week"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="plan-week-h">{weekTitle}</h2><WeekColumns label={copy.weekScroll} days={data.week.map((d) => ({ ...d, dow: DOW_SHORT[lang][utc(d.date).getUTCDay()] }))} onOpenItem={onOpenItem} /></section>`;
     - month: `<section className="tp-surface" aria-label={monthTitle} data-testid="plan-panel-month"><MonthGrid title={monthTitle} weekStartsOn={data.weekStartsOn} days={data.month} selected={data.anchor} onSelectDay={onSelectDay} onPrev={() => onPrev()} onNext={() => onNext()} /></section>`. (StateError, TFV2-0122, and MonthGrid, TFV2-0102, wire their buttons as `onClick={onRetry}` / `onClick={onPrev}` / `onClick={onNext}`, which passes the click event; the View wraps those props so the §13 log writes `onRetry:` / `onPrev:` / `onNext:`.)
  The page has no `.tp-btn--primary` (design: read + add; "Today" is secondary).

  **States:** `default` (panel of `mode`), `empty` (day mode with no items; header + toolbar stay so the person can switch view or add a block), `loading`, `error`; offline = `online: false` (banner, panels still shown, Add a time block disabled). Week and month never use `empty`: their components show "nothing planned" per day.

"flex" : "fixed" }`; events → `{ id: e._id, title: e.title, startMinute: minuteIn(e.startsAtMs, tz), endMinute: e.endsAtMs !== undefined && e.endsAtMs > e.startsAtMs ? - **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/tasks/TaskGroups.tsx
  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import { useId } from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  import { TpIcon } from "@/components/tempo/TpIcon";
  import { LoadMore } from "@/components/lists/LoadMore";
  export type TaskLevel = "low" | "medium" | "high";          // same values as convex/tasks.ts taskEnergyValidator / taskPriorityValidator
  export type TaskStep = { id: string; text: string; done: boolean };
  export type TaskItem = {
    id: string;                 // passed back in callbacks; never rendered
    title: string;              // user text, dir="auto"
    done: boolean;
    energy: TaskLevel;          // shown as Quiet / Steady / Push
    priority: TaskLevel;        // shown as Low / Normal / High priority
    minutes: number | null;     // planned length in whole minutes; null → not shown
    dueDate: string | null;     // "YYYY-MM-DD" local day; shown only in the "week" and "later" groups
    dueTime: string | null;     // "HH:MM" 24-hour; shown as "before HH:MM" in the "today" group when not done
    doneTime: string | null;    // "HH:MM" when done today; shown after the Done chip
    steps: TaskStep[];          // checklist; [] → no checklist
  };
  export type TaskGroupKey = "today" | "week" | "checklists" | "later";
  export type TaskGroup = { key: TaskGroupKey; tasks: TaskItem[] };
  export type TaskGroupsProps = {
    groups: TaskGroup[];        // any subset, rendered in the order today, week, checklists, later; a group with 0 tasks is not rendered
    laterShown: number;         // tasks of "later" currently in `groups`
    laterTotal: number;         // all "later" tasks; LoadMore shows only when laterShown < laterTotal
    loadingMore?: boolean;      // passed to LoadMore `loading`
    onToggle: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onToggleStep: (args: { taskId: string; stepId: string }) => void;
    onOpen: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onLoadMore: () => void;
  };
  export function TaskGroups(props: TaskGroupsProps): React.JSX.Element;
  // body starts: const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];
  ```
  Layout (composes existing tempo.css classes; no stylesheet): root `<div className="tp-section" data-component="TaskGroups">` (`.tp-section` is the existing grid with `--tp-space-3` gap; the design page's local `tk-groups` class is not in tempo.css and is not used) holding one `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" data-group={key} aria-labelledby={headingId}>` per non-empty group (`headingId` = `useId()` + key; `useId` imported from `"react"`). Section head `<div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id={headingId}>{title}</h2>{count}</div>` where `count` is `<span className="tp-section__count">` holding `copy.openCount` with `{n}` in `<span className="tp-num">` (n = tasks with `done === false`) for "today" and "week", `copy.laterSub` for "later", nothing for "checklists". Rows sit in `<ul className="tp-block-task" data-component="TaskBlock">`; the "checklists" group wraps each of its tasks in `<div className="tp-card" data-check-card>` holding a one-row `ul.tp-block-task`. Row: `<li className="tp-task-row" data-component="TaskRow" data-done={done ? "true" : "false"}>` → (1) `<button type="button" className="tp-check" aria-pressed={done} aria-label={done ? copy.markOpen : copy.markDone (with {title} filled)} onClick={() => onToggle({ taskId: id })}><span className="tp-check__box"><TpIcon name="check" /></span></button>`; (2) `<div className="tp-task-row__body"><span className="tp-task-row__title" dir="auto">{title}</span><span className="tp-task-row__meta">…</span></div>`; (3) `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.edit with {title}} onClick={() => onOpen({ taskId: id })}><TpIcon name="edit" size="sm" /></button>`. Meta, in this order, each only when its data exists: when `done`: `<span className="tp-chip tp-chip--done">{copy.done}</span>` then `doneTime` in `<span className="tp-num tp-mono">`; when not done: in "week"/"later" with `dueDate` → `<span>{copy.dow[weekday]} <span className="tp-num">{day}</span></span>` (weekday from `new Date(dueDate + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay()`, day = `Number(dueDate.slice(8))`); in "today" with `dueTime` → `<span>{copy.before} <span className="tp-num tp-mono">{dueTime}</span></span>`; `minutes` → `<span><span className="tp-num">{minutes}</span> {copy.min}</span>`; energy chip `<span className="tp-chip"><TpIcon name="energy" size="sm" /><span>{copy.energy[energy]}</span></span>`; priority chip `<span className="tp-chip"><TpIcon name="flag" size="sm" /><span>{copy.priority[priority]}</span></span>`; when `steps.length > 0` → `<span className="tp-checklist__count">` with `copy.stepsDone` (`{done}` and `{total}` each in `.tp-num`). Steps list (any group, rendered inside `.tp-task-row__body` right after the meta span, only when `steps.length > 0`, as `TaskViewsScreen.tsx` does today): `<ul className="tp-checklist" data-component="Checklist" aria-label={copy.stepsOf with {title}}>`, one `<li className="tp-checklist__item"><label className="tp-choice"><input type="checkbox" className="tp-checkbox" checked={step.done} onChange={() => onToggleStep({ taskId: id, stepId: step.id })} /><span className="tp-choice__text tp-checklist__text" dir="auto">{step.text}</span></label></li>` per step. After the "later" section's list, when `laterShown < laterTotal`: `<LoadMore shown={laterShown} total={laterTotal} onLoadMore={() => onLoadMore()} loading={loadingMore} />`.
  Group titles: today `copy.today`, week `copy.week`, checklists `copy.checklists`, later `copy.later`.
  Copy (`COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`; `dow`, `energy`, `priority` are nested records in the same constant):

  | key | EN | HE | source (not shipped) |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | today | Today | היום | — |
  | week | This week | השבוע | — |
  | checklists | Checklists | רשימות תיוג | — |
  | later | Later | בהמשך | — |
  | laterSub | No day yet, and that's okay | עוד בלי יום, וזה בסדר | — |
  | openCount | {n} open | {n} פתוחות | — |
  | markDone | Mark {title} complete | סימון המשימה {title} כבוצעה | repo key `tasks.markDone` |
  | markOpen | Mark {title} not done | סימון המשימה {title} כפתוחה | repo key `tasks.markOpen` |
  | edit | Edit {title} | עריכת {title} | repo key `tasks.editName` |
  | done | Done | בוצע | repo key `search.status.done` |
  | before | before | עד | — |
  | min | min | דק׳ | — |
  | stepsDone | {done} of {total} done | {done} מתוך {total} בוצעו | — |
  | stepsOf | Steps for {title} | השלבים של {title} | — |
  | energy.low / .medium / .high | Quiet / Steady / Push | שקט / יציב / דחיפה | — |
  | priority.low / .medium / .high | Low priority / Normal priority / High priority | עדיפות נמוכה / עדיפות רגילה / עדיפות גבוהה | — |
  | dow.0 … dow.6 (Sun … Sat) | Sun / Mon / Tue / Wed / Thu / Fri / Sat | א׳ / ב׳ / ג׳ / ד׳ / ה׳ / ו׳ / ש׳ | — |

  `{title}` is filled with `copy.x.replace("{title}", () => title)` (function replacer keeps a `$` in a title literal, as `TaskViewsScreen.tsx` `fillSlot` does). LoadMore's own strings come from TFV2-0101.
  States (harness order): `default` (all four groups: today 3 open + 1 done, week 2, checklists 1 with 5 steps 2 done, later 2 of 5 → LoadMore shown), `later-only` (only "later", laterShown 5 = laterTotal 5 → no LoadMore), `loading-more` (later 2 of 5 with `loadingMore: true`). Empty / loading / error / offline belong to TasksView (TFV2-0128a).
  Harness fixtures (typed `TaskGroupsProps["groups"]`): today = `t1` "Draft 3 slides for Thursday" (steady/high, 25 min), `t2` "Email Dana about the lease" (quiet/medium, 10 min), `t3` "Pick up prescription" (quiet/high, dueTime "18:00"), `t4` "Water the plants" (done, doneTime "08:05", quiet/low); week = `t5` "Call the bank about the deposit" (steady/medium, 15 min, dueDate "2026-10-14"), `t7` "Ask Yoni to borrow his van" (quiet/low, 5 min, dueDate "2026-10-16"); checklists = `t8` "Pack the kitchen" (push/medium, 90 min, dueDate "2026-10-17", steps `s1` "Buy boxes" done, `s2` "Wrap the glasses" done, `s3` "Pack the pans", `s4` "Label each box", `s5` "Clear the fridge"); later = `t9` "Sort old photos" (quiet/low, 30 min), `t10` "Book a haircut" (quiet/low, 5 min). All other fields: `done: false`, `null`, `[]`. Titles are user data and stay English in both languages.
  RTL: logical classes only; in Hebrew the check sits at the right and the edit button at the left; `.tp-num`/`.tp-mono` keep numbers and times LTR. Keyboard: check, steps and edit are native controls in DOM order (check → steps → edit per row); Enter/Space activate; focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` outline. Screen reader: each section is labelled by its h2; the check button announces "Mark … complete" and its pressed state; the steps list is labelled "Steps for …"; icons are hidden by `TpIcon`. Breakpoints: none of its own (rows wrap meta at 390; same layout at 768/1024/1280). Motion: only Stage 1 transitions (`.tp-task-row` background `--tp-dur-fast`); no entrance animation.
  Compat selectors (existing specs on `/tasks` this row markup must keep): `Mark {title} complete` / `Mark {title} not done` buttons (`tests/e2e/task-views-core.spec.ts:41`; storage-state `tests/e2e/acceptance/alpha.spec.ts:128-129`); text `Done` in a row (`task-views-core.spec.ts:42,48,54,58`; `alpha.spec.ts:140`); button `Edit {title}` (`task-views-core.spec.ts:33`; storage-state `tests/e2e/screens/tasks-edit.spec.ts:38,74`) — kept as names. Conflicts (decided by the OPEN questions of TFV2-0128b, not by this ticket, which builds the v3 design): after `Edit {title}` those specs expect an inline row editor (`Edit task title`, `Save task`, `Edit priority`, `Edit energy`, `Edit due date`, `New checklist step`, `Add step`, `Remove step {step}` — `task-views-core.spec.ts:34-35`, `tasks-edit.spec.ts:39-45,75-76`) and two-step row delete `Delete {title}` / `Confirm delete {title}` (`tasks-edit.spec.ts:92-93`); the v3 design opens the task sheet instead and has no row delete.

  ```ts
  // apps/web/components/tasks/TasksView.tsx
  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import { useId, useState } from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  import { TpIcon } from "@/components/tempo/TpIcon";
  import { TaskGroups, type TaskGroup, type TaskLevel } from "@/components/tasks/TaskGroups";
  import { SearchInput } from "@/components/lists/SearchInput";
  import { Segmented } from "@/components/lists/Segmented";
  import { SortMenu } from "@/components/lists/SortMenu";
  import { Select } from "@/components/forms/Select";
  import { StateEmpty } from "@/components/states/StateEmpty";
  import { StateLoading } from "@/components/states/StateLoading";
  import { StateError } from "@/components/states/StateError";
  import { StateOffline } from "@/components/states/StateOffline";
  import { UndoToast } from "@/components/goals/shared";
  export type TasksState = "default" | "empty" | "filtered-empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type TasksFilters = {
    search: string;                         // "" = no search
    energy: "all" | TaskLevel;
    priority: "any" | TaskLevel;
    sort: "due" | "energy" | "minutes";
  };
  export type TasksToast = { id: number; kind: "added" | "done" | "deleted"; undoUntilMs: number }; // "deleted" is used by TFV2-0129b
  export type TasksData = {
    groups: TaskGroup[];                    // passed to TaskGroups as-is
    shownCount: number;                     // tasks visible with the current filters (all groups, before Later's load-more cut)
    laterShown: number;
    laterTotal: number;
    filters: TasksFilters;
    quickAddBusy: boolean;                  // true while the add is in flight
    toast: TasksToast | null;
  };
  export type TasksViewProps = {
    state: TasksState;
    data: TasksData;
    online: boolean;                        // false → StateOffline above the content; everything stays usable
    onQuickAdd: (args: { text: string }) => void;   // text already trimmed and non-empty
    onFiltersChange: (filters: TasksFilters) => void; // the whole next filters object
    onClearFilters: () => void;
    onToggle: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onToggleStep: (args: { taskId: string; stepId: string }) => void;
    onOpen: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onLoadMore: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
    onUndo: () => void;
    onDismissToast: () => void;
  };
  export function TasksView(props: TasksViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  // body starts: const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];
  ```
  Layout, top to bottom, inside `<div className="tp-page tp-page--wide" data-component="TasksView">`:
  1. `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` → `<div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{copy.title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{copy.sub}</p></div>` and `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions"><a className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/brain-dump"><TpIcon name="inbox" size="sm" /><span>{copy.dump}</span></a></div>` (all states).
  2. `{!online && <StateOffline />}` (TFV2-0123 default text; all states).
  3. Quick add (states `default`, `empty`, `filtered-empty`; hidden in `loading`/`error` — it stays in `empty` because the empty copy tells the person to use it): `<form className="tp-form tp-surface" data-component="Form" noValidate aria-label={copy.qaLabel} onSubmit=…>` → `<div className="tp-field"><label className="tp-label" htmlFor={inputId}>{copy.qaLabel}</label><div className="tp-toolbar"><input className="tp-input tp-toolbar__grow" id={inputId} type="text" dir="auto" autoComplete="off" placeholder={copy.qaPh} aria-describedby={helpId + (error ? " " + errorId : "")} aria-invalid={error || undefined} value={text} onChange=… /><button className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" type="submit" disabled={data.quickAddBusy} aria-busy={data.quickAddBusy || undefined}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.qaAdd}</span></button></div><p className="tp-help" id={helpId}>{copy.qaHelp}</p>{error && <p className="tp-error-text" id={errorId} role="alert">{copy.qaErr}</p>}</div></form>`. `text` and `error` are local `useState` (UI state only). Submit: `const t = text.trim(); if (!t) { setError(true); focus input; return; } onQuickAdd({ text: t }); setText(""); setError(false);`. Typing clears `error`. Ids from `useId()`.
  4. Toolbar (states `default`, `filtered-empty`): `<div className="tp-toolbar" data-component="Toolbar">` with `<SearchInput id={searchId} label={copy.search} value={data.filters.search} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, search: v })} />` (wrapped in `<div className="tp-toolbar__grow">`), `<Segmented label={copy.energy} options={[{ value: "all", label: copy.all }, { value: "low", label: copy.energyLow }, { value: "medium", label: copy.energyMedium }, { value: "high", label: copy.energyHigh }]} value={data.filters.energy} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, energy: v as TasksFilters["energy"] })} />`, `<Select id={prioId} label={copy.prio} value={data.filters.priority} options={[{ value: "any", label: copy.prioAny }, { value: "high", label: copy.prioHigh }, { value: "medium", label: copy.prioMedium }, { value: "low", label: copy.prioLow }]} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, priority: v as TasksFilters["priority"] })} />`, and `<div className="tp-toolbar__end"><SortMenu label={copy.sortLabel} options={[{ value: "due", label: copy.sortDue }, { value: "energy", label: copy.sortEnergy }, { value: "minutes", label: copy.sortMinutes }]} value={data.filters.sort} onChange={(v) => onFiltersChange({ ...data.filters, sort: v as TasksFilters["sort"] })} /></div>`.
  5. Status line (states `default`, `filtered-empty`): `<p className="tp-muted tp-small" role="status">` with `copy.showing`, `{n}` = `data.shownCount` in `<span className="tp-num">`.
  6. Body by state: `default` → `<TaskGroups groups={data.groups} laterShown={data.laterShown} laterTotal={data.laterTotal} onToggle={onToggle} onToggleStep={onToggleStep} onOpen={onOpen} onLoadMore={() => onLoadMore()} />`; `filtered-empty` → `<div className="tp-empty" data-component="Empty"><TpIcon name="filter" size="lg" /><p>{copy.noMatch}</p><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={() => onClearFilters()}><TpIcon name="x" size="sm" /><span>{copy.clear}</span></button></div>`; `empty` → `<StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} icon={<TpIcon name="checklist" size="lg" />} action={<a className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/brain-dump"><TpIcon name="inbox" size="sm" /><span>{copy.dump}</span></a>} />`; `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={6} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} />`.
  7. Toast (any state, when `data.toast !== null`): `<UndoToast key={data.toast.id} toast={{ id: data.toast.id, title: { added: copy.toastAdded, done: copy.toastDone, deleted: copy.toastDeleted }[data.toast.kind], undoUntilMs: data.toast.undoUntilMs, onUndo: async () => onUndo() }} onClose={() => onDismissToast()} />` (existing `apps/web/components/goals/shared.tsx`; its Undo / Dismiss strings are the repo's `gx.toast.undo` "Undo"/"ביטול" and `gx.toast.dismiss` "Dismiss"/"סגירה").

  - `TasksPage`: `const forced = useE2EState(); const online = useOnline();` When `forced !== null`: `const fx = forced in FIXTURES ? FIXTURES[forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES] : FIXTURES.error; return <TasksView {...fx} online={forced === "offline" ? false : online && fx.online} {...NOOP} />;` (forced mode is display-only: every handler is a no-op and no Convex hook runs, because the data hooks live only in `TasksLive`). Otherwise: `const { isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useConvexAuth(); if (E2E_SIGNED_OUT && !isLoading && !isAuthenticated) return <TaskViewsScreen view="inbox" />;` (today's signed-out local-store screen, unchanged, so `task-views-core.spec.ts` keeps passing — subject to this ticket's OPEN question on the CI specs); else `return <ProfileReady fallback={<TasksView {...FIXTURES.loading} online={online} {...NOOP} />}><TasksBoundary online={online}><TasksLive online={online} /></TasksBoundary></ProfileReady>;`.
  - `class TasksBoundary extends Component<{ online: boolean; children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean; attempt: number }>`: `state = { failed: false, attempt: 0 }`; `static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }`; `render()` → when `failed`: `<TasksView {...FIXTURES.error} online={this.props.online} {...NOOP} onRetry={() => this.setState((s) => ({ failed: false, attempt: s.attempt + 1 }))} />`; else `<Fragment key={this.state.attempt}>{this.props.children}</Fragment>` (a new key remounts `TasksLive`, which re-subscribes its queries). Convex `useQuery` throws on a server error, which this boundary catches.
  - `TasksLive({ online })`: `const prefs = useQuery(api.preferences.get, {}); const [filters, setFilters] = useState<TasksFilters>({ search: "", energy: "all", priority: "any", sort: "due" }); const rows = useQuery(api.tasks.list, { search: filters.search.trim() || undefined, energy: filters.energy === "all" ? undefined : filters.energy, priority: filters.priority === "any" ? undefined : filters.priority }); const [laterLimit, setLaterLimit] = useState(20); const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false); const [toast, setToast] = useState<TasksToast | null>(null); const undoRef = useRef<(() => Promise<unknown>) | null>(null); const router = useRouter();` and the four mutations `createQuick`, `toggleCompletion`, `update`, `remove` via `useMutation(api.tasks.<name>)`.
  - Derivation (non-exported helpers in page.tsx): `isoInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: tz, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(ms)`; `timeInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: tz, hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(ms)`; `zoneOffsetMs(ms, tz)` = UTC ms of the zone's wall clock at `ms` (from `formatToParts` with `hourCycle: "h23"`, year…second) minus `Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000`; `zonedMs(iso, hhmm, tz)` (the UTC ms of wall-clock `iso` `hhmm` in `tz`) = `const u = Date.parse(iso + "T" + hhmm + ":00Z"); return u - zoneOffsetMs(u - zoneOffsetMs(u, tz), tz);`. With `tz = prefs.timeZone`, `today = isoInZone(Date.now(), tz)`, `weekEnd = addDays(today, (prefs.weekStartsOn + 6 - new Date(today + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay() + 7) % 7)` (`addDays` from `@/lib/period-pages`). Each row → `TaskItem`: `id: row._id`, `title`, `done: row.status === "done"`, `energy: row.energy ?? "medium"`, `priority`, `minutes: row.timeEstimate && row.timeEstimate > 0 ? Math.round(row.timeEstimate / 60_000) : null`, `dueDate: row.dueAt === undefined ? null : isoInZone(row.dueAt, tz)`, `dueTime: row.dueAt === undefined || timeInZone(row.dueAt, tz) === "23:59" ? null : timeInZone(row.dueAt, tz)` (23:59 is the end-of-day "no time" value the app stores), `doneTime: row.status === "done" && row.completedAt !== undefined ? timeInZone(row.completedAt, tz) : null`, `steps: (row.checklist ?? []).map((c) => ({ id: c.id, text: c.text, done: c.completed }))`. Rows dropped: `status === "cancelled"`; `status === "done"` with no `completedAt` or `isoInZone(completedAt, tz) < today` (done tasks stay until tomorrow). Group: `dueDate !== null && dueDate <= today` → `today` (an earlier open task is shown in Today, never called late); else `steps.length > 0` → `checklists`; else `dueDate !== null && dueDate <= weekEnd` → `week`; else `later`. Inside a group: open before done, then by `filters.sort`: `due` → `dueAt` ascending (none last), `energy` → low, medium, high, then `dueAt`; `minutes` → `minutes` ascending (null last); ties by `title.localeCompare`. `later` is cut to its first `laterLimit`; `laterShown = Math.min(laterLimit, later.length)`, `laterTotal = later.length`; groups with 0 tasks are left out. `shownCount` = all kept rows. `state`: `rows === undefined || prefs === undefined` → `"loading"`; kept rows 0 and filters equal the defaults → `"empty"`; kept rows 0 otherwise → `"filtered-empty"`; else `"default"`.
  - Handlers: `onQuickAdd({ text })` → `setBusy(true); try { const taskId = await createQuick({ title: text, dueAt: zonedMs(addDays(today, 1), "00:00", tz) - 1 }); undoRef.current = () => remove({ taskId }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), kind: "added", undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); } finally { setBusy(false); }` (the new task lands in Today, matching the "Added to Today" toast). `onToggle({ taskId })` → `const r = await toggleCompletion({ taskId: taskId as Id<"tasks"> }); if (r.status === "done") { undoRef.current = () => toggleCompletion({ taskId: taskId as Id<"tasks"> }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), kind: "done", undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); }`. `onToggleStep({ taskId, stepId })` → find the row in `rows`; `await update({ taskId: row._id, checklist: toggleChecklistItem(row.checklist ?? [], stepId) })` (`toggleChecklistItem` from `@/convex/lib/taskChecklists`). `onFiltersChange(next)` → `setFilters(next); setLaterLimit(20)`. `onClearFilters()` → `setFilters({ search: "", energy: "all", priority: "any", sort: "due" }); setLaterLimit(20)`. `onOpen({ taskId })` → `router.replace("/tasks?task=" + encodeURIComponent(taskId), { scroll: false })` (TFV2-0129b reads `?task=`). `onLoadMore()` → `setLaterLimit((n) => n + 20)`. `onUndo()` → `const u = undoRef.current; undoRef.current = null; setToast(null); if (u) await u();`. `onDismissToast()` → `undoRef.current = null; setToast(null)`. `onRetry` is supplied by `TasksBoundary`; inside `TasksLive` it is a no-op. The View calls each handler and ignores its promise; a failed Undo shows the UndoToast's own error line (`gx.toast.undoError`), and a failed Quick add / tick / step tick leaves the list unchanged (the reactive query still shows the true rows) with no new copy, because the v3 design has none for it (the builder lists this under REPORT `notes for ticket sync`).
  - Render: `<TasksView state={state} data={{ groups, shownCount, laterShown, laterTotal, filters, quickAddBusy: busy, toast }} online={online} …handlers />`.
  States: as TFV2-0128a (`default`, `empty`, `filtered-empty`, `loading`, `error`) plus forced `offline`. Copy: none of its own (all in TasksView). RTL / keyboard / breakpoints / motion: from TasksView. Route wrapper: the page adds no wrapper element; no existing spec asserts a `/tasks` wrapper test id.

  export type TaskSheetLevel = "low" | "medium" | "high";   // convex/tasks.ts energy values
  export type TaskSheetState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";  // "empty" = new task, blank fields
  export type TaskSheetTask = {
    title: string;
    date: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD" or "" (no day)
    time: string;               // "HH:MM" 24-hour or "" (no time)
    minutes: number | null;     // planned length; null = not set
    kind: "fixed" | "flex";
    energy: TaskSheetLevel;
    notes: string;
  };
  export type TaskSheetNag = { on: boolean; phrase: string };
  export type TaskSheetData = {
    taskId: string | null;      // null in state "empty"
    task: TaskSheetTask;        // initial field values; the form resets when taskId changes
    nag: TaskSheetNag | null;   // null → the nag section is not rendered
    saving: boolean;            // true → Save disabled + aria-busy, Delete disabled
  };
  export type TaskSheetValues = TaskSheetTask & { nag: TaskSheetNag | null };
  export type TaskSheetViewProps = {
    state: TaskSheetState;
    data: TaskSheetData;
    online: boolean;            // false → StateOffline at the top of the body; the form stays usable
    onSave: (args: { taskId: string | null; values: TaskSheetValues }) => void; // values trimmed (title, notes, phrase)
    onDelete: (args: { taskId: string }) => void;
    onClose: () => void;        // Close button, Cancel, Esc, scrim click
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function TaskSheetView(props: TaskSheetViewProps): React.JSX.Element;

  - `<div className="tp-sheet__body">`: `{!online && <StateOffline text={copy.offline} />}`; `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={4} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} />`; `default`/`empty` → `<form className="tp-form" data-component="Form" id={formId} noValidate onSubmit={submit}>` holding, in order: `<TextInput id={nameId} label={copy.name} value={v.title} onChange=… error={nameError ? copy.nameErr : undefined} />`; a row `<div className="tp-toolbar">` with three `.tp-field`s — `<label className="tp-label" htmlFor={dateId}>{copy.date}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={dateId} type="date" dir="ltr" value={v.date} …/>`, the same for time (`type="time"`, `step={300}`, label `copy.time`), and `<Select id={lenId} label={copy.len} value={v.minutes === null ? "" : String(v.minutes)} options={lengthOptions} onChange=… />`; `<RadioGroup legend={copy.kind}><Radio id={fixedId} name={kindName} value="fixed" label={copy.fixed} hint={copy.fixedHint} checked={v.kind === "fixed"} onChange=… /><Radio id={flexId} name={kindName} value="flex" label={copy.flex} hint={copy.flexHint} checked={v.kind === "flex"} onChange=… /></RadioGroup>`; `<Segmented label={copy.energy} block options={[{ value: "low", label: copy.energyLow }, { value: "medium", label: copy.energyMedium }, { value: "high", label: copy.energyHigh }]} value={v.energy} onChange=… />`; when `data.nag !== null`: `<Switch id={nagId} label={copy.nag} help={copy.nagHelp} checked={v.nag.on} onChange=… />` and, only while `v.nag.on`, `<TextInput id={phraseId} label={copy.phrase} help={copy.phraseHelp} value={v.nag.phrase} onChange=… error={phraseError ? copy.phraseErr : undefined} />`; `<Textarea id={notesId} label={copy.notes} rows={3} value={v.notes} onChange=… />`. `lengthOptions` = `[{ value: "", label: copy.lenNone }, …[10, 15, 25, 45].map((n) => ({ value: String(n), label: copy.lenMin.replace("{n}", String(n)) })), { value: "60", label: copy.lenHour }]`, plus `{ value: String(m), label: copy.lenMin.replace("{n}", String(m)) }` inserted in numeric order when the task's own `minutes` (m) is not one of 10/15/25/45/60.
  - `<div className="tp-sheet__foot">` (states `default`/`empty` only): `<button type="submit" form={formId} className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" disabled={data.saving} aria-busy={data.saving || undefined}><TpIcon name="check" size="sm" /><span>{copy.save}</span></button>`, `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" onClick={() => onClose()}>{copy.cancel}</button>`, and in `default` only `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--danger-ghost" disabled={data.saving} onClick={() => onDelete({ taskId: data.taskId! })}><TpIcon name="x" size="sm" /><span>{copy.delete}</span></button>`.
  Behaviour: the form values `v` are local state seeded from `data.task` and `data.nag` (re-seeded when `data.taskId` changes). Submit: `title = v.title.trim()`; empty → `nameError = true`, focus the name input, no callback; `v.nag?.on && !v.nag.phrase.trim()` → `phraseError = true`, focus the phrase input, no callback; else `onSave({ taskId: data.taskId, values: { ...v, title, notes: v.notes.trim(), nag: v.nag && { on: v.nag.on, phrase: v.nag.phrase.trim() } } })`. Editing a field clears its error. Switching the nag off hides the phrase field and clears `phraseError`. Focus: on mount the name input is focused (`loading`/`error`: the Close button); `trap` keeps Tab inside the section (Tab on the last focusable → first; Shift+Tab on the first → last; focusables = enabled `button, input, select, textarea, [href]` inside the section); Esc anywhere in the section calls `onClose()` with no argument (every `onClose`, `onRetry` call in this View is a no-argument arrow, never the bare prop as an `onClick`, so no click event reaches the callback); on unmount focus returns to the element that was focused when the sheet mounted (`useEffect` stores `document.activeElement`).

  // apps/web/components/journal/JournalView.tsx
  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import { useId } from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  import { journalDate } from "@/lib/journal";
  import { TpIcon } from "@/components/tempo/TpIcon";
  import { List, ListRow } from "@/components/lists/ListRow";
  import { StateEmpty } from "@/components/states/StateEmpty";
  import { StateLoading } from "@/components/states/StateLoading";
  import { StateError } from "@/components/states/StateError";
  import { StateOffline } from "@/components/states/StateOffline";
  export type JournalState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type JournalEntry = {
    id: string;          // notes row id; link target /notes/<id>
    date: string;        // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    title: string;       // page title; "" → the formatted date is the title
    tags: string[];      // page-meta tags (≤ 12), user text
  };
  export type JournalData = {
    today: string;       // "YYYY-MM-DD" in the person's time zone
    prompt: string;      // today's prompt, already localised (one of the repo's journal.p.1 … journal.p.7)
    entries: JournalEntry[];  // past days only, newest first
    hasMore: boolean;    // true → "Show more" button
    loadingMore: boolean;
  };
  export type JournalViewProps = {
    state: JournalState;
    data: JournalData;
    online: boolean;     // false → StateOffline under the head; links and buttons stay usable
    onAnotherPrompt: () => void;
    onLoadMore: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function JournalView(props: JournalViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  // body starts: const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang]; const promptHeadId = useId(); const pastId = useId();

Render every cursor as `<ChunkQuery key={c} before={c} onRows={onRows} />` next to the View. Derived: `entries` = cursors in order, each defined chunk's rows mapped `{ id: r._id, date: r.date, title: r.title, tags: r.tags }` (stop at the first undefined chunk); `last = chunks[cursors[cursors.length - 1]]`; `hasMore = last !== undefined && last.length === 10`; `loadingMore = cursors.length > 1 && last === undefined`; `shift = picked.day === today ? picked.shift : 0`; `prompt = today ? t(promptFor(today, shift)) : ""` (`promptFor` from `@/lib/journal`). `state`: `prefs === undefined || today === null || chunks[today] === undefined` → `"loading"`; `chunks[today].length === 0` → `"empty"`; else `"default"`. Handlers: `onAnotherPrompt` → `setPicked({ day: today, shift: shift + 1 })`; `onLoadMore` → append the last entry's `date` to `cursors` when `hasMore && !loadingMore`; `onRetry` → no-op inside `JournalLive` (the boundary supplies the real one).

  ```ts
  import type React from "react";
  // apps/web/components/calendar/AddEventSheet.tsx ("use client")
  export type AddEventValues = {
    title: string;              // trimmed, non-empty
    date: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    start: string;              // "HH:MM" 24-hour
    end: string;                // "HH:MM", later than start on the same day
    kind: "fixed" | "flex";
    place: string;              // trimmed; "" = none
  };
  export type AddEventSheetProps = {
    initialDate: string;        // "YYYY-MM-DD" preset for the Day field
    saving: boolean;            // true → Save disabled + aria-busy
    online: boolean;            // false → StateOffline at the top of the body; the form stays usable
    onSave: (values: AddEventValues) => void;
    onClose: () => void;        // Close, Cancel, Esc, scrim
  };
  export function AddEventSheet(props: AddEventSheetProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  Markup (fragment root): `<div className="tp-sheet-scrim" aria-hidden="true" onClick={onClose} />` and `<section className="tp-sheet tp-glass" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} data-component="MobileSheet" data-view="AddEventSheet" onKeyDown={trap}>` → `<span className="tp-sheet__grabber" aria-hidden="true" />`; `<div className="tp-sheet__head"><h2 className="tp-sheet__title" id={titleId}>{copy.title}</h2><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.close} onClick={onClose}><TpIcon name="x" /></button></div>`; `<div className="tp-sheet__body">{!online && <StateOffline />}<form className="tp-form" data-component="Form" id={formId} noValidate onSubmit={submit}>` with, in order: `<TextInput id={nameId} label={copy.name} placeholder={copy.namePh} value={v.title} onChange=… error={nameError ? copy.nameErr : undefined} autoComplete="off" />`; a `.tp-field` with `<label className="tp-label" htmlFor={dateId}>{copy.date}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={dateId} type="date" dir="ltr" value={v.date} …/>`; `<div className="tp-toolbar">` with two `.tp-field`s: start (`<label htmlFor={startId}>{copy.start}</label><input className="tp-input tp-num" id={startId} type="time" step={300} dir="ltr" …/>`) and end (`copy.end`, same input with `aria-invalid={endError || undefined}` and `aria-describedby={endError ? endErrId : undefined}`, then `{endError && <p className="tp-error-text" id={endErrId} role="alert">{copy.endErr}</p>}`); `<RadioGroup legend={copy.kind}><Radio id={fixedId} name={kindName} value="fixed" label={copy.fixed} hint={copy.fixedHint} checked={v.kind === "fixed"} onChange=… /><Radio id={flexId} name={kindName} value="flex" label={copy.flex} hint={copy.flexHint} checked={v.kind === "flex"} onChange=… /></RadioGroup>`; `<TextInput id={placeId} label={copy.place} optional value={v.place} onChange=… autoComplete="off" />`. Foot `<div className="tp-sheet__foot"><button type="submit" form={formId} className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" disabled={saving} aria-busy={saving || undefined}><TpIcon name="check" size="sm" /><span>{copy.save}</span></button><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" onClick={onClose}>{copy.cancel}</button></div>`.
  Behaviour: local form state `v` starts `{ title: "", date: initialDate, start: "10:00", end: "11:00", kind: "fixed", place: "" }` (the design's defaults). Submit: `title = v.title.trim()`; empty → `nameError`, focus name, no callback; `v.end <= v.start` (string compare of "HH:MM") → `endError`, focus end, no callback; else `onSave({ ...v, title, place: v.place.trim() })`. Editing a field clears its error. Focus: name input on mount; Tab / Shift+Tab wrap inside the section; Esc calls `onClose`; on unmount focus returns to the element focused at mount.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  import type React from "react";
  // apps/web/components/calendar/CalendarView.tsx ("use client")
  import type { MonthGridDay } from "@/components/calendar/MonthGrid";
  import type { EventBlockItem } from "@/components/blocks/EventBlock";
  import type { AddEventValues } from "@/components/calendar/AddEventSheet";
  export type CalendarState = "default" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";   // "empty" = no events in the shown month
  export type CalendarData = {
    month: string;               // "YYYY-MM" shown in the grid
    weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6;     // from userPreferences.weekStartsOn
    days: MonthGridDay[];        // full weeks covering the month, ordered by weekStartsOn
    today: string;               // "YYYY-MM-DD" in the person's time zone
    selected: string;            // "YYYY-MM-DD"
    dayEvents: EventBlockItem[]; // events of `selected`, by start time
    timeZone: string;            // IANA, from userPreferences.timeZone (passed to EventBlock)
    sheet: { open: boolean; saving: boolean };
    toast: { id: number; undoUntilMs: number } | null;
  };
  export type CalendarViewProps = {
    state: CalendarState;
    data: CalendarData;
    online: boolean;             // false → StateOffline under the head; everything stays usable
    onSelectDay: (date: string) => void;
    onPrevMonth: () => void;
    onNextMonth: () => void;
    onOpenAdd: () => void;
    onCloseAdd: () => void;
    onAddEvent: (values: AddEventValues) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
    onUndo: () => void;
    onDismissToast: () => void;
  };
  export function CalendarView(props: CalendarViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  Layout inside `<div className="tp-page tp-page--wide" data-component="CalendarView">`:
  1. `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` → text (`<h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{copy.title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{copy.sub}</p>`) and, in states `default` / `empty`, `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions"><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded={data.sheet.open} onClick={onOpenAdd}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.add}</span></button></div>`.
  2. `{!online && <StateOffline />}`.
  3. States `default` / `empty`: `<div className="tp-split" data-component="Split">` with (a) `<section className="tp-surface" data-component="Surface" aria-label={copy.title}>` holding `<MonthGrid title={monthTitle} weekStartsOn={data.weekStartsOn} days={data.days} selected={data.selected} onSelectDay={onSelectDay} onPrev={onPrevMonth} onNext={onNextMonth} />` and the legend `<ul className="tp-toolbar tp-small tp-muted" aria-label={copy.legend}><li><Dot kind="fixed" /><span>{copy.lgFixed}</span></li><li><Dot kind="flex" /><span>{copy.lgFlex}</span></li><li><Dot kind="done" /><span>{copy.lgDone}</span></li></ul>`; (b) in `default`: `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby={dayId}><div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id={dayId} tabIndex={-1}>{dayTitle}</h2>{data.dayEvents.length > 0 && <span className="tp-section__count">{count}</span>}</div>{data.dayEvents.length > 0 ? <EventBlock events={data.dayEvents} timeZone={data.timeZone} /> : <div className="tp-empty" data-component="Empty"><TpIcon name="leaf" size="lg" /><p>{copy.dayEmpty}</p><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={onOpenAdd}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.add}</span></button></div>}{data.selected === data.today && <div><a className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" href="/today"><TpIcon name="today" size="sm" /><span>{copy.openDay}</span></a></div>}</section>`; in `empty`: `<StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} icon={<TpIcon name="calendar-grid" size="lg" />} action={<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={onOpenAdd}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.add}</span></button>} />` (the grid stays so other months can be reached). `count` = `copy.items1` when 1, else `copy.itemsN` with `{n}` in `.tp-num`. `monthTitle` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-GB", { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(Date.parse(data.month + "-01T00:00:00Z"))`; `dayTitle` = the same formatter with `{ weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" }` on `data.selected`.
  4. `loading` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={5} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={onRetry} />`.
  5. `{data.sheet.open && <AddEventSheet initialDate={data.selected} saving={data.sheet.saving} online={online} onSave={onAddEvent} onClose={onCloseAdd} />}`.
  6. `{data.toast && <UndoToast key={data.toast.id} toast={{ id: data.toast.id, title: copy.toastAdded, undoUntilMs: data.toast.undoUntilMs, onUndo: async () => onUndo() }} onClose={onDismissToast} />}` (existing `apps/web/components/goals/shared.tsx`).

FIXTURES[forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES] : FIXTURES.error;` render `<CalendarView {...fx} online={forced === "offline" ? false : online && fx.online} {...NOOP} />` (display-only; no Convex hook in this branch). Else `const { isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useConvexAuth(); if (E2E_SIGNED_OUT && !isLoading && !isAuthenticated) return <CalendarViews eventSourceMode="local" />;` (today's local-store screen, unchanged — keeps `calendar-views.spec.ts` and the local case of `fix/calendar-add.spec.ts` green, subject to this ticket's OPEN question on the CI specs); else `<ProfileReady fallback={<CalendarView {...FIXTURES.loading} online={online} {...NOOP} />}><CalendarBoundary online={online}><CalendarLive online={online} /></CalendarBoundary></ProfileReady>`.
  - `CalendarBoundary`: `class CalendarBoundary extends Component<{ online: boolean; children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean; attempt: number }>`: `state = { failed: false, attempt: 0 }`; `static getDerivedStateFromError() { return { failed: true }; }`; `render()` → when `failed`: `<CalendarView {...FIXTURES.error} online={this.props.online} {...NOOP} onRetry={() => this.setState((s) => ({ failed: false, attempt: s.attempt + 1 }))} />`; else `<Fragment key={this.state.attempt}>{this.props.children}</Fragment>` (a new key remounts the data component, which re-subscribes its queries).
  - Helpers (non-exported, in page.tsx): `isoInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: tz, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(ms)`; `timeInZone(ms, tz)` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: tz, hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(ms)`; `zoneOffsetMs(ms, tz)` = UTC ms of the zone's wall clock at `ms` (from `formatToParts` with `hourCycle: "h23"`, year…second) minus `Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000`; `zonedMs(iso, hhmm, tz)` (UTC ms of wall-clock `iso` `hhmm` in `tz`) = `const u = Date.parse(iso + "T" + hhmm + ":00Z"); return u - zoneOffsetMs(u - zoneOffsetMs(u, tz), tz);`; `addDays` from `@/lib/period-pages`.
  - `CalendarLive({ online })`: `const prefs = useQuery(api.preferences.get, {}); const tz = prefs?.timeZone ?? "UTC"; const today = isoInZone(Date.now(), tz); const [month, setMonth] = useState<string | null>(null); const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);` — when `prefs` first arrives and `month === null`: `setMonth(today.slice(0, 7)); setSelected(today)`. `const first = (month ?? today.slice(0, 7)) + "-01"; const nextFirst = addDays(first, 32).slice(0, 7) + "-01";` Range `{ startMs: zonedMs(first, "00:00", tz), endMs: zonedMs(nextFirst, "00:00", tz) }` (one calendar month ≤ 31 days + 1 h, inside the 32-day cap). `const events = useQuery(api.calendar_events.listInRange, prefs && month ? range : "skip");` Mutations `create = useMutation(api.calendar_events.create)`, `remove = useMutation(api.calendar_events.remove)`; local state `const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const [toast, setToast] = useState<CalendarData["toast"]>(null); const undoRef = useRef<(() => Promise<unknown>) | null>(null);` (`CalendarData` is exported by `CalendarView`).
  - Derived: grid `days` = from `gridStart = addDays(first, -((dow(first) - prefs.weekStartsOn + 7) % 7))` to `gridEnd = addDays(lastOfMonth, (prefs.weekStartsOn + 6 - dow(lastOfMonth)) % 7)` inclusive, where `dow(iso) = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay()` and `lastOfMonth = addDays(nextFirst, -1)`; each `{ date, n: Number(date.slice(8)), outside: date.slice(0, 7) !== month, today: date === today, dots }` with `dots` = one entry per event whose `isoInZone(startsAtMs, tz) === date`, in start order, each `"done"` when `(endsAtMs ?? startsAtMs) < Date.now()` else `"fixed"` (every stored event is a fixed-time item until the Add event fields question in OPEN is answered). `dayEvents` = events with `isoInZone(startsAtMs, tz) === selected`, sorted by `startsAtMs`, mapped `{ id: e._id, title: e.title, startsAtMs: e.startsAtMs, endsAtMs: e.endsAtMs, kind: "fixed" }`. `state`: `prefs === undefined || month === null || events === undefined` → `"loading"`; `events.length === 0` → `"empty"`; else `"default"`.
  - Handlers: `onSelectDay(date)` → `setSelected(date)`; when `date.slice(0, 7) !== month`, also `setMonth(date.slice(0, 7))`. `onPrevMonth` → `m = addDays(first, -1).slice(0, 7)`; `onNextMonth` → `m = nextFirst.slice(0, 7)`; both then `setMonth(m); setSelected(today.slice(0, 7) === m ? today : m + "-01")`. `onOpenAdd` → `setSheetOpen(true)`; `onCloseAdd` → `setSheetOpen(false)`. `onAddEvent(v)` → `setSaving(true); try { const eventId = await create({ title: v.title, startsAtMs: zonedMs(v.date, v.start, tz), endsAtMs: zonedMs(v.date, v.end, tz) }); undoRef.current = () => remove({ eventId }); setToast({ id: Date.now(), undoUntilMs: Date.now() + 300_000 }); setSheetOpen(false); setSelected(v.date); setMonth(v.date.slice(0, 7)); } finally { setSaving(false); }` (`v.kind` and `v.place` are not stored: no field exists — the Add event fields question in OPEN). `onUndo()` → `const u = undoRef.current; undoRef.current = null; setToast(null); if (u) await u();`. `onDismissToast()` → `undoRef.current = null; setToast(null)`. `onRetry` is supplied by the boundary.
  - Render: `<CalendarView state={state} data={{ month: month ?? today.slice(0, 7), weekStartsOn: prefs?.weekStartsOn ?? 1, days, today, selected: selected ?? today, dayEvents, timeZone: tz, sheet: { open: sheetOpen, saving }, toast }} online={online} …handlers />`.

  **Layout** (390 px base, only the listed classes; no inline styles): root `<div className="tp-page" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="HabitsView">`. 1) Header `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` → `<div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{sub}</p></div>` and, only in `default`, `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions">{newButton}</div>`. `newButton` = `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button" aria-controls="new-habit" aria-expanded={sheetOpen}>` with `<TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" />` + `<span>{newHabit}</span>`; click opens the sheet. 2) `online === false` → `<StateOffline />` (default text) directly under the header in every state. 3) `data.saveError` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={saveError} live="alert" />`. 4) State body: `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={4} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} />` (a no-argument arrow, so the click event never reaches `onRetry`); `empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="habit" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} action={newButton} />` then the quick-add form; `default` → `<section className="tp-section" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby="hb-today">` with `<div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="hb-today"><span>{today}</span> · <span>{longDate(todayKey)}</span></h2><span className="tp-section__count"><span className="tp-num">{loggedCount}</span> <span>{of}</span> <span className="tp-num">{habits.length}</span> <span>{loggedTodayWord}</span></span></div>`, `<p className="tp-muted tp-small">{localDay with {day} = weekday-long name of todayKey}</p>`, `<div className="hb-list">` with one card per habit, then the quick-add form, then `{suggestions}`. 5) Card: `<article className="tp-surface tp-block-habit hb-card" data-component="HabitBlock">` → `<div className="tp-habit" data-habit={id} data-logged={String(loggedToday)}>` → head `<div className="tp-habit__head">` with `<a className="tp-habit__name" id={\`hb-${id}-name\`} href={\`/habits/${id}\`} dir="auto">{name}</a>`, `<span className="tp-habit__when">{cadence === "weekly" ? rhythmWeekly : rhythmDaily}</span>`, and `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary tp-habit__log" aria-pressed={loggedToday} aria-describedby={\`hb-${id}-name\`} aria-label={label + (loggedToday ? unlogSr : logSr).replace("{name}", name)}>` (`label` = `logged` or `log`) holding `<TpIcon name="check" size="sm" />` + `<span>{label}</span>`; click → `onToggleToday(id)`. Then `<ol className="tp-habit-days" aria-label={last7}>` with 7 `<li className="tp-habit-day" data-done={String(done)} data-today={isToday ? "true" : undefined}>` each holding `<span className="tp-habit-day__dot" aria-hidden="true"><TpIcon name="check" /></span>`, `<span className="tp-habit-day__label"><span>{dow[weekday]}</span> <span className="tp-num">{day}</span></span>`, `<span className="tp-sr-only">{done ? dayDone : dayOpen}</span>`, where `done` = `isToday ? loggedToday : loggedDates.includes(localDate)`. Then `<p className="tp-habit__summary">` rendering `summary` with `{n}` = count of done days and `{total}` = `7`, each number in `<span className="tp-num">`. 6) Quick-add form (in `default` and `empty`): `<form className="tp-toolbar" data-component="Toolbar" noValidate>` → `<div className="tp-field tp-toolbar__grow"><label className="tp-sr-only" htmlFor="habits-library-name">{quickLabel}</label><input className="tp-input" id="habits-library-name" type="text" dir="auto" autoComplete="off" maxLength={HABIT_NAME_MAX} placeholder={placeholder} aria-invalid={invalid || undefined} aria-describedby={invalid ? "hb-quick-error" : undefined} />{invalid ? <p className="tp-error-text" id="hb-quick-error">{quickError}</p> : null}</div>` and `<button className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" type="submit" disabled={busy}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{quickAdd}</span></button>`. 7) Sheet: when open, `<HabitSheet id="new-habit" title={newHabit} initial={{ name: "", cadence: "daily" }} onSubmit={onCreate} onClose={() => setSheetOpen(false)} />`. 8) Toasts: when `data.toasts.length > 0`, `<div className="tp-toast-region">` with one `<UndoToast key={habitId} title={added} undoUntilMs={undoUntilMs} onUndo={() => onUndoCreate(habitId)} onClose={() => onCloseToast(habitId)} />` each. Tokens come only from tempo.css/habits.css classes: `.hb-list` gap `--tp-space-4`, `.hb-card` gap `--tp-space-3`, dot `calc(var(--tp-space-6) + var(--tp-space-1))` = 28 px with `--tp-line-control` ring and `--tp-done` fill.
  **Behaviour:** `longDate(key)` = `Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", timeZone: "UTC" })`; `locale` = `"he-IL"` for `he`, else `"en-GB"`. Quick add submit: `preventDefault()`; if a submit is already running (a `useRef(false)` flag set before the first `await`) do nothing; trimmed name empty → `invalid = true`, focus the input, no callback; else `invalid = false`, `busy = true`, `await onCreate({ name, cadence: "daily" })`; on success clear the input; on rejection keep the text (the route shows `saveError`); finally `busy = false` and clear the flag. Typing clears `invalid` once the trimmed value is not empty. `loggedCount` = habits with `loggedToday`.
  **States** (harness order; route fixture names match): `default` (two habits), `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `offline` (`state: "default"`, `online: false`), `save-error` (`state: "default"`, `data.saveError: true`), `toast` (`state: "default"`, one toast). There is no disabled state; offline keeps every control enabled (changes queue in Convex). Welcome-back/Start fresh/Pause from the design are out of scope (no backend; the builder lists this under REPORT `notes for ticket sync`).

Changes save when you're back." / "אין חיבור כרגע. השינויים יישמרו כשהחיבור יחזור."; Notice adds its sr tone word "Heads up: " / "לתשומת לב: "; `HabitSheet` (`apps/web/components/habits/HabitSheet.tsx`, existing, not edited; props `{ id: string; title: string; initial: { name: string; cadence: "daily" | "weekly" }; submitVariant?: "primary" | "secondary"; onSubmit: (draft: HabitDraft) => Promise<void>; onClose: () => void }` — **Relies on** its close-on-submit contract: after `await onSubmit(draft)` resolves it calls `onClose()` itself (lines 130–131); on a rejection it stays open with its own save error, `HabitDraft = { name: string; cadence: "daily" | "weekly" }` exported from the same file; its own copy comes from the `hb.nh.*` keys and `kb61Copy`) and `UndoToast` (`apps/web/components/habits/UndoToast.tsx`, existing, not edited; props `{ title: string; undoUntilMs: number; onUndo: () => Promise<void>; onClose: () => void }`, exports `UNDO_WINDOW_MS = 300000`; copy `hr.toast.sub` "You can undo for" / "אפשר לבטל עוד", `hr.toast.undo` "Undo" / "ביטול", `hr.toast.dismiss` "Dismiss" / "סגירה") keep their existing copy.
  **RTL:** `dir` comes from `LocaleProvider`; layout uses only logical tempo.css rules, so the 7-day row runs right-to-left in Hebrew with today at the inline end; habit names are `dir="auto"`; numbers sit in `.tp-num`. **Keyboard / screen reader:** Tab order = New habit → each card (name link, Log today) → quick-add input → Add habit → toast Undo → Dismiss; Log today is a toggle button (`aria-pressed`) whose accessible name starts with the visible label; each day has sr text "logged"/"not logged"; the day list is an `<ol>` named "Last 7 days"; quick-add errors are tied with `aria-describedby`; the save-error notice is `role="alert"`. Focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` (`--tp-focus-w` `--tp-accent`). **Breakpoints:** one column at 390 and 768; from 1024 the page sits in `.tp-page` max width (`--tp-paper-max`) unchanged at 1280; the day row never wraps (7 × 28 px dots fit 390 px). **Motion:** no animation of its own; button hover transitions come from tempo.css (≤ `--tp-dur-base` 180 ms); reduced motion → instant.

  /** YYYY-MM-DD of `ms` in `timeZone` ("en-CA" formats as YYYY-MM-DD). */
  function localDateIn(timeZone: string, ms: number): string { return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).format(ms); }
  /** Date.now(), refreshed every 60 000 ms so "today" rolls over at local midnight. */
  function useNowMs(): number { /* useState(Date.now) + setInterval(60_000) cleared on unmount */ }

  export default function Page() {

  }

    // render: failed → <HabitsView state="error" data={EMPTY_DATA} online={this.props.online} {...NOOP_HANDLERS} onRetry={this.retry} />

  function HabitsRoute() {

      <HabitsBoundary online={online}>

          <HabitsLive forced={forced} online={online} />
        ) : (

            <HabitsLive forced={null} online={online} />
          </ProfileReady>
        )}
      </HabitsBoundary>
    );
  }

  export type HabitDetailData = {

    todayKey: string;
    weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6;
    weeks: HabitDetailWeek[];      // exactly 6, oldest first; empty array when habit is null
    summary: HabitDetailSummary;
    saveError: boolean;
  };
  export type HabitDetailDraft = { name: string; cadence: HabitDetailCadence };
  export type HabitDetailViewProps = {
    state: HabitDetailState;
    data: HabitDetailData;
    online: boolean;
    onToggleDay: (localDate: string) => void;
    onSaveEdit: (draft: HabitDetailDraft) => Promise<void>; // rejects when the save failed (HabitSheet shows its own error)
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function HabitDetailView(props: HabitDetailViewProps): React.JSX.Element;

  ```ts
  function buildWeeks(todayKey: string, weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6, logged: ReadonlySet<string>): HabitDetailWeek[] {
    const offset = ((parseLocalDate(todayKey)?.getDay() ?? 0) - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    const gridStart = addLocalDays(addLocalDays(todayKey, -offset), -35);
    return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((w) => {
      const cells = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((d) => {
        const key = addLocalDays(gridStart, w * 7 + d);
        return { localDate: key, day: Number(key.slice(8)), checked: logged.has(key), isFuture: key > todayKey, isToday: key === todayKey };
      });
      return { startDate: cells[0].localDate, cells };
    });
  }
  ```

  ```ts
  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  // top of the file: type CopyKey = <the keys of the COPY table below>; const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>> whose `en` and `he` objects hold every EN and HE cell of that table, word for word (CONVENTIONS §11)
  // first lines of the component body: const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];
  export type RoutineDetailState = "default" | "paused" | "finished" | "empty" | "loading" | "error" | "not-found";
  export type RoutineStepStatus = "done" | "now" | "skipped" | "next";
  export type RoutineDetailStep = { title: string; note: string | null; minutes: number | null };
  export type RoutineDetailRun = { index: number /* current step; === steps.length when finished */; statuses: RoutineStepStatus[]; paused: boolean };
  export type RoutineDetailData = {
    routine: { id: string; title: string /* "" → Untitled */; steps: RoutineDetailStep[]; minutes: number | null } | null; // null in loading | error | not-found
    run: RoutineDetailRun;      // statuses.length === steps.length
    resumed: boolean;           // the route picked up a saved place on open
  };
  export type RoutineDetailViewProps = {
    state: RoutineDetailState;
    data: RoutineDetailData;
    online: boolean;
    onDone: () => void;
    onSkip: () => void;
    onTogglePause: () => void;
    onBack: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function RoutineDetailView(props: RoutineDetailViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<div className="tp-page tp-page--wide" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="RoutineDetailView">`, first child the back link `<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" href="/routines">` (`<TpIcon name="chevron" size="sm" className="tp-icon--back" />` + `<span>{back}</span>`). `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={3} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} />`; `not-found` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="list" size="lg" />} title={gone} />`. Other states: header `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader"><div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title" dir="auto">{title || untitled}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{sub}</p></div></header>`, then `online === false` → `<StateOffline />`. `empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="list" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} action={editLink("secondary")} />`. `default` / `paused` / `finished` → `<div className="tp-split" data-component="Split">` holding: (a) `finished`: `<section className="tp-status-panel" data-tone="done" data-component="StatusPanel" aria-labelledby="rd-finish-title">` = `<span className="tp-status-panel__icon"><TpIcon name="leaf" size="lg" /></span>`, `<h2 className="tp-status-panel__title" id="rd-finish-title" tabIndex={-1}>{finTitle}</h2>`, `<p className="tp-status-panel__body"><span>{finDone}</span> <span className="tp-num">{doneCount}</span> · <span>{finSkipped}</span> <span className="tp-num">{skippedCount}</span>. <span>{finBody}</span></p>`, `<div className="tp-status-panel__actions"><Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/today"><TpIcon name="today" size="sm" /><span>{finToday}</span></Link><Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" href="/routines"><span>{back}</span></Link></div>`; otherwise `<section className="tp-surface rd-guide" data-component="Surface" aria-labelledby="rd-step-title" id="rd-guide">` = `<output className="tp-eyebrow block" aria-live="polite" id="rd-progress">` rendering `progress` with `{n}` = `index + 1`, `{total}` = steps count in `.tp-num`; `<ol className="rd-dots" aria-hidden="true">` with `<li><span className={\`tp-dot tp-dot--${DOT[status]}\`} /></li>` per status (`DOT = { done: "done", now: "fixed", skipped: "flex", next: "habit" }`); `<div className="rd-step"><h2 className="tp-page-title" id="rd-step-title" tabIndex={-1} dir="auto">{step.title}</h2>{step.note ? <p className="tp-muted" dir="auto">{step.note}</p> : null}{step.minutes ? <p className="tp-small tp-muted"><TpIcon name="clock" size="sm" /> <span>{about}</span> <span className="tp-num">{step.minutes}</span> <span>{min}</span></p> : null}</div>`; `paused` → `<Notice tone="info" title={pausedTitle} body={pausedBody} live="status" />`; `<output className="tp-muted tp-small block" aria-live="polite" data-testid="routine-said">{said ? copy[SAID[said]] : ""}</output>`; `<div className="rd-actions">` = Done `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" disabled={paused} data-component="Button">` (`check` icon + {done}) → `onDone()`; Skip `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" disabled={paused}>` (`arrow` icon `flip` + {skip}) → `onSkip()`; Pause `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" aria-pressed={paused}>` (`play` icon + {resume} when paused, else `pause` icon + {pause}) → `onTogglePause()`; Back (only when `index > 0`) `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" disabled={paused}>` (`undo` icon + {backStep}) → `onBack()`. (b) always: `<section className="tp-section rd-aside" data-component="Section" aria-labelledby="rd-all">` = `<div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="rd-all">{all}</h2>{minutes !== null ? <span className="tp-section__count"><span>{about}</span> <span className="tp-num">{minutes}</span> <span>{min}</span></span> : null}</div>`, `<List label={all}>` with one `<ListRow title={step.title} icon={<TpIcon name={ICON[status]} size="sm" flip={status === "now" || status === "skipped"} />} end={copy[WORD[status]]} current={status === "now"} />` per step (`ICON = { done: "check", now: "play", skipped: "arrow", next: "clock" }`), then `editLink("ghost")` = `<Link className={\`tp-btn tp-btn--${variant}\`} href={\`/notes/${routine.id}\`}><TpIcon name="edit" size="sm" /><span>{edit}</span></Link>`. `step` = `steps[Math.min(index, steps.length - 1)]`; `doneCount`/`skippedCount` count `statuses`.
  **Behaviour:** local `said: "done" | "skipped" | "reopened" | "resumed" | null`, initial `data.resumed ? "resumed" : null`; Done → `said = "done"`, Skip → `"skipped"`, Back → `"reopened"`, Pause/Resume → `null`; `SAID = { done: "saidDone", skipped: "saidSkipped", reopened: "saidReopened", resumed: "saidResumed" }`. After Done, Skip or Back a `useRef` flag makes the next render's effect focus `#rd-step-title`, or `#rd-finish-title` when `state === "finished"`.
  **States** (harness order): `default` (step 2 of 3 running), `paused`, `finished`, `resumed` (`default` + `resumed: true`), `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `not-found`, `offline` (`default` + `online: false`). No disabled state beyond `paused` disabling Done/Skip/Back.

  **RTL:** `.tp-split` puts the guide at inline start and the list at inline end (stacked below on a phone); arrow and play icons mirror with `flip`; step text `dir="auto"`; numbers `.tp-num`. **Keyboard / screen reader:** Tab order = back link → Done → Skip → Pause → Back → each list row (static, not focusable) → Edit the steps; progress and the "said" line are polite live regions; focus moves to the new step heading (or the finish heading) after Done/Skip/Back; Pause is a toggle (`aria-pressed`); the current list row has `aria-current="true"`. **Breakpoints:** 390 and 768 stack guide over list; from 1024 `.tp-split` shows two columns, unchanged at 1280. **Motion:** none of its own; reduced motion → instant.
