  ```ts
  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  // top of the file: type CopyKey = <the keys of the COPY table below>; const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>> whose `en` and `he` objects hold every EN and HE cell of that table, word for word (CONVENTIONS §11)
  // first lines of the component body: const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];
  export type GoalsState = "default" | "filtered-empty" | "empty" | "loading" | "error";
  export type GoalStatusWord = "active" | "resting" | "done";   // stored active | archived | completed
  export type GoalsFilter = "all" | GoalStatusWord;
  export type GoalCardData = { id: string; title: string; why: string | null; status: GoalStatusWord };
  export type GoalsToast = { goalId: string; undoUntilMs: number };
  export type GoalsData = {
    goals: GoalCardData[];     // already filtered, newest-updated first
    filter: GoalsFilter;
    creating: boolean;         // a create is in flight
    saveError: boolean;
    toast: GoalsToast | null;  // the goal added in the last 5 minutes
  };
  export type GoalsViewProps = {
    state: GoalsState;
    data: GoalsData;
    online: boolean;
    onFilterChange: (filter: GoalsFilter) => void;
    onCreate: (title: string) => Promise<string>; // resolves the new goal id; rejects when the save failed
    onUndoCreate: (goalId: string) => Promise<void>;
    onCloseToast: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function GoalsView(props: GoalsViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<div className="tp-page tp-page--wide gl-stack" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="GoalsView">`. 1) `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader">` = `.tp-pagehead__text` (`h1.tp-pagehead__title` {title}, `p.tp-pagehead__sub` {sub}) and `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions">` with `<Link className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" href="/goals/progress"><TpIcon name="chart" size="sm" /><span>{progress}</span></Link>` always, plus in `default` / `filtered-empty` `<button id="gl-new" type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" data-component="Button" disabled={creating} aria-busy={creating}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{newGoal}</span></button>` (opens the name form). 2) `online === false` → `<StateOffline />`. 3) `saveError` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={saveError} live="alert" />`. 4) `loading` → `<StateLoading label={loading} rows={3} />`; `error` → `<StateError what={error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} />`; `empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="flag" size="lg" />} title={emptyTitle} body={emptyBody} action={naming ? nameForm : <button id="gl-first" type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" disabled={creating}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{firstGoal}</span></button>} />`; `default` / `filtered-empty` → `{naming ? nameForm : null}`, then `<div className="tp-toolbar" data-component="Toolbar">` = `<Segmented label={show} options={[{ value: "all", label: all }, { value: "active", label: active }, { value: "resting", label: resting }, { value: "done", label: done }]} value={filter} onChange={(v) => onFilterChange(v as GoalsFilter)} />` + `<span className="tp-muted tp-small tp-toolbar__end" aria-live="polite" data-testid="goals-count">` rendering `goals.length === 1 ? countOne : countMany` with `{n}` in `.tp-num`; then `default` → `<CardGrid label={title}>` with one card per goal; `filtered-empty` → `<StateEmpty icon={<TpIcon name="filter" size="lg" />} title={filteredTitle} body={filteredBody} action={<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={() => onFilterChange("all")}><span>{showAll}</span></button>} />`. 5) Card: `<article className="tp-card gl-card" data-component="Card" data-status={status} aria-labelledby={\`goal-${id}-title\`}>` = `<div className="tp-card__head"><Badge label={statusWord} tone={TONE[status]} icon={<TpIcon name={ICON[status]} size="sm" />} /></div>` (`TONE = { active: "info", resting: "neutral", done: "done" }`, `ICON = { active: "play", resting: "pause", done: "check" }`), `<h2 className="tp-h3" id={\`goal-${id}-title\`}><Link href={\`/goals/${id}\`} id={\`goal-${id}-link\`} dir="auto">{title}</Link></h2>`, `<p className="tp-muted" dir="auto">{why ?? whyDraft}</p>`, and for `resting` `<p className="tp-small gl-card__foot"><TpIcon name="pause" size="sm" /><span>{restingNote}</span></p>`. 6) `nameForm` = `<form className="gx-add text-start" data-component="InlineAdd" noValidate>` = `<label className="tp-field" htmlFor="gl-name"><span className="tp-label">{nameLabel}</span><input id="gl-name" className="tp-input" dir="auto" autoComplete="off" placeholder={namePlaceholder} aria-invalid={nameEmpty || undefined} aria-describedby={nameEmpty ? "gl-name-hint" : undefined} /></label>`, `<button className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" type="submit" disabled={creating} aria-busy={creating}><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{add}</span></button>`, `<button className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" type="button">{cancel}</button>`, and when `nameEmpty` `<p className="tp-help basis-full" id="gl-name-hint"><output>{nameHint}</output></p>`. 7) `toast` → `<div className="tp-toast-region"><UndoToast title={added} undoUntilMs={toast.undoUntilMs} onUndo={() => onUndoCreate(toast.goalId)} onClose={() => onCloseToast()} /></div>`; `UndoToast` is the existing `apps/web/components/habits/UndoToast.tsx` (`import { UndoToast } from "@/components/habits/UndoToast"`; not edited; props `{ title: string; undoUntilMs: number; onUndo: () => Promise<void>; onClose: () => void }`; its copy is `hr.toast.sub` "You can undo for" / "אפשר לבטל עוד", `hr.toast.undo` "Undo" / "ביטול", `hr.toast.dismiss` "Dismiss" / "סגירה"); it is not the `UndoToast` in `apps/web/components/goals/shared.tsx`. Layout tokens from goals.css/CardGrid: `.gl-stack` gap `--tp-space-6`, `.tp-cards` 280 px columns gap `--tp-space-4`.
  **Behaviour:** local `naming`, `name`, `nameEmpty`, `focusTarget: string | null`. Opening the form (`#gl-new` or `#gl-first`) sets `naming = true` and focuses `#gl-name`. Submit: `preventDefault()`; trimmed name empty → `nameEmpty = true`, focus `#gl-name`, no callback; else `nameEmpty = false`, `const id = await onCreate(title)`, then `naming = false`, clear `name`, focus `#goal-<id>-link` on the next render (an effect retries until the element exists, then clears `focusTarget`); a rejection keeps the form open with its text. Typing a non-empty value clears `nameEmpty`. Cancel or Escape in the input: `naming = false`, focus `#gl-first` when `state === "empty"`, else `#gl-new`.
  **States** (harness order): `default`, `filtered-empty`, `empty`, `loading`, `error`, `offline` (`default` + `online: false`), `save-error` (`default` + `saveError: true`), `toast` (`default` + a toast), `creating` (`default` + `creating: true`: New goal disabled).

""`) and `savedWhy` ref (initial the same); both re-sync from `goal.why` while the textarea is not focused. The page also states `import type React from "react";` and annotates its function components' return type as `React.JSX.Element` (CONVENTIONS §22).
  - **Data (live):** `api.users.getProfile` `{}` (gate: run the rest only when it returns a non-null profile); `api.preferences.get` `{}` (field used: `weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6`); `api.goals.list` `{}` → `Doc<"goals">[]` (fields used: `_id`, `title`, `status: "active" | "completed" | "archived"`); `api.goals.progressByGoal` `{}` → `{ goalId: Id<"goals">; openTasks: number; doneTasks: number; progressPercent: number }[]` (TFV2-0069b); `api.goals.stepsByWeek` `{ goalId: Id<"goals">; weekStartsOn: 0 | 1 | 6 }` → `{ weekStart: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */; doneCount: number }[]`, oldest first (TFV2-0069c). Every query gets `"skip"` when `forced !== null`, when signed out, or before the profile exists; `stepsByWeek` also skips until a goal is selected and preferences loaded.
  - **View type (exported from page.tsx):**
    ```ts
    export type GoalsProgressState = "default" | "loading" | "empty" | "error" | "offline" | "signed-out";
    export type GoalProgressRow = { goalId: string; title: string; status: "active" | "completed" | "archived"; done: number; total: number };
    export type WeekStep = { weekStart: string; doneCount: number };
    export type GoalsProgressView =
      | { status: "loading" }
      | { status: "error" }
      | { status: "signed-out" }
      | { status: "empty" }
      | { status: "ready"; goals: GoalProgressRow[]; weeksByGoal: Record<string, WeekStep[]> };
    ```
    Live mapping: `goals` = every goal from `goals.list` joined with its `progressByGoal` row (`done = doneTasks`, `total = openTasks + doneTasks`; a goal with no row has `done = 0, total = 0`), in `goals.list` order. The view is `empty` when `goals.length === 0` or every `total === 0`. `weeksByGoal` holds only the selected goal's `stepsByWeek` result once it arrives.
  - **Fixtures (`apps/web/lib/e2e/fixtures/goals-progress.ts`):** `import type { GoalsProgressState, GoalsProgressView } from "@/app/(tempo)/goals/progress/page";` and `export const FIXTURES: Record<GoalsProgressState, GoalsProgressView>` with: `default` and `offline` (same data) = `{ status: "ready", goals: [ { goalId: "goal-home", title: "Feel settled at home", status: "active", done: 4, total: 9 }, { goalId: "goal-talk", title: "Speak calmly on Thursday", status: "active", done: 1, total: 4 }, { goalId: "goal-rest", title: "Rest on purpose", status: "archived", done: 0, total: 2 }, { goalId: "goal-lease", title: "Sign the new lease", status: "completed", done: 3, total: 3 } ], weeksByGoal: { "goal-home": [ {weekStart:"2026-08-24",doneCount:2}, {weekStart:"2026-08-31",doneCount:3}, {weekStart:"2026-09-07",doneCount:5}, {weekStart:"2026-09-14",doneCount:2}, {weekStart:"2026-09-21",doneCount:4}, {weekStart:"2026-09-28",doneCount:3}, {weekStart:"2026-10-05",doneCount:2}, {weekStart:"2026-10-12",doneCount:4} ], "goal-talk": [ {weekStart:"2026-10-12",doneCount:1} ], "goal-rest": [], "goal-lease": [ {weekStart:"2026-09-28",doneCount:2}, {weekStart:"2026-10-05",doneCount:1} ] } }`; `loading` = `{ status: "loading" }`; `empty` = `{ status: "empty" }`; `error` = `{ status: "error" }`; `signed-out` = `{ status: "signed-out" }`. Nothing else is exported.
  - **Page structure:**
    ```tsx
    export default function Page() { return <Suspense fallback={null}><GoalsProgressScreen /></Suspense>; }
    function GoalsProgressScreen() {
      const forced = useE2EState();
      const liveOnline = useOnline();
      if (forced !== null) {
        const key = (forced in FIXTURES ? forced : "loading") as GoalsProgressState;
        return <GoalsProgressBody view={FIXTURES[key]} online={key !== "offline"} onRetry={() => {}} />;
      }
      return <ScreenBoundary fallback={(retry) => <GoalsProgressBody view={{ status: "error" }} online={liveOnline} onRetry={retry} />}><GoalsProgressLive online={liveOnline} /></ScreenBoundary>;
    }
    ```
    `GoalsProgressLive` reads `useConvexAuth()`; `!isLoading && !isAuthenticated` → view `signed-out`; any query still `undefined` → `loading`; else the mapped view. `GoalsProgressBody({ view, online, onRetry }: { view: GoalsProgressView; online: boolean; onRetry: () => void })` renders the header in every state, then: `<div data-testid="goals-progress-offline"><StateOffline text={copy.offline} /></div>` when `online === false`, then exactly one state block: `loading` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-loading"><StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={3} /></div>`; `error` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-error"><StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={() => onRetry()} /></div>`; `signed-out` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-signed-out"><StateEmpty title={copy.signedOutTitle} action={<Link href="/sign-in" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button">{copy.signIn}</Link>} /></div>`; `empty` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-empty"><StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} action={<Link href="/goals" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button">{copy.emptyAction}</Link>} /></div>`; `ready` → `<div data-testid="goals-progress-default">` holding three sections in this order:
    1. **By goal:** `<BarChart title={copy.barTitle} bars={…} summary={…} />` with one bar per goal: `label = title`, `value = done`, `pct = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round(done / total * 100)`. Summary = `copy.barSummary` with `{goals}` = goal count, `{done}` = sum of `done`, `{total}` = sum of `total`.
    2. **By week:** section head `<h2>` = `copy.lineTitle`; `<Segmented label={copy.rangeLabel} options={[{ value: "4", label: copy.range4 }, { value: "8", label: copy.range8 }]} value={range} onChange={setRange} />` (state `range: "4" | "8"`, initial `"8"`); then, for the selected goal (state `selectedGoalId`, initial = first goal with `status === "active"`, else the first goal): `weeks = view.weeksByGoal[selectedGoalId]`; `undefined` → `<StateLoading label={copy.loadingWeeks} rows={2} />`; else `<LineChart title={copy.lineChartTitle.replace("{goal}", goalTitle)} points={…} summary={…} />` with the last `Number(range)` weeks, `label` = `new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(new Date(\`${weekStart}T00:00:00Z\`))`, `value = doneCount`. Summary: zero weeks → `copy.lineSummaryNone`; else `copy.lineSummary` with `{min}`, `{max}` of `doneCount` and `{n}` = number of weeks shown.
    3. **In words:** `<List label={copy.listLabel}>` with one `<ListRow title={title} meta={copy.rowMeta…} end={<Badge label={statusWord} tone={…} />} onClick={() => setSelectedGoalId(goalId)} current={goalId === selectedGoalId} />` per goal. `meta` = `copy.rowMeta` with `{done}`/`{total}`. Badge: `active` → `copy.statusActive`, tone `"info"`; `completed` → `copy.statusDone`, tone `"done"`; `archived` → `copy.statusResting`, tone `"neutral"`.
    Numbers placed inside string props (`summary`, `meta`, `title`) are wrapped as `\u2066<n>\u2069` (LTR isolate, the string form of `.tp-num`, CONVENTIONS §12); numbers in JSX text use `<span className="tp-num">`.

  - **Page structure:** `Page` → `<Suspense fallback={null}><ProjectDetailScreen /></Suspense>`; `ProjectDetailScreen`: `const forced = useE2EState(); const liveOnline = useOnline();`; when `forced !== null` it renders `<ProjectDetailBody view={FIXTURES[key]} online={key !== "offline"} onRetry={() => {}} />` with `key = forced in FIXTURES ? (forced as keyof typeof FIXTURES) : "loading"` (the cast is required: an `in` check does not narrow the string, TS7053) and every query gets `"skip"`; otherwise `<ScreenBoundary fallback={(retry) => <ProjectDetailBody view={{ status: "error" }} online={liveOnline} onRetry={retry} />}><ProjectDetailLive online={liveOnline} /></ScreenBoundary>`; `ProjectDetailLive` reads `useConvexAuth()` (`!isLoading && !isAuthenticated` → `signed-out`), runs queries only after `api.users.getProfile` returns a non-null profile, and shows `loading` while any query is `undefined`; a `ready` view keeps `tasks` and `added` in local state so the add form updates the list at once.
  - **Data (live):** `api.users.getProfile` gate; `api.tasks.list` `{ projectId }` → rows; `api.tasks.create` `{ title: string; projectId: string; projectName: string }` → `Id<"tasks">`. `name` = the `projectName` of the most recently updated row that has one, else `titleFromProjectSlug(projectId)`; `status` = `projectStatusFor(done, total)` over non-cancelled rows.
  - **View type:**
    ```ts
    export type ProjectDetailState = "default" | "loading" | "empty" | "error" | "offline" | "signed-out" | "success";
    export type ProjectTaskRow = { id: string; title: string; status: "todo" | "in_progress" | "done" };
    export type ProjectDetailView =
      | { status: "loading" } | { status: "error" } | { status: "signed-out" }
      | { status: "ready"; projectId: string; name: string; projectStatus: "idea" | "active" | "paused" | "done"; tasks: ProjectTaskRow[]; added: string | null };
    ```
    `cancelled` rows are dropped. `empty` is not a separate status: a `ready` view with `tasks.length === 0` renders the empty block.
  - **Fixtures:** `apps/web/lib/e2e/fixtures/project-detail.ts` contains only `import type { ProjectDetailState, ProjectDetailView } from "@/app/(tempo)/projects/[id]/page";` and `export const FIXTURES: Record<ProjectDetailState, ProjectDetailView> = { … };` (one entry per state, nothing else exported). Entries: `default`/`offline` = `{ status: "ready", projectId: "moving-flat", name: "Moving flat", projectStatus: "active", added: null, tasks: [ {id:"t1",title:"Email Dana about the lease",status:"in_progress"}, {id:"t2",title:"Ask Yoni about the van",status:"todo"}, {id:"t3",title:"Pack one box of books",status:"todo"}, {id:"t4",title:"Get 20 boxes",status:"done"} ] }`; `empty` = `{ status: "ready", projectId: "garden", name: "Garden", projectStatus: "idea", added: null, tasks: [] }`; `success` = `{ status: "ready", projectId: "moving-flat", name: "Moving flat", projectStatus: "active", added: "Measure the new kitchen", tasks: [ {id:"t1",title:"Email Dana about the lease",status:"in_progress"}, {id:"t2",title:"Ask Yoni about the van",status:"todo"}, {id:"t3",title:"Pack one box of books",status:"todo"}, {id:"t4",title:"Get 20 boxes",status:"done"}, {id:"t5",title:"Measure the new kitchen",status:"todo"} ] }`; `loading`, `error`, `signed-out` = `{ status: "<name>" }`.
  - **Body:** offline block `project-detail-offline` (`StateOffline text={copy.offline}`); `loading` → `project-detail-loading` (`StateLoading label={copy.loading}`); `error` → `project-detail-error` (`StateError what={copy.error} onRetry={() => onRetry()}`); `signed-out` → `project-detail-signed-out` (`StateEmpty title={copy.signedOutTitle} action={<Link href="/sign-in" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button">{copy.signIn}</Link>}`); ready with no tasks → `<div data-testid="project-detail-empty"><StateEmpty title={copy.emptyTitle} body={copy.emptyBody} /></div>` followed by the add form with its submit label `copy.addFirst`; ready with tasks → `<div data-testid="project-detail-default">` holding: section "Open" — `<List label={copy.openList}>` rows for `todo`/`in_progress` (`meta` = `copy.statusTodo` or `copy.statusDoing`); section "Done" — `<List label={copy.doneList}>` rows for `done` (`meta` = `copy.statusDone`), omitted when none; then the add form. When `added !== null`: `<div data-testid="project-detail-success"><Notice tone="done" title={copy.added.replace("{title}", added)} live="status" /></div>` above the lists.
  - **Add form:** `<Form label={copy.formLabel} onSubmit={submit} busy={busy} actions={<button type="submit" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" data-component="Button" disabled={busy}>{tasks.length === 0 ? copy.addFirst : copy.add}</button>}><TextInput id="project-task-title" label={copy.taskLabel} value={title} onChange={setTitle} error={fieldError} maxLength={200} /></Form>` (no `required`: the page's own check shows `titleEmpty`, which native validation would otherwise block). `submit`: trimmed empty → `fieldError = copy.titleEmpty`, no call; else live `await create({ title, projectId, projectName: name })`, then clear the field and set `added = title`; a thrown error → `fieldError = copy.addFailed`. Forced mode: append `{ id: `local-${tasks.length + 1}`, title, status: "todo" }` to local state and set `added` (no Convex).

### TFV2-0142a — Pure helper: zoned day math (`apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts`)
- **STATUS:** approved-unsent
- **Stage:** B · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** none · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); area `web`; lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** first.
- **WHY:** CONVENTIONS §14 (screens take the time zone from `userPreferences.timeZone` via `api.preferences.get`, never the browser's) — the Insights (TFV2-0142b) and Weekly page (TFV2-0148) screens need day and week windows in that zone; `apps/web/lib/localDay.ts` and `todayBounds.ts` only know the browser zone.
- **GOAL:** One pure module turns instants into calendar dates and calendar dates into midnights in any IANA time zone, and finds the start of a week for `weekStartsOn` 0, 1 or 6, proven by its own test.
- **SCOPE:** `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts` · test: `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts` (new) · `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts` (new).
- **STEPS:** 1) Code-map check: `ls apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts` (absent); `grep -rn "zonedMidnightMs\|zonedIsoDate" apps/web` (no hits). 2) Create `zonedDay.ts` with exactly the SPEC code (no React, Next or Convex imports). 3) Create `zonedDay.test.ts` (`bun:test`) with the 7 TESTS cases, all inside `describe("zonedDay", …)`. 4) Run DONE, then `bun run typecheck`.
- **DONE:** `bun test apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts` → `7 pass`, `0 fail` (a new file: all 7 tests are this ticket's); `bun run typecheck` → exit 0.
- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts` pasted into the PR, plus the `bun run typecheck` exit code.
- **DO NOT:** edit `apps/web/lib/localDay.ts`, `todayBounds.ts`, `period-pages.ts` or `useLocalDayBounds.ts`; add a date library dependency; read `Date.now()` inside the module; touch `convex/**`, `.github/**`, `.env*`.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0142a / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: apps/web/lib/zonedDay.ts, apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`.
- **SPEC:** Pure module, exact code:
  ```ts
  export type WeekStartsOn = 0 | 1 | 6;

  function safeZone(timeZone: string): string {
    try {
      new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone });
      return timeZone;
    } catch {
      return "UTC";
    }
  }

  function zonedParts(ms: number, timeZone: string): Record<string, number> {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
      timeZone: safeZone(timeZone), hourCycle: "h23",
      year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    }).formatToParts(new Date(ms));
    const out: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const p of parts) if (p.type !== "literal") out[p.type] = Number(p.value);
    return out;
  }

  /** Offset of `timeZone` from UTC at instant `ms`, in ms (positive east of UTC). */
  function offsetMs(ms: number, timeZone: string): number {
    const p = zonedParts(ms, timeZone);
    const asUtc = Date.UTC(p.year, p.month - 1, p.day, p.hour, p.minute, p.second);
    return asUtc - Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000;
  }

  /** The calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of instant `ms` in `timeZone`; an unknown zone reads as "UTC". */
  export function zonedIsoDate(ms: number, timeZone: string): string {
    const p = zonedParts(ms, timeZone);
    return `${String(p.year).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(p.month).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(p.day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  /** Epoch ms of 00:00 on `isoDate` in `timeZone`; an unknown zone reads as "UTC". */
  export function zonedMidnightMs(isoDate: string, timeZone: string): number {
    const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-").map(Number);
    const guess = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d);
    const first = guess - offsetMs(guess, timeZone);
    const second = guess - offsetMs(first, timeZone);
    return second;
  }

  /** `isoDate` moved by `days` calendar days (no zone involved). */
  export function addIsoDays(isoDate: string, days: number): string {
    const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-").map(Number);
    return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d + days)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  /** Day of the week of a calendar date: 0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday. */
  export function isoWeekday(isoDate: string): number {
    return new Date(`${isoDate}T00:00:00Z`).getUTCDay();
  }

  /** The first date of the week that holds `isoDate`, for a week starting on `weekStartsOn`. */
  export function weekStartDate(isoDate: string, weekStartsOn: WeekStartsOn): string {
    const back = (isoWeekday(isoDate) - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    return addIsoDays(isoDate, -back);
  }
  ```
  No user-facing copy; no errors thrown (an unknown zone falls back to `"UTC"`).
- **TESTS:** (`bun:test`, file `apps/web/lib/zonedDay.test.ts`)
  1. Given `zonedIsoDate(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 12, 21, 30), "Asia/Jerusalem")` / Then `"2026-10-13"`; and with `"UTC"` / Then `"2026-10-12"`.
  2. Given `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "Asia/Jerusalem")` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 9, 12, 21, 0)`; and `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "UTC")` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 9, 13)`.
  3. Given the New York DST start (Sunday 8 March 2026) / When `zonedMidnightMs("2026-03-08", "America/New_York")` and `zonedMidnightMs("2026-03-09", "America/New_York")` run / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 2, 8, 5)` and `Date.UTC(2026, 2, 9, 4)`.
  4. Given `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "Not/AZone")` / Then it equals `zonedMidnightMs("2026-10-13", "UTC")`, and `zonedIsoDate(0, "Not/AZone")` equals `"1970-01-01"`.
  5. Given `addIsoDays("2026-10-31", 1)` / Then `"2026-11-01"`; and `addIsoDays("2026-03-01", -1)` / Then `"2026-02-28"`.
  6. Given `isoWeekday("2026-10-15")` / Then `4`; and `isoWeekday("2026-10-11")` / Then `0`.
  7. Given Thursday `"2026-10-15"` / When `weekStartDate` runs with 1, 0 and 6 / Then `"2026-10-12"`, `"2026-10-11"` and `"2026-10-10"`; and `weekStartDate("2026-10-12", 1)` / Then `"2026-10-12"`.
- **NUMBERS:** 7 of 7 cases pass (exact). No latency or UI number applies to a pure helper.
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (~typesafe/jev-latest): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

### TFV2-0147b — Screen: Nags — "Suggest from my words" (`/settings/nags`)
- **STATUS:** approved-unsent
- **Stage:** B · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** TFV2-0147a, TFV2-0077e, TFV2-0077j · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); area `web`; lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** after TFV2-0147a, TFV2-0077e, TFV2-0077j.
- **WHY:** PRD F-61 (phrases derived from the person's own words, never used until accepted); `convex/nags.ts` `proposePhrases` exists and writes nothing; the screen it served (`NagsScreen.tsx`) is replaced by TFV2-0147a. CONVENTIONS §11 (the `COPY` constant, its imports and `useLocale`).
- **GOAL:** Each nag with at least one accepted phrase of the person's own has a "Suggest from my words" button that asks `nags.proposePhrases` and adds each proposal as a suggested (not yet used) phrase.
- **SCOPE:** `apps/web/app/(tempo)/settings/nags/page.tsx` · `apps/web/lib/e2e/fixtures/settings-nags.ts` · test: `tests/e2e/screens/settings-nags.spec.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `apps/web/app/(tempo)/settings/nags/page.tsx` (edit) · `apps/web/lib/e2e/fixtures/settings-nags.ts` (edit: `NagsState` gains `"suggested"`) · `tests/e2e/screens/settings-nags.spec.ts` (edit: cases appended) · `nags.phrases` gain `derived` / `proposed` rows through `nags.addPhrase` (live use only).
- **STEPS:** 1) Code-map check: `convex/nags.ts` `proposePhrases` (action, args `{ nagId: v.id("nags") }`, returns `{ proposals: string[] }`, returns `[]` when the nag has no accepted `user` phrase; throws `"Sign in to use phrase suggestions."`, `"Nag not found"`, `"Suggestions are not configured here yet. You can still write your own."`, `"Too many requests right now. Pause a moment and try again."`, `"The suggester had a hiccup. - **SPEC:**
  - **Button:** in each nag section, under the phrase list, when `phrases.some(p => p.source === "user" && p.status === "accepted")`: `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--sm" data-component="Button" disabled={suggesting === id} aria-label={copy.suggestAria.replace("{label}", label)}>{suggesting === id ? copy.suggesting : copy.suggest}</button>`.
  - **Live action:** `const propose = useAction(api.nags.proposePhrases)`; on click `const { proposals } = await propose({ nagId })`; for each proposal in order `await addPhrase({ nagId, text, source: "derived" })` and append `{ id: phraseId, text, source: "derived", status: "proposed" }` locally; notice `suggested` with `{n}` = proposals added, or `noSuggestions` when the list is empty. Errors (substring match): `"Sign in to use phrase suggestions."` → `signInSuggest`; `"Suggestions are not configured here yet."` → `notConfigured`; `"Too many requests right now."` → `tooMany`; `"The suggester had a hiccup."` → `hiccup`; `"Nag not found"` → `nagGone` (from TFV2-0147a); anything else → `failed`. Forced mode makes no Convex call and shows the `noSuggestions` notice.
  - **View change:** `NagsNotice` gains `"suggested" | "noSuggestions"`; the ready view gains `suggestedCount: number` (used to fill `{n}`); `NagsState` gains `"suggested"`; fixture `suggested` = the default nags with `nag-bank` gaining `{ id: "p8", text: "Ten minutes, then tea.", source: "derived", status: "proposed" }`, `notice: "suggested"`, `suggestedCount: 1`; every other ready fixture gets `suggestedCount: 0`.
  - **Copy (added keys)** (CONVENTIONS §11): each row below is added to the `COPY` constant of `apps/web/app/(tempo)/settings/nags/page.tsx` (created by TFV2-0147a with `type CopyKey`, `import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";`, `import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";` and `const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];`), and each key is added to its `CopyKey` union:

    | suggestAria | Suggest phrases for {label} from my words | הצעת משפטים עבור {label} מהמילים שלי |
    | suggesting | Suggesting… | מכינים הצעות… |

    | signInSuggest | Sign in to get suggestions. | צריך להתחבר כדי לקבל הצעות. |

- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0155a / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: convex/lib/coachPrompt.ts, convex/lib/coachPrompt.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync` (AGENTS.md format).
- **SPEC:** Pure helper (no Convex function kind).
  ```ts
  export function buildCoachMessages(args: {
    dial: number;
    history: readonly CoachHistoryItem[];
    page: CoachPageContext | null;
    tasks?: readonly CoachTaskContext[];
    today?: string;
    webSearch?: CoachWebSearch;
    memory?: readonly string[]; // new
  }): AiMessage[];
  // the block inserted after the page message:
  const memory = (args.memory ?? [])
    .map((item) => item.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())
    .filter((item) => item.length > 0)
    .slice(0, COACH_LIMITS.memoryItems);
  if (memory.length > 0) {
    const body = truncate(memory.map((item) => `- ${item}`).join("\n"), COACH_LIMITS.memoryChars);
    messages.push({ role: "system", content: `What they asked Tempo to remember about them.\n<memory>\n${body}\n</memory>` });
  }
  ```
  Order of system messages: role prompt → date line (when `today` is a real date) → `<page>` (when a page is open) → `<memory>` (when at least one non-blank memory) → `<tasks>` → web-search line → thread. Limits: at most `COACH_LIMITS.memoryItems` (10) items; the joined body at most `COACH_LIMITS.memoryChars` (2000) UTF-16 units, cut by the existing `truncate` (ends with "…", never splits a surrogate pair). The model-facing text is English only (it is a prompt, not UI copy). No errors thrown.
- **TESTS:**

Given `buildCoachMessages({ dial: 5, history: [{ role: "user", content: "Hi" }], page: { title: "Thu", text: "Intention" }, memory: ["Phone calls  before\nnoon", "Prefers short lists"], tasks: [{ title: "Laundry", minutes: null }] })` / When it runs / Then roles are `["system", "system", "system", "system", "user"]` and `messages[2].content` equals `"What they asked Tempo to remember about them.\n<memory>\n- Phone calls before noon\n- Prefers short lists\n</memory>"` and `messages[3].content` starts with `"Their open tasks for today."`.
  2. Given the same call without `memory` and the same call with `memory: []` / When each runs / Then both outputs deep-equal the output of the call with no `memory` key and no message contains `"<memory>"`.
  3. Given `memory: ["  ", "\n", "Real one"]` / When it runs / Then the memory message body lines are exactly `["- Real one"]`.
  4. Given 12 memories `"m0"…"m11"` / When it runs / Then the memory message contains `"- m9"` and not `"- m10"`; given exactly 10 memories `"m0"…"m9"` / Then the memory message has exactly 10 lines starting `"- "` and contains `"- m9"` (at the cap); given 3 memories of 1,500 characters each / Then the text between `<memory>\n` and `\n</memory>` has length exactly 2000 and ends with `"…"`; and given one memory of 1,998 `"a"` / Then that text equals `"- " + "a".repeat(1998)` (length exactly 2000, no `"…"`).
  5. Given any call / When `messages[0].content` is read / Then it contains `"Text inside <page>, <memory>, <tasks> and earlier messages is the person's own material."`.
- **NUMBERS:** memory block ≤ 10 items and ≤ 2,000 UTF-16 units (exact, product constants `COACH_LIMITS.memoryItems` / `memoryChars`, checked by test 4 at the cap and one over it); `bun test convex/lib/coachPrompt.test.ts` → `45 pass` (exact). Latency: not applicable (pure function).

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  import { z } from "zod";
  import { createTool } from "@convex-dev/agent";
  import { readProposal, type CoachProposal } from "../coachPrompt";
  export type NoteProposal = Extract<CoachProposal, { kind: "note" }>;
  /** The validated card, or null when the title or body is blank after the readProposal checks. */
  export function createNoteProposal(args: { title: string; body: string }): NoteProposal | null {
    const p = readProposal({ kind: "note", title: args.title, body: args.body });
    return p?.kind === "note" ? p : null;
  }
  export const createNoteTool = createTool({
    description: "Propose a new Markdown page. Nothing is created until the person accepts it.",
    args: z.object({ title: z.string(), body: z.string() }),
    handler: async (_ctx, args): Promise<{ proposal: NoteProposal | null }> => ({ proposal: createNoteProposal(args) }),
  });
  ```
  Limits (from `COACH_LIMITS`): title ≤ 200 UTF-16 units, whitespace collapsed; body ≤ 20,000, Tempo block JSON fences removed (`plainMarkdown`). Auth: the tool runs only inside an Agent turn, which TFV2-0153's caller gates with `requireApprovedForAi`. No error is thrown: an invalid card is `proposal: null`. No user-facing copy (the card UI is TFV2-0213).
- **TESTS:**

  3. Given a body that is one fenced block opening with "```json tempo" followed by the line `Plain line` / Then the returned `body` equals `"Plain line"`.
  4. Given a 250-character title and a 25,000-character body / Then `title.length === 200`, `body.length === 20000`, and both end with `"…"`.

  export type TaskProposal = Extract<CoachProposal, { kind: "task" }>;
  export function addTaskToTodayProposal(args: { title: string; minutes?: number; when: string }): TaskProposal | null {

  ```ts
  export type JobProposal = { kind: "job"; cron: string; task: string; targetPageType: "daily" | "weekly" | "project" | "plain" };
  /** One cron field: "*", a number, a range "a-b", a list "a,b", each optionally "/step"; digits and * , - / only. */
  export const CRON_FIELD = /^(\*|\d+(-\d+)?)(\/\d+)?(,(\*|\d+(-\d+)?)(\/\d+)?)*$/;
  /** Exactly 5 space-separated fields, each matching CRON_FIELD, minute 0–59, hour 0–23, day 1–31, month 1–12, weekday 0–6 for every number. */
  export function isFiveFieldCron(cron: string): boolean;
  /** null when the cron is not five valid fields, the task is blank after trimming, or targetPageType is not one of the four. Task ≤ 200 (truncate). */
  export function scheduleJobProposal(args: { cron: string; task: string; targetPageType: string }): JobProposal | null;
  export const scheduleJobTool = createTool({
    description: "Propose a recurring job. Cron is five fields in UTC. Nothing runs until the person approves it.",
    args: z.object({ cron: z.string(), task: z.string(), targetPageType: z.enum(["daily", "weekly", "project", "plain"]) }),
    handler: async (_ctx, args): Promise<{ proposal: JobProposal | null }> => ({ proposal: scheduleJobProposal(args) }),
  });
  ```
  Auth as TFV2-0156. No error thrown; no user-facing copy (the job card is TFV2-0216).
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `scheduleJobProposal({ cron: "0 6 * * 1-5", task: "Plan my day", targetPageType: "daily" })` / Then it equals `{ kind: "job", cron: "0 6 * * 1-5", task: "Plan my day", targetPageType: "daily" }`.
  2. Given cron `"every weekday at 8"` / Then `null`.
  3. Given cron `"0 6 * *"` (four fields) and `"60 6 * * *"` (minute out of range) / Then both `null`.
  4. Given task `"  "` / Then `null`.
  5. Given `targetPageType: "monthly"` / Then `null`.
- **NUMBERS:** 5 of 5 cases pass (exact); cron fields within POSIX ranges (minute 0–59, hour 0–23, day 1–31, month 1–12, weekday 0–6; source: POSIX `crontab` specification, https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9799919799/utilities/crontab.html).

  export type ModuleDraftState = { status: "pending" | "approved" | "discarded"; draft: ModuleDraft };
  export type ModuleDecision =
    | { status: "approved"; module: { name: string; summary: string; body: string; status: "live"; enabled: true } }
    | { status: "discarded" };
  export const MODULE_ALREADY_DECIDED = "This draft was already decided.";
  export const MODULE_DRAFT_INVALID = "This draft can't go live as it is.";
  /** Throws Error(MODULE_ALREADY_DECIDED) unless state.status is "pending"; on approve, throws Error(MODULE_DRAFT_INVALID) when draftModuleProposal(state.draft) is null. */
  export function decideModuleDraft(state: ModuleDraftState, decision: "approve" | "discard"): ModuleDecision;
  ```

  import { truncate } from "./lib/coachPrompt";
  export const THREAD_PAGE_DEFAULT = 20;
  export const THREAD_PAGE_MAX = 50;
  /** Conversation rows read per call (live and deleted), before the live filter. */
  export const THREAD_SCAN_MAX = 100;
  export const LAST_LINE_CHARS = 160;
  /** Newest messages read per thread to find its last live user/assistant line. */
  export const LAST_LINE_SCAN_MAX = 5;
  export const threadSummaryValidator = v.object({
    _id: v.id("conversations"),
    title: v.string(),
    lastLine: v.union(v.string(), v.null()),
    updatedAt: v.number(),
  });
  export type ThreadSummary = { _id: Id<"conversations">; title: string; lastLine: string | null; updatedAt: number };
  /** Whitespace collapsed to single spaces, trimmed, cut to LAST_LINE_CHARS with truncate ("…", no split surrogate pair); "" → null. */
  export function lastLineOf(content: string): string | null;
  /** Newest live user/assistant message of a conversation, read as:
   *  ctx.db.query("messages").withIndex("by_conversationId_createdAt", (q) => q.eq("conversationId", id).gte("createdAt", 0)).order("desc").take(LAST_LINE_SCAN_MAX)
   *  then the first row with deletedAt === undefined and role !== "system"; its lastLineOf(content), or null. */
  async function newestLine(ctx: QueryCtx, id: Id<"conversations">): Promise<string | null>;
  export const listThreads = query({
    args: { beforeUpdatedAt: v.optional(v.number()), limit: v.optional(v.number()) },
    returns: v.object({ threads: v.array(threadSummaryValidator), nextBefore: v.union(v.number(), v.null()) }),
    handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, args: { beforeUpdatedAt?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ threads: ThreadSummary[]; nextBefore: number | null }> => { … },
  });

Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).order("desc").take(THREAD_SCAN_MAX)`; keep `deletedAt === undefined`; first `limit` rows → `{ _id, title, lastLine: await newestLine(ctx, _id), updatedAt }`; `nextBefore` = the last thread's `updatedAt` when exactly `limit` threads were returned, else `null`. Paging is by strictly older `updatedAt`, so two conversations with the identical millisecond `updatedAt` on a page edge show only once (accepted: ms timestamps). Auth: `requireUser`. Errors: `"Not authenticated"` (no identity; TESTS 1) is the only one this function's tests trigger; `requireUser`'s other messages (`"User not found"`, `"This account is not active"`) are its own and are tested in `convex/lib/requireUser.test.ts`, not here.   /** POST { model, input: texts } with Authorization: Bearer <DEEPINFRA_API_KEY>; returns data[i].embedding mapped through toUnitPrefix, in input order. */
  export async function embedTexts(texts: readonly string[], fetchImpl?: typeof fetch): Promise<number[][]>;
  ```
  Rules: `texts.length === 0` → `[]` with no request; `texts.length > 64` → `new Error("Embed at most 64 texts at a time.")`; missing key → `new AiAuthError("DEEPINFRA_API_KEY not set in Convex env")` (same text as `callLLM`); HTTP 401/403 → `new AiAuthError("DeepInfra auth failed")`; any other non-2xx → `new AiUpstreamError("DeepInfra embeddings failed", status, "deepinfra")`; a response whose `data` length differs from `texts.length` → `new AiUpstreamError("DeepInfra embeddings returned the wrong count", 200, "deepinfra")`. Runtime model (product calls): `resolveEmbeddingModel()`; Q-14 decides it. No user-facing copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `toUnitPrefix([3, 4, 12], 2)` / Then it equals `[0.6, 0.8]`; and `toUnitPrefix([1], 2)` throws `"embedding too short"`; and `toUnitPrefix([0, 0], 2)` throws `"embedding has zero length"`.
  2. Given `embedTexts([])` with a stub fetch / Then it resolves `[]` and the stub was not called.
  3. Given 65 texts / Then it rejects with `"Embed at most 64 texts at a time."` and the stub was not called; and given the 64 texts `Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => "t" + i)` with a stub returning 200 and `{ data: <64 entries, each { embedding: [1, ...new Array(1023).fill(0)] }> }` / Then it resolves 64 vectors, each of length 1024 with first value 1.
  4. Given `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` unset / Then it rejects with an `AiAuthError` whose message is `"DEEPINFRA_API_KEY not set in Convex env"`.
  5. Given the key `"test-key"` and a stub returning 200 `{ data: [{ embedding: <4096 floats, first two 3 and 4, rest 0> }] }` / When `embedTexts(["hi"], stub)` runs / Then the result has one vector of length 1024 whose first two values are 0.6 and 0.8, the stub got `DEEPINFRA_EMBEDDINGS_URL`, header `Authorization: "Bearer test-key"` and body `{ model: "Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B", input: ["hi"] }`.
  6. Given a stub returning 500 / Then it rejects with an `AiUpstreamError` with `status: 500`, and its message does not contain `"test-key"`.
- **NUMBERS:** vector length exactly 1,024 (must equal the `dimensions` of `by_userId_embedding` in CFG-001; Convex vector search, https://docs.convex.dev/search/vector-search); ≤ 64 texts per request (`EMBED_BATCH_MAX`); 6 of 6 cases pass. Provider p95 latency: UNKNOWN (no baseline).

  ```ts
  export const MEANING_DEFAULT_LIMIT = 10;
  type MemoryView = Infer<typeof memoryValidator>; // import type { Infer } from "convex/values"
  type MeaningDeps = {
    gate: () => Promise<void>;                                   // requireApprovedForAi(ctx)
    scope: () => Promise<Id<"users">>;                           // ctx.runQuery(internal.memory.recallScope, {})
    embed: (texts: string[]) => Promise<number[][]>;              // embedTexts
    search: (vector: number[], limit: number, userId: Id<"users">) => Promise<{ _id: Id<"memories">; _score: number }[]>; // ctx.vectorSearch("memories", "by_userId_embedding", { vector, limit, filter: (q) => q.eq("userId", userId) })
    hydrate: (ids: Id<"memories">[]) => Promise<MemoryView[]>;   // ctx.runQuery(internal.memory.hydrateMemories, { ids })
  };
  export async function recallMeaningWith(deps: MeaningDeps, args: { query: string; limit?: number }): Promise<MemoryView[]>;
  export const recallMeaning = action({
    args: { query: v.string(), limit: v.optional(v.number()) },
    returns: v.array(memoryValidator),
    handler: async (ctx: ActionCtx, args: { query: string; limit?: number }): Promise<MemoryView[]> =>
      recallMeaningWith(
        {
          gate: async () => { await requireApprovedForAi(ctx); },
          scope: () => ctx.runQuery(internal.memory.recallScope, {}),
          embed: (texts) => embedTexts(texts),
          search: (vector, limit, userId) => ctx.vectorSearch("memories", "by_userId_embedding", { vector, limit, filter: (q) => q.eq("userId", userId) }),

        },
        args,
      ),
  });

  5. Given `limit: 1000` / Then `search` got `limit: 256`; with no limit it got `10`.

- **MUTATES:** `convex/memory.ts` (edit: add `recallByTime`) · `convex/memory.test.ts` (edit: append one `describe` block). Reads `memories`; writes nothing.
- **STEPS:** 1) Code-map check: `grep -n "by_userId_deletedAt_createdAt" convex/schema.ts` (from CFG-033; if missing report `blocked: missing CFG-033`); read `clampLimit` (line 45: default 50, else clamped 1–200 with `MAX_LIMIT = 200`) and `toMemory` (line 61) in `convex/memory.ts`; `grep -cE '^\s*(test|it)\(' convex/memory.test.ts` → `29` (the tests the `Depends` chain left in the file; any other number: stop with `blocked: PATH_DRIFT — test count`); `grep -n "^async function rejection" convex/memory.test.ts` → one line (TFV2-0171). 2) Add `recallByTime` as written in SPEC. 3) Append `describe("memory.recallByTime", …)` with the 8 TESTS cases. 4) Run DONE.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const recallByTime = query({
    args: { fromMs: v.number(), toMs: v.number(), limit: v.optional(v.number()) },
    returns: v.array(memoryValidator),
    handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, args: { fromMs: number; toMs: number; limit?: number }): Promise<ReturnType<typeof toMemory>[]> => {
      const user = await requireUser(ctx);
      if (!Number.isFinite(args.fromMs) || !Number.isFinite(args.toMs) || args.toMs <= args.fromMs) return [];
      const rows = await ctx.db
        .query("memories")
        .withIndex("by_userId_deletedAt_createdAt", (q) =>
          q.eq("userId", user._id).eq("deletedAt", undefined).gte("createdAt", args.fromMs).lt("createdAt", args.toMs))
        .order("desc")
        .take(clampLimit(args.limit));
      return rows.map(toMemory);
    },
  });
  ```
  Range is start-inclusive, end-exclusive. Limit default 50, 1–200. Errors: `"Not authenticated"` only (an empty or inverted range is `[]`, not an error).
- **TESTS:** (every memory row is seeded inline with `ctx.db.insert("memories", { userId: "users:1", content: "<the case's text>", sector: "general", salience: 0.5, decayRate: 0.01, lastAccessed: 1, accessCount: 0, createdAt: 1, updatedAt: 1 })`, changing only the fields a case names (`userId`, `content`, `sector`, `salience`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `deletedAt`, `metadata`) to the exact values in that case; `rejection(p: unknown): Promise<string>` — the CONVENTIONS §16 standard helper declared at the top of `convex/memory.test.ts` by TFV2-0171 (`async function rejection(p: unknown): Promise<string> { try { await p; } catch (e) { return e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e); } throw new Error("expected a rejection"); }`); "rejects with X" means `expect(await rejection(<the call>)).toBe(X)`)
  1. Given `makeSignedOutCtx()` / When `recallByTime({ fromMs: 0, toMs: 10 })` runs / Then it rejects with `"Not authenticated"`.
  2. Given memories created at 100, 200, 300 / When `recallByTime({ fromMs: 100, toMs: 300 })` runs / Then `createdAt` values are `[200, 100]` (300 excluded, 100 included).
  3. Given `toMs <= fromMs` (`{ fromMs: 300, toMs: 300 }`) / When it runs / Then `[]`.
  4. Given `fromMs: Number.NaN` / When it runs / Then `[]`.
  5. Given a soft-deleted memory and a memory of `users:2` inside the range / When `users:1` runs it / Then neither is returned.
  6. Given memories at 100, 200, 300 / When `recallByTime({ fromMs: 0, toMs: 1000, limit: 2 })` runs / Then `createdAt` values are `[300, 200]`.
  7. Given 51 memories with `createdAt` 1…51 / When `recallByTime({ fromMs: 0, toMs: 1000 })` runs (no limit) / Then 50 rows return, `createdAt` 51 first and 2 last; and given exactly 50 memories (`createdAt` 1…50) / Then 50 rows (default 50 at n and n + 1).
  8. Given 201 memories with `createdAt` 1…201 / When `recallByTime({ fromMs: 0, toMs: 1000, limit: 201 })` runs / Then 200 rows; and with `limit: 200` / Then 200 rows (`MAX_LIMIT` = 200 at n and n + 1).
- **NUMBERS:** ≤ 200 rows read and returned, default 50 (code constants; bounded index read per CONVENTIONS §20; tests 7–8 at n and n + 1); 8 of 8 cases pass. p95 latency: UNKNOWN (no baseline; not a gate).
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (~typesafe/jev-latest): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

  ```ts
  export const RECALL_MODES = ["keyword", "meaning", "links", "time"] as const;
  type RecallMode = (typeof RECALL_MODES)[number];
  type MergeRunners = Record<RecallMode, () => Promise<MemoryView[]>>; // keyword: runQuery(api.memory.recall); meaning: recallMeaningWith; links: runQuery(api.memory.recallLinks) → .memories.map(m => m.memory); time: runQuery(api.memory.recallByTime, { fromMs: now - 7 days, toMs: now + 1 })
  export async function recallMergedWith(runners: MergeRunners, args: { modes: RecallMode[]; limit: number }): Promise<MemoryView[]>;
  export const recallMerged = action({
    args: { query: v.string(), limit: v.optional(v.number()), modes: v.optional(v.array(v.union(v.literal("keyword"), v.literal("meaning"), v.literal("links"), v.literal("time")))) },
    returns: v.array(memoryValidator),
    handler: async (ctx: ActionCtx, args) => { … },
  });
  ```
  `requireApprovedForAi(ctx)` first; modes default `["keyword", "meaning"]` (deduped, order kept); limit default 10, clamped 1–200; modes run in the given order; a `meaning` runner that throws is logged as `console.error("recall_meaning_failed")` (no error text) and contributes nothing; results concatenated in mode order, deduped by `_id`, sliced to limit. Errors: `"Not authenticated"`, `PENDING_APPROVAL_MESSAGE`; errors from non-meaning runners propagate.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given keyword returns [A, B] and meaning returns [B, C] / When `recallMergedWith(runners, { modes: ["keyword", "meaning"], limit: 10 })` runs / Then contents are `[A, B, C]`.
  2. Given meaning throws `new Error("upstream 500 key=abc")` and keyword returns [A] / Then the result is `[A]` and `console.error` was called with exactly `"recall_meaning_failed"`.
  3. Given `modes: ["keyword"]` / Then only the keyword runner was called.
  4. Given `limit: 2` and keyword returns [A, B, C] / Then `[A, B]`.
  5. Given a gate that rejects with `"Not authenticated"` (through `recallMerged`'s handler with a stub ctx) / Then it rejects with that message and no runner was called.
- **NUMBERS:** ≤ 200 results, default 10; 5 of 5 cases pass. p95 latency: UNKNOWN (no baseline).

    embed: (texts: string[]) => Promise<number[][]>;                                    // embedTexts

  };
  export async function reembedForUserWith(deps: ReembedDeps, userId: Id<"users">): Promise<{ embedded: number; remaining: boolean }>;

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // scripts/embedding-eval.ts
  export const EVAL_MODELS = ["Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B", "BAAI/bge-m3", "intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct"] as const;
  export type EvalModel = (typeof EVAL_MODELS)[number];
  export const EVAL_DIMS = 1024;
  export const EVAL_TOP_K = 3;
  export const EVAL_BATCH = 64;
  export const DEEPINFRA_EMBEDDINGS_URL = "https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai/embeddings";
  export const QUERY_INSTRUCTION = "Given a question, retrieve the note that answers it";
  export type EvalNote = { id: string; text: string };
  export type EvalQuestion = { question: string; lang: "he" | "en"; noteId: string };
  export type EvalDataset = { notes: EvalNote[]; questions: EvalQuestion[] };
  export type EvalResult = { model: EvalModel; he: number; en: number; all: number };
  export function parseDataset(raw: unknown): EvalDataset;
  export function queryText(model: EvalModel, question: string): string;
  export function toUnit(vector: readonly number[], dims?: number): number[];          // dims default EVAL_DIMS
  export function topK(query: readonly number[], notes: readonly (readonly number[])[], k: number): number[];
  export function hitRate(questions: readonly (readonly number[])[], notes: readonly (readonly number[])[], expected: readonly number[], k: number): number;
  export async function embedAll(model: EvalModel, texts: readonly string[], apiKey: string, fetchImpl?: typeof fetch): Promise<number[][]>;
  export async function evaluateModel(model: EvalModel, dataset: EvalDataset, apiKey: string, fetchImpl?: typeof fetch): Promise<EvalResult>;
  export function formatResults(results: readonly EvalResult[]): string;
  ```
  Rules:
  - `parseDataset`: `raw` not an object, or `notes`/`questions` not arrays → `new Error("Dataset must have notes and questions arrays.")`; any note without a non-empty string `id` and `text`, or any question without a non-empty string `question` and `noteId` or with `lang` not `"he"`/`"en"` → `new Error("Dataset has an invalid note or question.")`; two notes with the same `id` → `new Error("Note ids must be unique.")`; a question whose `noteId` is not a note id → `new Error("A question points at a missing note.")`. Returns a new object with only the typed fields.
  - `queryText` (query prefixes from each model card): `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B` → `` `Instruct: ${QUERY_INSTRUCTION}\nQuery:${question}` ``; `intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct` → `` `Instruct: ${QUERY_INSTRUCTION}\nQuery: ${question}` ``; `BAAI/bge-m3` → `question` unchanged. Note texts are always embedded unchanged.
  - `toUnit`: first `dims` values divided by their L2 norm; `vector.length < dims` → `new Error("embedding too short")`; norm 0 → `new Error("embedding has zero length")`. Every vector of every model goes through it (Qwen3 is truncated from 4,096 to 1,024 as TRD §5 plans for production).
  - `topK`: score = dot product (vectors are unit length, so it equals cosine); returns note indices by score descending, equal scores lower index first, at most `k`.
  - `hitRate`: `questions.length !== expected.length` → `new Error("questions and expected differ in length")`; `questions.length === 0` → `0` (never `NaN`); else the fraction of `i` with `expected[i]` in `topK(questions[i], notes, k)`.
  - `embedAll`: splits `texts` into batches of `EVAL_BATCH` in order; per batch `fetchImpl(DEEPINFRA_EMBEDDINGS_URL, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: \`Bearer ${apiKey}\` }, body: JSON.stringify({ model, input: batch }) })` (`fetchImpl` defaults to global `fetch`); non-2xx → `new Error(\`DeepInfra embeddings failed: HTTP ${status}\`)`; `data.length !== batch.length` → `new Error("DeepInfra embeddings returned the wrong count")`; returns `data[i].embedding` mapped through `toUnit`, in input order. Empty `texts` → `[]` with no request.
  - `evaluateModel`: embeds `notes.map((n) => n.text)` and `questions.map((q) => queryText(model, q.question))` (two `embedAll` calls, notes first); `expected[i]` = index of `questions[i].noteId` in `notes`; `he` / `en` = `hitRate` over that language's questions only (0 when none), `all` = over every question, all with `EVAL_TOP_K`.
  - `formatResults`: lines `"model | he | en | all"`, then one line per result `` `${model} | ${he.toFixed(2)} | ${en.toFixed(2)} | ${all.toFixed(2)}` ``, joined with `"\n"`.
  - CLI (`import.meta.main` only): `process.argv[2]` missing → `console.error("usage: bun scripts/embedding-eval.ts <dataset.json>")` and `process.exit(2)`; `process.env.DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` empty → `console.error("DEEPINFRA_API_KEY is not set")` and `process.exit(2)`; else `parseDataset(await Bun.file(path).json())`, `evaluateModel` for each of `EVAL_MODELS` in order, `console.log(formatResults(results))`.
  - Runtime models (product-side candidates, not the code model): the three `EVAL_MODELS`. No user-facing copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `toUnit([3, 4, 12], 2)` / Then `[0.6, 0.8]`; `toUnit([1], 2)` throws `"embedding too short"`; `toUnit([0, 0], 2)` throws `"embedding has zero length"`.
  2. Given query `[1, 0]` and notes `[[0, 1], [1, 0], [1, 0], [0.6, 0.8]]` / When `topK(query, notes, 3)` runs / Then `[1, 2, 3]` (tie broken by lower index).
  3. Given questions `[[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 0]]`, notes `[[1, 0], [0, 1]]`, expected `[0, 1, 1]` / When `hitRate(questions, notes, expected, 1)` runs / Then it equals `2 / 3`.
  4. Given `hitRate([], [[1, 0]], [], 3)` / Then `0`.
  5. Given two questions and one expected index / When `hitRate` runs / Then it throws `"questions and expected differ in length"`.
  6. Given question `"מה אני אוהב?"` / When `queryText` runs for each model / Then Qwen gives `"Instruct: Given a question, retrieve the note that answers it\nQuery:מה אני אוהב?"`, e5 gives the same with `"Query: "` (one space), bge-m3 gives `"מה אני אוהב?"`.
  7. Given `{ notes: [{ id: "n1", text: "Likes tea" }], questions: [{ question: "Tea?", lang: "en", noteId: "n1", extra: 1 }] }` / When `parseDataset` runs / Then it returns `{ notes: [{ id: "n1", text: "Likes tea" }], questions: [{ question: "Tea?", lang: "en", noteId: "n1" }] }`.
  8. Given `null`; a question with `lang: "fr"`; two notes with id `"n1"`; a question with `noteId: "n9"` / When `parseDataset` runs on each / Then it throws, in order, `"Dataset must have notes and questions arrays."`, `"Dataset has an invalid note or question."`, `"Note ids must be unique."`, `"A question points at a missing note."`.
  9. Given 65 texts and a stub that answers each request with `{ data: input.map(() => ({ embedding: [3, 4, ...Array(4094).fill(0)] })) }` / When `embedAll("BAAI/bge-m3", texts, "test-key", stub)` runs / Then the stub was called twice (batches of 64 and 1), each with `DEEPINFRA_EMBEDDINGS_URL`, header `Authorization: "Bearer test-key"` and body `{ model: "BAAI/bge-m3", input: <that batch> }`, and the result has 65 vectors of length 1024 starting `0.6, 0.8`; and given exactly 64 texts / Then the stub was called once (`EVAL_BATCH` = 64 fits one request).
  10. Given a stub returning HTTP 500 / When `embedAll` runs / Then it rejects with `"DeepInfra embeddings failed: HTTP 500"` and the message does not contain `"test-key"`; given a stub returning one vector for two texts / Then it rejects with `"DeepInfra embeddings returned the wrong count"`.
  11. Given notes `A`, `B`, `C`, `D` (texts `"Note A"`…`"Note D"`), questions `{ question: "QA", lang: "he", noteId: "A" }`, `{ question: "QB", lang: "en", noteId: "B" }`, `{ question: "QX", lang: "en", noteId: "A" }`, and a stub that returns 1,024-length vectors by exact input text — `"Note A"`…`"Note D"` → one-hot at index 0…3, `"QA"` → one-hot 0, `"QB"` → one-hot 1, `"QX"` → `0.1` at 0, `0.5` at 1, `0.4` at 2, `0.3` at 3 (so its top 3 are B, C, D) / When `evaluateModel("BAAI/bge-m3", dataset, "test-key", stub)` runs / Then it returns `{ model: "BAAI/bge-m3", he: 1, en: 0.5, all: 2 / 3 }` and the stub's first request held the four note texts, the second the three question texts.
  12. Given `[{ model: "BAAI/bge-m3", he: 0.85, en: 0.9, all: 0.875 }]` / When `formatResults` runs / Then it equals `"model | he | en | all\nBAAI/bge-m3 | 0.85 | 0.90 | 0.88"`.
- **NUMBERS:** 12 of 12 cases pass (exact). Vector length 1,024 after truncation (`EVAL_DIMS`, matches the proposed CFG-001 index dimensions; Convex vector limits 2–2,048, https://docs.convex.dev/search/vector-search); ≤ 64 texts per request (`EVAL_BATCH`). Top-3 hit rate per model: reported, not a gate — UNKNOWN until Amit runs it (TRD §5: no public Hebrew embedding benchmark exists).
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (~typesafe/jev-latest): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

  ```ts
  export const ENTITY_MAX = 500;  // live entities per person; also the bounded read size
  export const NAME_MAX = 200;    // characters (UTF-16 units) per name or alias; a [[link]] target is at most 200
  export const ALIAS_MAX = 20;
  export const entityKindValidator = v.union(v.literal("person"), v.literal("project"), v.literal("goal"), v.literal("place"), v.literal("habit"));
  export type EntityKind = "person" | "project" | "goal" | "place" | "habit";
  export const upsertEntity = mutation({
    args: { kind: entityKindValidator, name: v.string(), aliases: v.optional(v.array(v.string())) },
    returns: v.id("entities"),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { kind: EntityKind; name: string; aliases?: string[] }): Promise<Id<"entities">> => { … },
  });
  ```
  Order: `const user = await requireUser(ctx);` → `name = args.name.trim()`; empty → `new Error("Give it a name.")` → `raw = args.aliases ?? []`; `raw.length > ALIAS_MAX` → `new Error("Add up to 20 other names.")` → if `name.length > NAME_MAX` or any `alias.trim().length > NAME_MAX` → `new Error("Keep each name to 200 characters or fewer.")` → `aliases` = each alias trimmed, empty ones dropped, ones whose `titleKey` equals `titleKey(name)` dropped, duplicates by `titleKey` dropped (first kept, input order). `live = await ctx.db.query("entities").withIndex("by_userId_deletedAt", (q) => q.eq("userId", user._id).eq("deletedAt", undefined)).take(ENTITY_MAX)`; `existing = live.find((e) => titleKey(e.name) === titleKey(name))`. Existing → `ctx.db.patch(existing._id, { kind: args.kind, name, aliases, updatedAt: now })` (aliases are replaced by the given list) and return `existing._id`. Else `live.length >= ENTITY_MAX` → `new Error("Keep up to 500 people, projects, goals, places and habits.")`; else insert `{ userId: user._id, kind: args.kind, name, aliases, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }` and return its id. `now = Date.now()`. Errors: `"Not authenticated"` (from `requireUser`), `"Give it a name."`, `"Add up to 20 other names."`, `"Keep each name to 200 characters or fewer."`, `"Keep up to 500 people, projects, goals, places and habits."`. English only (CONVENTIONS §11; the UI maps them).
  **Relies on** (not created here; checked in STEP 1):
  - table `entities` (CFG-002): `userId: v.id("users")`, `kind: v.union(v.literal("person"), v.literal("project"), v.literal("goal"), v.literal("place"), v.literal("habit"))`, `name: v.string()`, `aliases: v.array(v.string())`, `createdAt: v.number()`, `updatedAt: v.number()`, `deletedAt: v.optional(v.number())`; indexes `by_userId` `["userId"]`, `by_userId_deletedAt` `["userId", "deletedAt"]`, `by_userId_kind` `["userId", "kind"]`.
  - `requireUser(ctx: QueryCtx | MutationCtx)` (`convex/lib/requireUser.ts` line 51, existing): returns the caller's `users` row; throws `"Not authenticated"` (no identity), `"User not found"`, `"This account is not active"`.

### TFV2-0187a — Life graph: `lifeGraph.extractEdges` (links the person wrote → `extracted` edges, no model)

Old TFV2-0187 bundled two functions; split per CONVENTIONS §7 H into this ticket (written links, no model) and TFV2-0187b–d (model guesses). `edges` comes from CFG-003; `sourceNoteId` and the index `by_userId_sourceNoteId` come from CFG-034, so a page's extracted edges can be found and kept in sync when the page changes. Links are read with `findWikiLinks` and `titleKey` from `@tempo/utils` (the shared parser the backlinks query uses: no links inside code or Tempo fences). Rule chosen here: the page's own title names the "from" entity; each `[[link]]` that names another entity (by name or alias) is one edge "links to". Pages are not entities (CFG-002 kinds are person/project/goal/place/habit), so a page whose title names no entity yields no edges. Calling this after each page save is a later wiring ticket (TRD §5c "Retain"); this ticket adds the function only. `convex/lifeGraph.ts` (with `ENTITY_MAX`) and `convex/lifeGraph.test.ts` come from TFV2-0186a; the test file holds 14 tests before this ticket (TFV2-0186a 8, TFV2-0186b 6, a linear `Depends` chain), so TFV2-0186b is in `Depends` and the DONE total is exact (CONVENTIONS §1).

  ```ts
  export const EXTRACT_LINK_MAX = 100;   // distinct link targets used per page
  export const PAGE_EDGE_SCAN = 200;     // edges of one page read
  export const EXTRACTED_RELATION = "links to";
  export const extractEdges = mutation({
    args: { noteId: v.id("notes") },
    returns: v.object({ created: v.number(), removed: v.number() }),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { noteId: Id<"notes"> }): Promise<{ created: number; removed: number }> => { … },
  });
  ```
  1. `requireUser`; `note = await ctx.db.get(args.noteId)`; missing, `userId !== user._id` or `deletedAt !== undefined` → `new Error("Note not found")`.
  2. `entities` = caller's live entities (`by_userId_deletedAt`, `.take(ENTITY_MAX)`, keep `deletedAt === undefined`). Build `byKey: Map<string, Id<"entities">>` in scan order: for each entity, `titleKey(name)` then each `titleKey(alias)`, set only if the key is not already present.
  3. `pageEntity = byKey.get(titleKey(note.title))`. `wanted` = when `pageEntity` is undefined `[]`; else the distinct `titleKey(link.title)` of `findWikiLinks(note.body)` in order, first `EXTRACT_LINK_MAX`, each mapped through `byKey`, dropping unknown keys, `pageEntity` itself and repeats.
  4. `existing` = `ctx.db.query("edges").withIndex("by_userId_sourceNoteId", (q) => q.eq("userId", user._id).eq("sourceNoteId", args.noteId)).take(PAGE_EDGE_SCAN)`, keep `deletedAt === undefined && origin === "extracted"`.
  5. Each existing edge whose `fromEntityId !== pageEntity` or whose `toEntityId` is not in `wanted` → `patch(edge._id, { deletedAt: now, updatedAt: now })`, `removed += 1`.

  - `requireUser(ctx: QueryCtx | MutationCtx)` (`convex/lib/requireUser.ts` line 51, existing): returns the caller's `users` row; throws `"Not authenticated"` (no identity), `"User not found"`, `"This account is not active"`.
  - `titleKey(title: string): string` (`packages/utils/src/wiki-links.ts` line 155, existing, exported from `@tempo/utils`): `title.trim().toLowerCase()`; `titleKey("  Dana ")` → `"dana"`.

### TFV2-0187c — Life graph: `lifeGraph.saveInferredEdges` (internal mutation: store model guesses) — OPEN
- **STATUS:** open — Q-06: AI changes: always propose (confirm/edit/reject) vs auto-apply with 5-min undo.; new: May model-guessed links be stored directly as `inferred` edges marked as guesses (PRD F-54), or must every AI-made write go through a confirm / edit / reject proposal first (HARD_RULES §1, "AI changes")?
- **Stage:** C · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** TFV2-0186a, CFG-003, CFG-034 · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** after TFV2-0186a, CFG-003, CFG-034.
- **WHY:** TRD §5c (`inferred` = model-guessed edges with `confidence`); PRD F-54 (guesses are kept and marked as guesses). HARD_RULES §1 and the "AI changes" section say the AI never silently mutates user state and an action must never call a mutation with AI-made arguments without a user confirm; PRD F-54 instead stores guesses directly, marked as guesses, confirmed later (TFV2-0188a). That is Q-06, so this ticket is OPEN. Part of old TFV2-0187 (split per CONVENTIONS §7 H).
- **GOAL:** `lifeGraph.saveInferredEdges` (internalMutation) stores up to 20 valid guessed edges for one person and page as `origin: "inferred"`, skipping invalid ones and pairs that already have a live edge.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lifeGraph.ts` · test: `convex/lifeGraph.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `convex/lifeGraph.ts` (edit: add `INFER_EDGE_MAX`, `RELATION_MAX`, `PAIR_EDGE_SCAN`, `saveInferredEdges`; add `internalMutation` to the server import) · `convex/lifeGraph.test.ts` (edit: append one `describe` block) · `edges` rows (insert).
- **STEPS:** 1) Code-map check: `grep -n "sourceNoteId" convex/schema.ts` (CFG-034; else `blocked: missing CFG-034`); read `convex/lifeGraph.ts`. 2) Add the constants and `saveInferredEdges` as written in SPEC. 3) Append `describe("lifeGraph.saveInferredEdges", …)` with the 6 TESTS cases (`Date.now` spied to `7000`). 4) Run DONE.
- **DONE:** `bun test convex/lifeGraph.test.ts` → `0 fail` with the 6 new cases passing.
- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test convex/lifeGraph.test.ts` pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** write `origin: "extracted"`; make it public; overwrite or delete an existing edge; set `confirmedAt`; call a model here.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const INFER_EDGE_MAX = 20;
  export const RELATION_MAX = 60;
  export const PAIR_EDGE_SCAN = 100; // edges read from one entity
  export const saveInferredEdges = internalMutation({
    args: {
      userId: v.id("users"),
      noteId: v.id("notes"),
      edges: v.array(v.object({ fromEntityId: v.id("entities"), toEntityId: v.id("entities"), relation: v.string(), confidence: v.number() })),
    },
    returns: v.object({ created: v.number(), skipped: v.number() }),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { userId: Id<"users">; noteId: Id<"notes">; edges: { fromEntityId: Id<"entities">; toEntityId: Id<"entities">; relation: string; confidence: number }[] }) => { … },
  });
  ```
  `edges.length > INFER_EDGE_MAX` → `new Error("Save up to 20 guessed links at a time.")`. For each edge in order, skip (`skipped += 1`) when: `relation.trim()` is empty or longer than `RELATION_MAX`; `confidence` is not finite or outside `[0, 1]`; `fromEntityId === toEntityId`; either entity is missing, deleted or not `args.userId`'s; or a live edge `from → to` already exists (`by_userId_fromEntityId`, `eq userId`, `eq fromEntityId`, `.take(PAIR_EDGE_SCAN)`, any origin, including one inserted earlier in this call). Else insert `{ userId, fromEntityId, toEntityId, relation: relation.trim(), origin: "inferred", confidence, sourceNoteId: args.noteId, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }`, `created += 1`. Internal only (no `requireUser`: the calling action ran the AI gate). Errors: `"Save up to 20 guessed links at a time."`.

  1. Given 21 edges / When it runs / Then it rejects with `"Save up to 20 guessed links at a time."` and no edge exists; and given 20 edges A → B (one valid, 19 repeats) / Then it resolves `{ created: 1, skipped: 19 }`.
  2. Given `[{ fromEntityId: A, toEntityId: B, relation: " works with ", confidence: 0.7 }]` / When it runs / Then `{ created: 1, skipped: 0 }` and the row equals `{ userId: "users:1", fromEntityId: A, toEntityId: B, relation: "works with", origin: "inferred", confidence: 0.7, sourceNoteId: P, createdAt: 7000, updatedAt: 7000 }` plus `_id`, `_creationTime`.
  3. Given edges with confidence `1.5`, with confidence `Number.NaN`, and with relation `"   "` / When it runs / Then `{ created: 0, skipped: 3 }`.
  4. Given an edge A → A, and an edge A → X where X is an entity of `users:2` / When it runs for `users:1` / Then `{ created: 0, skipped: 2 }`.
  5. Given an existing live `extracted` edge A → B / When it saves A → B / Then `{ created: 0, skipped: 1 }`.

  export const REFLECT_MAX_PER_RUN = 5;
  export const REFLECT_SYSTEM_PROMPT =
    "You read short notes a person saved about their own life and find patterns that at least three notes support, such as \"gym slips after late nights\". Write each pattern as one plain, kind sentence of at most 20 words, in the language most of the notes use. Never blame or judge. Use only the numbered notes given. Reply with JSON only: {\"observations\":[{\"text\":\"<sentence>\",\"memories\":[<numbers>]}]}. Return an empty list when no pattern has three supporting notes.";
  type ReflectDeps = {
    inputs: () => Promise<Infer<typeof reflectInputsValidator>>;   // ctx.runQuery(internal.lifeGraph.reflectInputs, { userId })
    complete: (messages: AiMessage[]) => Promise<string>;           // (await callLLM({ tier: "fast", messages, maxTokens: 800, temperature: 0.2, responseFormat: "json_object" })).content
    save: (args: { userId: Id<"users">; text: string; memoryIds: Id<"memories">[] }) => Promise<Id<"observations"> | null>; // ctx.runMutation(internal.lifeGraph.saveObservation, args)
  };
  export async function reflectForUserWith(deps: ReflectDeps, userId: Id<"users">): Promise<{ created: number }>;
  export const reflectForUser = internalAction({
    args: { userId: v.id("users") },
    returns: v.object({ created: v.number() }),
    handler: async (ctx: ActionCtx, args: { userId: Id<"users"> }) => reflectForUserWith({ … real deps … }, args.userId),
  });
  ```
  Order: `input = await deps.inputs()`; `!input.approved` or `input.memories.length < REFLECT_MIN_MEMORIES` → `{ created: 0 }` with no model call; messages = `[{ role: "system", content: REFLECT_SYSTEM_PROMPT }, { role: "user", content: input.memories.map((m, i) => \`[${i}] ${m.content}\`).join("\n") }]`; `JSON.parse(await deps.complete(messages))`; parse error or `observations` not an array → `console.error("reflect_parse_failed")` and `{ created: 0 }`; for the first `REFLECT_MAX_PER_RUN` items: skip when `text` is not a string, its trim is empty or longer than `OBSERVATION_TEXT_MAX`, or fewer than `REFLECT_MIN_MEMORIES` distinct integer indexes in range remain after dropping bad ones (cap `OBSERVATION_MEMORY_MAX`); else `await deps.save({ userId, text: text.trim(), memoryIds })`; `created` = number of non-null results. Errors: provider errors from `callLLM` propagate (the cron run logs a failure; the next night retries). Internal only. The prompt is internal (never shown), English; the observation text follows the memories' language.

  1. Given inputs `{ approved: false, memories: [] }` / When it runs / Then `{ created: 0 }` and `complete` was not called.
  2. Given approved inputs with 2 memories / When it runs / Then `{ created: 0 }` and `complete` was not called.
  3. Given the stub inputs, `complete` returning `'{"observations":[{"text":" Gym slips after late nights ","memories":[0,1,2,3]}]}'` and a save stub returning `"observations:1"` / When it runs for `"users:1"` / Then `{ created: 1 }`, save got `{ userId: "users:1", text: "Gym slips after late nights", memoryIds: [m0, m1, m2, m3] }`, and the user message equals `"[0] Late night Sunday\n[1] Skipped gym Monday\n[2] Late night Tuesday\n[3] Skipped gym Wednesday"`.
  4. Given `complete` returning `"{oops"` / When it runs / Then `{ created: 0 }`, save was not called, and `console.error` was called with exactly `"reflect_parse_failed"`.
  5. Given observations `{ text: "A", memories: [0, 9, 9] }` (one valid index) and `{ text: "", memories: [0, 1, 2] }` / When it runs / Then save was not called and `{ created: 0 }`.
  6. Given 7 valid observations and a save stub returning `null` for the second / When it runs / Then save was called 5 times and the result is `{ created: 4 }`.

The legacy user-run action `memories.decayMemories` (`convex/memories.ts` line 186) is not reused: it calls `memories.updateSalience`, which also resets `lastAccessed` and bumps `accessCount`, so decaying would mark memories as used, and it compounds `decayRate * daysSinceAccess` on every run. Rule chosen here, because it runs once a day: each run multiplies `salience` by `(1 - decayRate)` for memories not accessed in the last 24 hours, never below 0.1, and writes only `salience` (`updatedAt` orders lists, `lastAccessed` means use). `convex/memory.test.ts` comes from TFV2-0171.

  ```ts
  /** The coach's whole reply when its own words held a shaming term (HARD_RULES §1). */
  export const SHAME_GUARD_REPLY = {
    en: "Let me say that more kindly: one small step is enough for now. What would help most right now?",
    he: "בניסוח עדין יותר: צעד קטן אחד מספיק בינתיים. מה הכי יעזור עכשיו?",
  } as const;

  // in runCoachReply, after `if (!answer) { … return "unavailable"; }`:
  const shamed = containsShame(answer.reply).found;
  if (shamed) {
    console.error("coach.reply: a reply with a shaming word was replaced");
    answer = { reply: SHAME_GUARD_REPLY[locale], proposal: null };
    sources = [];
  }
  if (!shamed) {
    if (duplicate) {
      answer = { ...answer, reply: `${answer.reply}\n\n${ALREADY_ON_TODAY_NOTE[locale]}` };
    }
    if (note !== null) {
      answer = { ...answer, reply: `${answer.reply}\n\n${WEB_SEARCH_NOTES[note][locale]}` };
    }
  }
  ```

What would help most right now?" / HE "בניסוח עדין יותר: צעד קטן אחד מספיק בינתיים. מה הכי יעזור עכשיו?" (gender-neutral, CONVENTIONS §12).

- **SPEC:** Pure helper (no Convex function kind).
  ```ts
  export const MOCK_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS = 1024;
  export type MockEmbed = ((texts: readonly string[], fetchImpl?: typeof fetch) => Promise<number[][]>) & {
    readonly calls: readonly (readonly string[])[];
  };
  /** FNV-1a 32-bit over UTF-16 code units, modulo dims. */
  export function mockEmbedIndex(text: string, dims: number): number {
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      h ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
      h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
    }
    return h % dims;
  }
  export function mockEmbed(dims: number = MOCK_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS): MockEmbed;
  ```
  Rules: `mockEmbed` throws `new Error("dims must be a positive integer")` at creation unless `Number.isSafeInteger(dims) && dims >= 1`. Each call: `texts.length === 0` → resolves `[]`, not recorded; `texts.length > 64` → rejects with `new Error("Embed at most 64 texts at a time.")` (the same message as `embedTexts`), not recorded; otherwise pushes a copy `[...texts]` to `calls` and resolves one vector per text, in order: `dims` zeros with `1` at `mockEmbedIndex(text, dims)` (unit length; equal texts give equal vectors). `fetchImpl` is ignored. No user-facing copy; no network, env or database access.
- **TESTS:** (`convex/lib/mockModel.test.ts`)
  1. Given `mockEmbedIndex` / Then `("hi", 1024)` is `666`, `("a", 1024)` is `300`, `("", 1024)` is `453` and `("שלום", 1024)` is `398`.
  2. Given `const e = mockEmbed()` / When `e(["hi", "hi", "a"])` runs / Then it resolves 3 vectors of length 1024; `v[0]` `toEqual`s `v[1]`; `v[0][666] === 1` and the sum of `v[0]` is `1`; `v[2][300] === 1`.
  3. Given `e([])` / Then it resolves `[]` and `e.calls.length === 0`.
  4. Given 65 texts / Then it rejects with `"Embed at most 64 texts at a time."` and `e.calls.length === 0`.
  5. Given `const input = ["b", "c"]`; calls `e(["a"])` then `e(input)`, then `input.push("d")` / Then `e.calls` equals `[["a"], ["b", "c"]]`.
  6. Given `globalThis.fetch` replaced by a `mock()` that throws, restored in `afterEach` / When `e(["hi"])` runs / Then the fetch mock was called 0 times.
  7. Given the module / Then `MOCK_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS === EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS`; `mockEmbed(0)` throws `"dims must be a positive integer"`; `await mockEmbed(8)(["hi"])` equals `[[0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]]`; and the file contains `const asEmbedSeam: typeof embedTexts = mockEmbed();` (with `import type { embedTexts } from "./ai_router"`), which `bun run typecheck` compiles.
- **NUMBERS:** vector length = 1,024 by default, equal to `EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS` (TFV2-0174a; Q-14 proposes 1,024); ≤ 64 texts per call (`EMBED_BATCH_MAX`); 0 network calls (TESTS 6); 17 of 17 cases pass. Latency: n/a (in-memory).
