  ```ts
  /** Coach turns one person may start on one UTC day (TRD §7.3 quota). Value: Amit (OPEN). */
  export const COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT: number = /* Amit's number */;
  /** The coach's reply once today's turns are used up, in the person's app language. */
  export const COACH_TURN_LIMIT_NOTE = {
    en: "(Today's coach replies are used up. They start again after midnight UTC.)",
    he: "(התשובות של המאמן להיום נגמרו. הן יתחדשו אחרי חצות UTC.)",
  } as const;
  /** Turns booked on one UTC day, counting at most COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT (bounded read). */
  async function turnsOn(ctx: Db, userId: UserId, day: string): Promise<number> {
    const rows = await ctx.db
      .query("coachTurns")
      .withIndex("by_userId_utcDateKey", (q) => q.eq("userId", userId).eq("utcDateKey", day))
      .take(COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT);
    return rows.length;
  }

  // in claimTurn, after the "busy" check:
  const turnDay = utcDay(now);
  if ((await turnsOn(ctx, user._id, turnDay)) >= COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT) {
    const { locale } = await preferencesFor(ctx, user._id);
    const at = Math.max(now, last.createdAt + 1);
    await ctx.db.insert("messages", {
      conversationId: args.conversationId,
      role: "assistant",
      content: COACH_TURN_LIMIT_NOTE[locale],
      modelUsed: "coach-turn-limit",
      createdAt: at,
    });
    await ctx.db.patch(args.conversationId, { updatedAt: at });
    return null;
  }
  await ctx.db.insert("coachTurns", { userId: user._id, utcDateKey: turnDay, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now });
  ```
  Behaviour: returning `null` makes `runCoachReply` return `"idle"` with no model call; the limit line is then the newest message, so a second `runCoachReply` is also `"idle"` and adds nothing. Order: `requireApprovedForAi` (in `runCoachReply`) → `requireApprovedUser` + `requireLegacyWritableConversation` (in `claimTurn`) → crisis/idle check → busy check → quota → claim. Auth and errors: unchanged (`"Not authenticated"`, `PENDING_APPROVAL_MESSAGE`, `"Conversation not found or access denied"`); no new error. Limit: rows read ≤ `COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT`. Existing whole-turn tests (`coach_chat.test.ts`, `coachProposalGuard.test.ts`) run up to 4 turns for one user in one world (`coachProposalGuard.test.ts` "decision, page and template cards pass…"), so a cap below 5 makes existing cases fail: if STEP 5 or DONE shows that, report `blocked: question — cap below existing test turns` and stop (never edit those cases). Copy (saved as the coach's message): EN "(Today's coach replies are used up. They start again after midnight UTC.)" / HE "(התשובות של המאמן להיום נגמרו. הן יתחדשו אחרי חצות UTC.)".
- **TESTS:** (`const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)`; each case seeds a conversation of the acting user and sends `"Plan my day"` with `say`)

  2. Given A has `COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT` turns dated `today` / When the turn runs / Then it returns `"idle"`, `model.calls` has length 0, the last message has `role: "assistant"`, `content: COACH_TURN_LIMIT_NOTE.en`, `modelUsed: "coach-turn-limit"`, and `coachTurns` still has `COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT` rows.
  3. Given `await turnOnSearch(world, A, "he")` and A at the limit / When the turn runs / Then the last message `content` is `COACH_TURN_LIMIT_NOTE.he`.
  4. Given A has `COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT` turns dated `daysAgo(1)` / When the turn runs / Then it returns `"replied"` and `model.calls` has length 1.
  5. Given B has `COACH_TURN_DAILY_LIMIT` turns dated `today` and A none / When A's turn runs / Then it returns `"replied"`.

  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import { useId } from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  type CopyKey = "today" | "week" | "earlier" | "untitled";
  const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>> = {
    en: { today: "Today", week: "Last week", earlier: "Earlier", untitled: "Untitled" },
    he: { today: "היום", week: "בשבוע שעבר", earlier: "מוקדם יותר", untitled: "ללא כותרת" },
  };
  export type ChatHistoryGroupKey = "today" | "week" | "earlier";
  export type ChatHistoryThread = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    /** Last message line (TFV2-0163 lastLine), or null for an empty conversation. */
    lastLine: string | null;
    /** Already formatted by the screen ("09:12", "Thu 8 Oct"). */
    time: string;
    /** Where the row links (opened in a new tab with Ctrl/Cmd/Shift-click). */
    href: string;
  };
  export type ChatHistoryGroup = { key: ChatHistoryGroupKey; threads: ChatHistoryThread[] };
  export type ChatHistoryListProps = { groups: ChatHistoryGroup[]; currentId?: string | null; onOpen: (id: string) => void };
  /** Local calendar days between updatedAt and nowMs in timeZone (keys from Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" })):
   *  diff ≤ 0 → "today"; 1–7 → "week"; ≥ 8 → "earlier". diff = (Date.UTC of nowMs's key − Date.UTC of updatedAt's key) / 86_400_000. */
  export function chatHistoryGroupKey(updatedAt: number, nowMs: number, timeZone: string): ChatHistoryGroupKey;
  export function ChatHistoryList({ groups, currentId = null, onOpen }: ChatHistoryListProps): React.JSX.Element;
  // first statements of the body (CONVENTIONS §11): const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];
  ```

  Task variant: icon `"task"`, kindLabel `copy.kindTask`, head `copy.headTask`, target `when === "today" ? copy.targetToday : copy.targetLater`; body `<ul className="tp-proposal__changes"><li className="tp-change" data-op="add" data-component="ChangePreview"><span className="tp-change__sign"><TpIcon name="plus" size="sm" /><span>{copy.add}</span></span><span className="tp-change__body">{editing ? editInput : <span className="tp-change__title" dir="auto">{draft}</span>}<span className="tp-change__detail">{copy.kindTask} · <span className="tp-num">{minutes}</span> {copy.min}</span></span></li></ul>`.

States in order (each `id` = the state name): `task-pending` (`TASK`, pending, `primary`), `task-later` (`LATER`, pending), `task-busy` (`TASK`, pending, `busy`), `task-error` (`TASK`, pending, `error`), `task-accepted` (`TASK`, accepted, `undoUntilMs={until}`), `task-expired` (`TASK`, accepted, `undoUntilMs={0}`), `task-rejected` (`TASK`, rejected), `task-undone` (`TASK`, undone).

  "use client";
  import type React from "react";
  import { type ReactNode, useId } from "react";
  import { Badge } from "@/components/layout/Badge";
  import { useLocale } from "@/components/providers/LocaleProvider";
  import { TpIcon } from "@/components/tempo/TpIcon";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  export type MemorySource = "saved" | "chatgpt" | "claude" | "grok" | "other";
  export type MemoryItemData = { id: string; fact: string; source: MemorySource; dayKey: string /* "YYYY-MM-DD" in the person's zone, computed by the route */ };
  export type MemoryGuess = { reason: string; confirmed: boolean };
  export type MemoryItemProps = {
    memory: MemoryItemData;
    todayKey: string;            // "YYYY-MM-DD" of today in userPreferences.timeZone, computed by the route (CONVENTIONS §22)
    guess?: MemoryGuess;         // present → a guessed life-graph link row
    forgetError?: boolean;       // the last Forget of this row failed
    onForget: (id: string) => void;
    onConfirm?: (id: string) => void; // guess rows only
    forgetButtonRef?: (el: HTMLButtonElement | null) => void; // lets the screen move focus
  };
  export function MemoryItem(props: MemoryItemProps): React.JSX.Element;
  export type MemoryListProps = { label: string; children: ReactNode };
  export function MemoryList({ label, children }: MemoryListProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  - **Copy** (CONVENTIONS §11: one `const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>> = { en: {…}, he: {…} }` at the top of the file with `type CopyKey` = the keys below and these exact values; the component body reads `const { lang } = useLocale(); const copy = COPY[lang];`):
    | key | EN | HE |
    |---|---|---|
    | saved | Saved in Tempo | נשמר ב־Tempo |
    | chatgpt | Imported from ChatGPT | יובא מ־ChatGPT |
    | claude | Imported from Claude | יובא מ־Claude |
    | grok | Imported from Grok | יובא מ־Grok |
    | other | Imported | יובא |
    | today | Today | היום |
    | forget | Forget | לשכוח |
    | forgetError | That didn't go through. Try again? | זה לא עבר. לנסות שוב? |
    | guess | Guess | ניחוש |
    | confirmed | You confirmed this | אושר |
    | confirm | That's right | נכון |

  ```ts
  export const GUESS_SCAN = 500; // live edges read
  export const GUESS_MAX = 50;   // guesses returned
  export const guessValidator = v.object({
    _id: v.id("edges"),
    from: v.object({ _id: v.id("entities"), name: v.string(), kind: entityKindValidator }),
    to: v.object({ _id: v.id("entities"), name: v.string(), kind: entityKindValidator }),
    relation: v.string(),
    confidence: v.number(),
    sourceNoteTitle: v.optional(v.string()),
    createdAt: v.number(),
  });
  export const listGuesses = query({
    args: {},
    returns: v.array(guessValidator),
    handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx): Promise<Infer<typeof guessValidator>[]> => { … },
  });

  Handler: `const user = await requireUser(ctx)`; `rows = ctx.db.query("edges").withIndex("by_userId_deletedAt", (q) => q.eq("userId", user._id).eq("deletedAt", undefined)).take(GUESS_SCAN)`; keep `origin === "inferred" && confirmedAt === undefined && deletedAt === undefined`; for each, load both entities with `ctx.db.get` and skip the edge when either is missing, has `deletedAt`, or has `userId !== user._id`; `sourceNoteTitle` = the title of `ctx.db.get(sourceNoteId)` when that note exists, is the caller's and has no `deletedAt` (otherwise the key is absent); sort `createdAt` descending; return the first `GUESS_MAX`.   **Test helpers** (declared at the top of the new `describe`; `import { makeFakeCtx, makeSignedOutCtx, run } from "./lib/testFakeCtx";` and the CONVENTIONS §16 `rejection` helper, reused if the file already has it):
  ```ts
  const seedEntity = (ctx: any, userId: string, name: string, kind: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
    ctx.db.insert("entities", { userId, kind, name, aliases: [], createdAt: 1, updatedAt: 1, ...extra });

### TFV2-0229 — Memory: `memory.touch` (a recalled memory gets stronger)
- **STATUS:** approved-unsent
- **Stage:** C · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** TFV2-0171, TFV2-0173, TFV2-0195b · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** after TFV2-0171, TFV2-0173, TFV2-0195b.
- **WHY:** `memories.accessCount` / `lastAccessed` / `salience` (using a memory strengthens it; the opposite of TFV2-0195a's decay); PRD F-50. The old ticket depended on the merged recall TFV2-0177, which is OPEN (Q-14/Q-12); this one works with the buildable keyword recall `memory.recall` (TFV2-0173). `recall` is a `query` and cannot write, so the bump is a separate mutation that whoever shows recalled memories (the coach, the memory screen, TFV2-0177 later) calls with the ids it used; wiring those callers belongs to their own tickets. It is a public mutation with `requireUser` so both a client and an action (through `ctx.runMutation(api.memory.touch, …)` with the person's identity) can call it, and it only ever touches the caller's own live rows. The legacy `memories.updateSalience` (`convex/memories.ts`) is not reused: it also bumps `updatedAt`, which orders lists. TFV2-0195b is in `Depends` because it is the last earlier approved ticket appending to `convex/memory.test.ts` (its chain is TFV2-0195a → TFV2-0171, TFV2-0172, TFV2-0173, TFV2-0175, TFV2-0176, TFV2-0178, TFV2-0182), so the file total is fixed; the OPEN adders (TFV2-0174b–d, 0177, 0179–0181b, 0183a–c, 0184a–b) are not built.
- **GOAL:** `memory.touch` (mutation) sets `lastAccessed` to now, adds 1 to `accessCount` and raises `salience` by 0.02 (capped at 1.0) for each distinct live memory of the caller among up to 200 given ids, and returns how many it touched.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/memory.ts` · test: `convex/memory.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `convex/memory.ts` (edit: add `TOUCH_BUMP`, `touch`) · `convex/memory.test.ts` (edit: append one `describe` block) · `memories` rows (patch `lastAccessed`, `accessCount`, `salience`).
- **STEPS:** 1) Code-map check: read `MAX_LIMIT` (line 42, `const MAX_LIMIT = 200;`), `remember` and `recall` (lines 87–130) in `convex/memory.ts`; `grep -cE '^\s*(test|it)\(' convex/memory.test.ts` → `59` (6 + 6 + 6 + 11 + 8 + 8 + 6 + 5 + 3 from TFV2-0171, 0172, 0173, 0175, 0176, 0178, 0182, 0195a, 0195b; the file is absent on `integration`); `grep -n "async function rejection" convex/memory.test.ts` (reuse it if found). 2) Add `TOUCH_BUMP` and `touch` as written in SPEC. 3) Append `describe("memory.touch", …)` with the SPEC helper and the 7 TESTS cases (`Date.now` spied to `5000`). 4) Run DONE.

  export const TOUCH_BUMP = 0.02;
  export const touch = mutation({
    args: { memoryIds: v.array(v.id("memories")) },
    returns: v.object({ touched: v.number() }),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { memoryIds: Id<"memories">[] }): Promise<{ touched: number }> => { … },
  });
  ```
  `requireUser`; `memoryIds.length > MAX_LIMIT` (200) → `new Error("Touch up to 200 memories at a time.")`; for each distinct id: row missing, foreign or deleted → skip; else `patch(id, { lastAccessed: now, accessCount: row.accessCount + 1, salience: Math.min(1, row.salience + TOUCH_BUMP) })`, `touched += 1`. Errors: `"Not authenticated"`, `"Touch up to 200 memories at a time."`. Type imports: line 2 becomes `import type { Doc, Id } from "./_generated/dataModel";` and line 4 becomes `import type { MutationCtx, QueryCtx } from "./_generated/server";` (keep any name an earlier ticket already added to those lines).

  ```ts
  export const TEMPLATE_LIST_MAX = 200;
  async function listMine(ctx: QueryCtx | MutationCtx, userId: Id<"users">): Promise<Doc<"templates">[]> {
    const rows = await ctx.db
      .query("templates")
      .withIndex("by_userId_deletedAt", (q) => q.eq("userId", userId).eq("deletedAt", undefined))
      .take(TEMPLATE_LIST_MAX);
    return rows.filter((row) => row.deletedAt === undefined && row.status !== "draft").sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt);
  }
  // list (unchanged signature): query({ scope?: "all" | "starter" | "mine" }) → TemplateView[]
  ```

  ```ts
  export const restore = mutation({
    args: { templateId: v.id("templates") },
    returns: v.null(),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { templateId: Id<"templates"> }): Promise<null> => {
      const user = await requireUser(ctx);
      if (isStarterTemplateId(args.templateId)) throw new Error("Starter templates cannot be changed");
      const doc = await ctx.db.get(args.templateId);
      if (!doc) throw new Error("Template not found");
      if (doc.userId !== user._id) throw new Error("Access denied");
      if (doc.deletedAt === undefined) return null;
      await ctx.db.patch(doc._id, { deletedAt: undefined, updatedAt: Date.now() });
      return null;
    },
  });
  ```

  export const COPY_SUFFIX = " (copy)";

    args: { templateId: v.string() },
    returns: v.id("templates"),

        updatedAt: now,
      });
    },
  });

  ```ts
  export const RUN_ANSWER_MAX = 4000;
  /**
   * Walks body line by line (split on "\n"). A line matching /^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*$/ whose trimmed heading text is a key of
   * `answers` with a non-blank trimmed value is kept and followed by that value (trimmed, "\r\n" → "\n"); only the first
   * heading with that text is filled. Every other line is copied as it was. Lines are joined with "\n".
   */
  export function fillSectionAnswers(body: string, answers: Record<string, string>): string;
  export const apply = mutation({
    args: { templateId: v.string(), answers: v.record(v.string(), v.string()), title: v.optional(v.string()) },
    returns: v.id("notes"),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { templateId: string; answers: Record<string, string>; title?: string }): Promise<Id<"notes">> => { … },
  });
  ```
  Handler order: `requireUser` → `resolveTemplate(ctx, user._id, args.templateId)` → for each key of `answers`: not in `sectionsFromBody(template.body)` → throw; value longer than `RUN_ANSWER_MAX` UTF-16 units → throw → `body = fillSectionAnswers(template.body, args.answers)`; `body.length > PERIOD_BODY_MAX` → throw → insert `{ userId, title: args.title?.trim() || template.name, body, pinned: false, periodType: template.periodType, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }`.
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Not authenticated"` → signed out; `"Template not found"` / `"Access denied"` → from `resolveTemplate` (unknown or deleted / another user's row); `"Step not found"` → an answers key that is not a heading of the template; `"Answer is too long"` → an answer over 4,000 characters; `"Page body is too long"` → the filled body over 100,000 characters.   export const saveRunDraft = mutation({
    args: { templateId: v.string(), step: v.string(), answer: v.string() },

- **GOAL:** A pure helper splits a template body into a head and `## ` blocks and joins it back byte for byte, and a new mutation `templates.insertBlock` adds one empty `## <heading>` block at a given position in the caller's own template.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lib/templateBlocks.ts` · `convex/templates.ts` · test: `convex/templates.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `convex/lib/templateBlocks.ts` (new) · `convex/templates.ts` (edit: new exports `MAX_TEMPLATE_BLOCKS`, `insertBlock`; new private helper `editableTemplate`) · `convex/templates.test.ts` (edit: one new `describe` block) · `templates.body`, `templates.updatedAt` (patch).
- **STEPS:**

  2. Create `convex/lib/templateBlocks.ts` with `TemplateBlocks`, `splitBlocks`, `joinBlocks` as the SPEC states.
  3. In `convex/templates.ts` add `MAX_TEMPLATE_BLOCKS`, `editableTemplate` and `insertBlock` as the SPEC states.
  4. Append `describe("insertBlock (TFV2-0240a)", …)` with the 7 TESTS cases (shared fake; helper cases call the helper directly).
  5. Run DONE.
- **DONE:** `bun test convex/templates.test.ts` → `0 fail`, the 7 new cases passing.
- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test convex/templates.test.ts` pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** render blocks; call a model; touch `convex/notes.ts`, `convex/lib/blocks.ts` or `convex/schema.ts`; change starter bodies.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0240a / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: convex/lib/templateBlocks.ts, convex/templates.ts, convex/templates.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; list STEPS 1–5 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // convex/lib/templateBlocks.ts — pure, no Convex imports
  export type TemplateBlocks = { head: string; blocks: string[] };
  /** head = every line before the first line that starts with "## "; each block = one "## " line plus the lines after it up to the next "## " line. Line endings are kept, so joinBlocks(splitBlocks(b)) === b for every string b. */
  export function splitBlocks(body: string): TemplateBlocks;
  /** head + blocks.join(""), after appending "\n" to head (when non-empty) or to any block that does not end with "\n" and is followed by another block. */
  export function joinBlocks(parts: TemplateBlocks): string;

  // convex/templates.ts
  export const MAX_TEMPLATE_BLOCKS = 50;
  /** starter id → "Starter templates cannot be changed"; else ownedTemplate (→ "Template not found" / "Access denied"). */
  async function editableTemplate(ctx: MutationCtx, userId: Id<"users">, templateId: Id<"templates">): Promise<Doc<"templates">>;
  export const insertBlock = mutation({
    args: { templateId: v.id("templates"), afterIndex: v.number(), heading: v.string() },
    returns: v.null(),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { templateId: Id<"templates">; afterIndex: number; heading: string }): Promise<null> => { … },
  });
  ```
  `insertBlock`: `heading` has every whitespace run replaced by one space, then is trimmed; the new block is `"## <heading>\n"`; `afterIndex: -1` puts it first, `afterIndex: i` puts it after block `i`; patch `{ body: joinBlocks(next), updatedAt: now }`.
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Not authenticated"`; `"Starter templates cannot be changed"` → starter id; `"Template not found"` → missing or deleted row; `"Access denied"` → another user's row; `"Heading is required"` → heading blank after cleaning; `"Invalid index"` → `afterIndex` not an integer in `[-1, blocks.length - 1]`; `"Too many blocks"` → the template already has 50 blocks. No user-facing copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given body `"# Brief\n\n## Goal\nWhy\n## Steps\n- a\n"` / When `splitBlocks` runs / Then it returns `{ head: "# Brief\n\n", blocks: ["## Goal\nWhy\n", "## Steps\n- a\n"] }`, and `joinBlocks` of that returns the same body.
  2. Given an owned row with that body / When `insertBlock({ templateId, afterIndex: 0, heading: "  Risks   now " })` runs / Then the body is `"# Brief\n\n## Goal\nWhy\n## Risks now\n## Steps\n- a\n"`.
  3. Given the same row / When `afterIndex: -1` / Then the first block is `"## <heading>\n"` right after the head.
  4. Given `afterIndex: 2` (only 2 blocks) or `0.5` / When it runs / Then it rejects with `"Invalid index"`; given `heading: "   "` / Then `"Heading is required"`.
  5. Given a row with 50 blocks / When it runs / Then it rejects with `"Too many blocks"`.
  6. Given a row of user B / When user A runs it / Then `"Access denied"`; given `"starter:daily-page"` / Then `"Starter templates cannot be changed"`; given a deleted row / Then `"Template not found"`.
  7. Given `makeSignedOutCtx()` / When it runs / Then it rejects with `"Not authenticated"`.
- **NUMBERS:** at most 50 blocks per template (`MAX_TEMPLATE_BLOCKS`, tested at 50); split/join round trip exact; 7 of 7 cases pass. Latency: UNKNOWN (no baseline).
- **GATES:** n/a — OPEN (not buildable until Amit answers).
- **OPEN:** new: Are template-builder blocks the `## ` sections of `templates.body`, addressed by 0-based index (this SPEC), or `json tempo` fenced blocks with stable ids? — Amit.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const TEMPLATE_OUTLINE_MAX = 2000;
  export const PROPOSE_TEMPLATE_SYSTEM =
    'You turn a person\'s outline into one reusable Markdown page template. Reply with JSON only: {"name": string, "period": "daily" | "weekly" | "none", "body": string}. The body uses "## " headings, one per step, and may use the tokens {{date}} and {{weekday}}. No links, no code, no HTML.';
  export type TemplateProposal = Extract<CoachProposal, { kind: "template" }>;
  export type CallModel = (opts: AiCallOptions) => Promise<{ content: string }>;
  /** Throws on a blank or too-long outline; otherwise one callModel call, then JSON.parse (failure → null), then readProposal({ ...parsed, kind: "template" }). */
  export async function proposeTemplateFrom(callModel: CallModel, outline: string): Promise<TemplateProposal | null>;
  export const proposeTemplate = action({
    args: { outline: v.string() },
    returns: v.union(v.object({ kind: v.literal("template"), name: v.string(), body: v.string(), period: v.union(v.literal("daily"), v.literal("weekly"), v.literal("none")) }), v.null()),
    handler: async (ctx: ActionCtx, args: { outline: string }): Promise<TemplateProposal | null> => {
      await requireApprovedForAi(ctx);
      return proposeTemplateFrom(callLLM, args.outline);
    },
  });
  ```
  The model call is `{ tier: "fast", messages: [{ role: "system", content: PROPOSE_TEMPLATE_SYSTEM }, { role: "user", content: outline.trim() }], responseFormat: "json_object", maxTokens: 1200, temperature: 0.3 }`. Errors (exact → trigger): `"Outline is required"` → outline blank after trim; `"Outline is too long"` → outline over 2,000 characters; `"Not authenticated"` / `"User not found"` / the pending-approval message → from `requireApprovedForAi` (runs `internal.approval.assertApprovedForAi`); model errors (`AiAuthError`, `AiContextTooLargeError`, `AiRateLimitedError`, `AiUpstreamError` from `convex/lib/ai_errors.ts`) propagate unchanged and are not tested here (no network in tests); `"User not found"` and the pending-approval message also come from `requireApprovedForAi` unchanged, which this ticket tests once through its `"Not authenticated"` path (case 7). Model JSON that is not an object, or fails `readProposal` → `null`. No user-facing copy (the system prompt is sent to the runtime model, not shown).
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given a stub returning `{ content: JSON.stringify({ name: "Morning check", period: "daily", body: "## Sleep\n## Mood" }) }` / When `proposeTemplateFrom(stub, "sleep, mood")` runs / Then it returns `{ kind: "template", name: "Morning check", body: "## Sleep\n## Mood", period: "daily" }`, and the stub got exactly one call whose `messages[0].content` equals `PROPOSE_TEMPLATE_SYSTEM` and `messages[1].content` equals `"sleep, mood"`.
  2. Given a stub returning `{ content: "not json" }` / When it runs / Then it returns `null`.
  3. Given a stub returning `{ content: JSON.stringify({ name: "", period: "daily", body: "## A" }) }` / When it runs / Then it returns `null`.
  4. Given outline `"   "` / When it runs / Then it rejects with `"Outline is required"` and the stub was never called.
  5. Given an outline of exactly 2,000 characters (`"a".repeat(2000)`) and the stub of case 3 / When it runs / Then it resolves `null` and the stub got exactly one call.
  6. Given an outline of 2,001 characters (`"a".repeat(2001)`) / When it runs / Then it rejects with `"Outline is too long"` and the stub was never called.
  7. Given a ctx `{ runQuery: async () => { throw new Error("Not authenticated"); } }` / When `run(templates.proposeTemplate, ctx, { outline: "x" })` runs / Then `await rejection(run(templates.proposeTemplate, ctx, { outline: "x" }))` equals `"Not authenticated"` (the standard `rejection` helper of CONVENTIONS §16, declared once at the top of `convex/templates.test.ts` unless `grep -n "async function rejection" convex/templates.test.ts` finds it; `run` from `./lib/testFakeCtx`, imported unless already imported).

- **STATUS:** approved-unsent

Which list a view module uses is decided by its caller (TFV2-0243, OPEN), so this validator takes the allowed names as an argument and needs no answer.
- **GOAL:** A pure function `validateViewSpec(spec, catalog)` returns every problem in a spec: unknown component types, unknown actions, forbidden strings (links, scripts), a non-object root, or a spec that is too large.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lib/moduleValidation.ts` · test: `convex/lib/moduleValidation.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `convex/lib/moduleValidation.ts` (new) · `convex/lib/moduleValidation.test.ts` (new). No table written.
- **STEPS:**
  1. Code-map check: `ls convex/lib/moduleValidation.ts` → missing.
  2. Create `convex/lib/moduleValidation.ts` as the SPEC states (no imports from React, Convex or `@tempo/ui`; no Zod).

  4. Run DONE.

- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test convex/lib/moduleValidation.test.ts` pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** execute, `eval` or render the spec; import React or `packages/ui`; hard-code a catalog list in this file; touch `convex/schema.ts`.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0242 / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: convex/lib/moduleValidation.ts, convex/lib/moduleValidation.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; list STEPS 1–4 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type ViewCatalog = { components: readonly string[]; actions: readonly string[] };
  export type ViewValidation = { ok: boolean; problems: string[] };
  export const VIEW_SPEC_LIMITS = { maxNodes: 500, maxDepth: 20 } as const;
  export const FORBIDDEN_STRING = /https?:\/\/|javascript:|<script|\beval\s*\(/i;
  /**
   * Walks the spec depth-first (object keys in insertion order, then array items). Problems, in walk order:
   * - "not-an-object" when spec is not a plain object (null, an array, a string, a number, a boolean or undefined), and nothing else is checked;
   * - an object's own "unknown-component"/"unknown-action" problems are added when the object is visited, before its children;
   * - "unknown-component:<value>" for every object with a string "type" not in catalog.components;
   * - "unknown-action:<value>" for every object with a string "action" not in catalog.actions;
   * - "forbidden-string:<path>" for every string value matching FORBIDDEN_STRING, path = keys/indexes joined by "." from the root;
   * - "too-large" once, and the walk stops, when more than maxNodes values or a depth over maxDepth is reached.
   *   Every visited value is one node (the root, each object, each array, each leaf); the root has depth 0 and a value inside a depth-d object or array has depth d + 1.
   * ok === (problems.length === 0).
   */
  export function validateViewSpec(spec: unknown, catalog: ViewCatalog): ViewValidation;
  ```
  Pure; throws nothing. Problems are codes for the UI to map, not user-facing copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `{ root: "a", elements: { a: { type: "TaskBlock", props: {} } } }` and catalog `{ components: ["TaskBlock"], actions: ["setTaskDone"] }` / When validated / Then `{ ok: true, problems: [] }`.
  2. Given `{ root: "a", elements: { a: { type: "Iframe" } } }` and the case-1 catalog / Then `problems` equals `["unknown-component:Iframe"]`.
  3. Given `{ root: "a", elements: { a: { type: "TaskBlock", on: { toggle: { action: "deleteAll" } } } } }` and the case-1 catalog / Then `problems` equals `["unknown-action:deleteAll"]`.
  4. Given `{ root: "a", elements: { a: { type: "TaskBlock", props: { label: "see https://x.y" } } } }` and the case-1 catalog / Then `problems` equals `["forbidden-string:elements.a.props.label"]`; given `{ a: "<SCRIPT>" }` / Then `["forbidden-string:a"]`; given `{ b: "eval (1)" }` / Then `["forbidden-string:b"]`.
  5. Given `null`, `[]` and `"x"` / Then each returns `{ ok: false, problems: ["not-an-object"] }`.
  6. Given `nest(n)` built in the test by `let v: unknown = "x"; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) v = { a: v };` (its string leaf sits at depth n) and the case-1 catalog / Then `nest(20)` gives `{ ok: true, problems: [] }` and `nest(21)` gives `problems` equal to `["too-large"]`; given `Object.fromEntries(Array.from({ length: k }, (_, i) => ["k" + i, i]))` (k number leaves plus the root = k + 1 nodes) / Then k = 499 (500 nodes) gives `{ ok: true, problems: [] }` and k = 500 (501 nodes) gives `problems` equal to `["too-large"]`.
  7. Given `{ elements: { a: { type: "X" }, b: { type: "Y", props: { label: "javascript:go" } } } }` and the case-1 catalog / Then `problems` equals `["unknown-component:X", "unknown-component:Y", "forbidden-string:elements.b.props.label"]` and `ok` is `false`.
- **NUMBERS:** at most 500 nodes and depth 20 (`VIEW_SPEC_LIMITS`, tested at 500 and 501 nodes, depth 20 and 21); 7 of 7 cases pass. Latency: n/a (pure).
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (~typesafe/jev-latest): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS = 30_000; // proposed; Amit to confirm (OPEN)
  export type SandboxResult = { stdout: string; stderr: string; timedOut: boolean };
  export type SandboxDeps = { create: () => Promise<{ run: (code: string, timeoutMs: number) => Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string }>; stop: () => Promise<void> }> };
  /** Throws "Invalid timeout" unless 1 ≤ timeoutMs ≤ SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS; creates a fresh sandbox, races run() against timeoutMs, always calls stop(). */
  export async function runInSandbox(args: { code: string; timeoutMs: number }, deps: SandboxDeps): Promise<SandboxResult>;
  export function defaultSandboxDeps(): SandboxDeps; // wraps @vercel/sandbox (CFG-039)
  ```
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Invalid timeout"` → `timeoutMs` outside `[1, 30000]`; a `create` failure propagates unchanged. Timeout → `{ stdout: "", stderr: "", timedOut: true }`. No user-facing copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given a stub whose `run` resolves `{ stdout: "hi\n", stderr: "" }` / When `runInSandbox({ code: "print('hi')", timeoutMs: 1000 }, stub)` runs / Then `{ stdout: "hi\n", stderr: "", timedOut: false }` and `stop` was called once.
  2. Given a `run` that never resolves / When `timeoutMs: 50` / Then `timedOut: true` and `stop` was called once.
  3. Given `timeoutMs: 0` or `30001` / Then it rejects with `"Invalid timeout"` and `create` was never called.
  4. Given two calls / Then `create` was called twice (a fresh sandbox per run).
- **NUMBERS:** run timeout ≤ 30,000 ms (proposed, UNKNOWN until Amit answers; source TRD §1); 4 of 4 cases pass. Sandbox latency and price: UNKNOWN (Vercel Sandbox limits not decided).

  ```ts
  export type ModuleProblem = "link" | "script" | "tempo-block";
  /** "link" when /https?:\/\//i matches, "script" when /<script/i matches, "tempo-block" when body.includes("\x60\x60\x60json tempo") (three backticks then "json tempo"); in that order, each at most once. */
  export function validateModuleBody(body: string): { ok: boolean; problems: ModuleProblem[] };
  /** Row must exist, belong to userId, have no deletedAt (else "Module not found") and have status "draft" (else "Not a draft"). */
  async function ownedDraft(ctx: QueryCtx | MutationCtx, userId: Id<"users">, templateId: Id<"templates">): Promise<Doc<"templates">>;
  export const getDraft = query({
    args: { templateId: v.id("templates") },
    returns: v.object({ templateId: v.id("templates"), name: v.string(), summary: v.string(), body: v.string(), validation: v.object({ ok: v.boolean(), problems: v.array(v.union(v.literal("link"), v.literal("script"), v.literal("tempo-block"))) }) }),
    handler: async (ctx: QueryCtx, args: { templateId: Id<"templates"> }) => { … },
  });
  ```
  `summary` returned = `row.summary ?? row.description ?? ""`. Errors (exact → trigger): `"Not authenticated"`; `"Module not found"` → missing, deleted or another user's row (new module, CONVENTIONS §16 noun); `"Not a draft"` → `status` is not `"draft"`. Problems are codes the screen maps to copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given body `"## Sleep\n## Mood"` / When `validateModuleBody` runs / Then `{ ok: true, problems: [] }`; given a body with `"https://a.b"`, `"<script>"` and a `"\x60\x60\x60json tempo"` fence (three backticks then `json tempo`) / Then `problems` equals `["link", "script", "tempo-block"]`.
  2. Given an owned row with `status: "draft"`, `name: "Morning"`, `summary: "Sleep · Mood"` / When `getDraft` runs / Then it returns those fields with `validation: { ok: true, problems: [] }`.
  3. Given an owned row with `status: "live"` / Then it rejects with `"Not a draft"`.
  4. Given a draft of user B / When user A runs it / Then it rejects with `"Module not found"`.
  5. Given a draft with `deletedAt: 5` / Then it rejects with `"Module not found"`.
  6. Given `makeSignedOutCtx()` / Then it rejects with `"Not authenticated"`.

### TFV2-0250a — Scheduled jobs: cron check `isFiveFieldCron` (`convex/lib/cronSpec.ts`)
- **STATUS:** approved-unsent
- **Stage:** D · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** none · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** first.
- **WHY:** PRD F-47; TRD §5d (jobs are 5-field cron strings in UTC; CFG-012 `jobs.cron`). The same check is written inside the coach tool TFV2-0161, which is OPEN (Q-12); `jobs.scheduleJob` (TFV2-0250b) needs it now, so it lives in its own pure helper.
- **GOAL:** A pure function `isFiveFieldCron` says whether a string is exactly five valid POSIX cron fields.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lib/cronSpec.ts` · test: `convex/lib/cronSpec.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `convex/lib/cronSpec.ts` (new) · `convex/lib/cronSpec.test.ts` (new). No table written.
- **STEPS:**
  1. Code-map check: `ls convex/lib/cronSpec.ts` → missing.
  2. Create `convex/lib/cronSpec.ts` as the SPEC states.
  3. Create the test with the 5 TESTS cases.
  4. Run DONE.
- **DONE:** `bun test convex/lib/cronSpec.test.ts` → `5 pass`, `0 fail`.
- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test convex/lib/cronSpec.test.ts` pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** accept 6-field (seconds) crons, `L`, `?`, `#` or names (`MON`, `JAN`); import anything.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0250a / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: convex/lib/cronSpec.ts, convex/lib/cronSpec.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; list STEPS 1–4 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  /** One field: "*", a number, or a range "a-b", each optionally "/step"; comma lists of those. Digits and * , - / only. */
  export const CRON_FIELD = /^(\*|\d+(-\d+)?)(\/\d+)?(,(\*|\d+(-\d+)?)(\/\d+)?)*$/;
  export const CRON_RANGES = [[0, 59], [0, 23], [1, 31], [1, 12], [0, 6]] as const;
  /** True when cron.trim() split on /\s+/ has exactly 5 fields, each matches CRON_FIELD, every number before "/" lies in its CRON_RANGES pair, every range has a ≤ b, and every step is ≥ 1. */
  export function isFiveFieldCron(cron: string): boolean;
  ```
  Pure; throws nothing; no user-facing copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `"0 6 * * 1-5"`, `"*/15 * * * *"`, `"0 9,17 1 1 0"` / Then each is `true`.
  2. Given `"0 6 * *"` (4 fields) and `"0 0 6 * * 1"` (6 fields) / Then `false`.
  3. Given `"60 6 * * *"`, `"0 24 * * *"`, `"0 0 0 * *"`, `"0 0 * 13 *"`, `"0 0 * * 7"` / Then each is `false`.
  4. Given `"5-1 * * * *"` and `"*/0 * * * *"` / Then `false`.
  5. Given `"every day"`, `"0 6 * * MON"` and `""` / Then `false`.
- **NUMBERS:** field ranges minute 0–59, hour 0–23, day 1–31, month 1–12, weekday 0–6 (POSIX `crontab`, https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9799919799/utilities/crontab.html); 5 of 5 cases pass. Latency: n/a (pure).
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (~typesafe/jev-latest): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

  export const JOB_OUTPUT_MAX = 8000;
  export const recordRun = internalMutation({
    args: { jobId: v.id("jobs"), result: v.union(v.literal("ok"), v.literal("didnt_finish")), output: v.optional(v.string()), now: v.number() },
    returns: v.null(),

  });

  Missing or deleted job → return `null`. `didnt_finish` (or blank output) → patch the job `{ lastRunAt: now, lastRunResult: "didnt_finish", updatedAt: now }` only. `ok`: `date = localDateKey(now, job.timeZone)`; `section = "\n\n## " + job.task + " · " + date + "\n" + output.trim().slice(0, JOB_OUTPUT_MAX) + "\n"`; target = for `daily` the live daily page of `date`, for `weekly` the live weekly page of that date's ISO Monday, when it exists; otherwise (and always for `project`/`plain`) the live note `job.lastRunNoteId` owned by the job's user, else a new note `{ userId, title: job.task, body: "# " + job.task + "\n", pinned: false, periodType: "none", pageType: "plain", aiGenerated: true, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }`; patch the target `{ body: body + section, updatedAt: now }`; patch the job `{ lastRunAt: now, lastRunResult: "ok", lastRunNoteId: targetId, updatedAt: now }`. No errors thrown; the section heading is the person's task text plus a date (no fixed copy).

  2. Given a `daily` job and no daily page / Then a new plain note titled with the task holds the section and becomes `lastRunNoteId`; a second run appends to that same note.
  3. Given a `project` job / Then the section goes to the job's plain note, never a daily page.
  4. Given `result: "didnt_finish"` / Then no `notes` row changes and the job has `lastRunResult: "didnt_finish"`.
  5. Given an output of 9,000 characters / Then the appended text holds exactly 8,000 characters of output.

  3. At the top of `convex/jobs.test.ts`, add `mock.module("@convex-dev/crons", () => ({ Crons: FakeCrons }))` where `FakeCrons` records `register`/`get`/`delete` calls in an exported-to-test array and keeps a name set; then add the 4 TESTS cases.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export function jobCronName(jobId: Id<"jobs">): string { return `job:${jobId}`; }
  export const syncCron = internalMutation({
    args: { jobId: v.id("jobs") },
    returns: v.null(),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { jobId: Id<"jobs"> }): Promise<null> => {
      const crons = new Crons(components.crons);
      const name = jobCronName(args.jobId);
      if ((await crons.get(ctx, { name })) !== null) await crons.delete(ctx, { name });
      const job = await ctx.db.get(args.jobId);
      if (job && job.deletedAt === undefined && job.enabled && job.approvedAt !== undefined) {
        await crons.register(ctx, { kind: "cron", cronspec: job.cron }, internal.jobs.runJob, { jobId: args.jobId }, name);
      }
      return null;
    },
  });
  ```
  No auth (internal). Errors from the component propagate unchanged. No user-facing copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given an enabled approved job and no cron / When `syncCron` runs / Then one `register` call with `{ kind: "cron", cronspec: <job.cron> }`, args `{ jobId }` and name `"job:<jobId>"`.
  2. Given a registered cron for the job and `enabled: false` / Then one `delete` with `{ name: "job:<jobId>" }` and no `register`.
  3. Given a registered cron and an enabled job / Then `delete` then `register`, in that order (the cron string is refreshed).
  4. Given an id with no row and no cron / Then neither `delete` nor `register` is called.
- **NUMBERS:** at most 1 cron per job (cases 1–3); 30 of 30 file cases pass. Latency: UNKNOWN (no baseline).

  /** A plain object: typeof value is "object", value is not null and not an array. */
  type PlainObject = Record<string, unknown>;
  function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is PlainObject {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
  }
  export type Artifact =
    | { kind: "flashcard"; data: FlashcardData }
    | { kind: "quiz"; data: QuizData }
    | { kind: "checklist"; data: ChecklistData }
    | { kind: "tracker"; data: TrackerData };
  /** isPlainObject(spec) false → ["not-an-object"]; kind not one of the four → ["unknown-kind"]; else the kind's parser on spec.data, wrapping its value as { kind, data }. */
  export function makeArtifact(spec: unknown): Parsed<Artifact>;
  ```

Responses (exact status → body → trigger): `503` → `"Webhook not configured"` → env `REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` unset; `401` → `"Unauthorized"` → `Authorization` header not equal to the secret; `400` → `"Invalid JSON body"` → body not JSON; `400` → `"Missing event field"` → no `event`; `200` → `{"received":true,"eventType":<type>}` otherwise, also when `runMutation` throws (RevenueCat must not retry our errors). With `event.app_user_id` it calls `internal.users.updateSubscriptionStatus` with `{ userId: app_user_id, userType: mapRevenueCatEventToUserType(type), activeEntitlements: entitlement_ids ?? [], revenueCatEvent: type ?? "UNKNOWN" }`.
  **Relies on:** `run(fn, ctx, args)` from `./lib/testFakeCtx` (line 74; calls `fn._handler(ctx, args)`) · `mapRevenueCatEventToUserType(eventType: string | undefined): RevenueCatUserType` from `./lib/revenuecat_events` (line 20): `"paid"` for `INITIAL_PURCHASE`, `RENEWAL`, `PRODUCT_CHANGE`, `UNCANCELLATION`; `"free"` otherwise and when `undefined`.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given the secret unset / When a POST with body `{}` runs / Then status `503` and text `"Webhook not configured"`.
  2. Given the secret set and header `Authorization: wrong` with body `{}` / Then `401` and `"Unauthorized"`; `runMutation` not called.
  3. Given the right header and body `"not json"` / Then `400` and `"Invalid JSON body"`.
  4. Given the right header and body `{}` / Then `400` and `"Missing event field"`.
  5. Given `{ event: { type: "INITIAL_PURCHASE", app_user_id: "a@b.co", entitlement_ids: ["pro"] } }` / Then `200`, JSON `{ received: true, eventType: "INITIAL_PURCHASE" }`, and one call with `{ userId: "a@b.co", userType: "paid", activeEntitlements: ["pro"], revenueCatEvent: "INITIAL_PURCHASE" }`.
  6. Given `{ event: { type: "EXPIRATION" } }` (no `app_user_id`) / Then `200`, JSON `{ received: true, eventType: "EXPIRATION" }`, and `runMutation` not called.
  7. Given a `runMutation` that throws `new Error("boom")` and body `{ event: { type: "RENEWAL", app_user_id: "a@b.co" } }` / Then status `200` and JSON `{ received: true, eventType: "RENEWAL" }`.

- **STATUS:** approved-unsent

- **WHY:** PRD F-110 ("notices at 3 days, 1 day and 1 hour before conversion"). The timing rule is pure and needs no stored field.
- **GOAL:** A pure function returns the one notice that is due now (the most urgent threshold crossed and not yet sent), or `null`.
- **SCOPE:** `convex/lib/trialNotices.ts` · test: `convex/lib/trialNotices.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `convex/lib/trialNotices.ts` (new) · `convex/lib/trialNotices.test.ts` (new). No table written.
- **STEPS:**
  1. Code-map check: `ls convex/lib/trialNotices.ts` → missing.
  2. Create the file as the SPEC states.
  3. Create the test with the 5 TESTS cases.
  4. Run DONE.
- **DONE:** `bun test convex/lib/trialNotices.test.ts` → `5 pass`, `0 fail`.
- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test convex/lib/trialNotices.test.ts` pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** send anything; read the clock (`now` is an argument); import Convex.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0264a / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: convex/lib/trialNotices.ts, convex/lib/trialNotices.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; list STEPS 1–4 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type TrialNotice = "3d" | "1d" | "1h";
  export const TRIAL_NOTICE_MS: Record<TrialNotice, number> = { "3d": 72 * 3_600_000, "1d": 24 * 3_600_000, "1h": 3_600_000 };
  /** left = trialEndsAt - now; left <= 0 → null; t = the first of "1h", "1d", "3d" (in that order) with left <= TRIAL_NOTICE_MS[t]; no such t → null; t in sent → null; else t. So a larger threshold is never sent after a smaller one was sent or is due. */
  export function nextTrialNotice(args: { now: number; trialEndsAt: number; sent: readonly TrialNotice[] }): TrialNotice | null;
  ```
  Rule in words: send at most one notice per check, the most urgent one crossed; once `"1h"` is due, `"1d"` and `"3d"` are skipped. Pure; throws nothing.
- **TESTS:** every case passes `now = 1_793_577_600_000` and `trialEndsAt = now + h * 3_600_000` for the stated `h` hours left (72 h → `1_793_836_800_000`, 73 h → `1_793_840_400_000`); 0 ms left is `trialEndsAt = now`; "the end in the past" is `trialEndsAt = now - 1`.
  1. Given 72 h left and `sent: []` / Then `"3d"`; given 73 h left / Then `null`.
  2. Given 24 h left and `sent: ["3d"]` / Then `"1d"`.
  3. Given 1 h left and `sent: ["3d", "1d"]` / Then `"1h"`; given 1 h left and `sent: []` / Then `"1h"`.
  4. Given 25 h left and `sent: ["3d"]` / Then `null`; given 2 h left and `sent: ["3d", "1d"]` / Then `null`; given 20 h left and `sent: ["1d"]` / Then `null` (the `"3d"` notice is skipped once `"1d"` was sent).
  5. Given 0 ms left or the end in the past / Then `null`.
- **NUMBERS:** thresholds 72 h / 24 h / 1 h (PRD F-110, exact; each tested at its threshold and one hour past it: 72/73, 24/25, 1/2); 5 of 5 cases pass. Latency: n/a (pure).
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (~typesafe/jev-latest): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.

  ```ts
  export const TRIAL_SCAN_MAX = 200;
  export const TRIAL_NOTICE_COPY: Record<TrialNotice, { en: { title: string; body: string }; he: { title: string; body: string } }> = {
    "3d": { en: { title: "Your trial ends in 3 days", body: TRIAL_BODY_EN }, he: { title: "תקופת הניסיון מסתיימת בעוד 3 ימים", body: TRIAL_BODY_HE } },
    "1d": { en: { title: "Your trial ends tomorrow", body: TRIAL_BODY_EN }, he: { title: "תקופת הניסיון מסתיימת מחר", body: TRIAL_BODY_HE } },
    "1h": { en: { title: "Your trial ends in an hour", body: TRIAL_BODY_EN }, he: { title: "תקופת הניסיון מסתיימת בעוד שעה", body: TRIAL_BODY_HE } },
  };
  const TRIAL_BODY_EN = "After that your plan starts and the first charge is made. You can cancel any time in Settings.";
  const TRIAL_BODY_HE = "אחר כך המסלול מתחיל והחיוב הראשון מתבצע. אפשר לבטל מתי שרוצים בהגדרות.";
  export const queueTrialNotices = internalMutation({
    args: { now: v.optional(v.number()) },
    returns: v.object({ queued: v.number() }),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { now?: number }): Promise<{ queued: number }> => { … },
  });

  (Declare the two body constants above `TRIAL_NOTICE_COPY`.) Handler: `now = args.now ?? Date.now()`; rows = `withIndex("by_trialEndsAt", q => q.gte("trialEndsAt", now + 1).lt("trialEndsAt", now + TRIAL_NOTICE_MS["3d"] + 1)).take(TRIAL_SCAN_MAX)`; for each row with `plan === "trial"`, `status === "active"` and `trialEndsAt` set: `notice = nextTrialNotice({ now, trialEndsAt, sent: row.trialNoticesSent ?? [] })`; when not `null`: `lang = (await preferencesFor(ctx, row.userId)).locale`; insert `notifications` `{ userId: row.userId, title, body, kind: "billing", createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }` from `TRIAL_NOTICE_COPY[notice][lang]`; patch the row `{ trialNoticesSent: [...sent, notice], updatedAt: now }`; count it.   ```ts
  /** POSTs { from, to: [to], subject: copy.title, text: copy.body } to RESEND_EMAILS_URL with "Authorization: Bearer <key>"; throws "Email is not set up" when key or from is blank, "Email was not sent" on a non-2xx status. */

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // convex/askFounder.ts
  import { v } from "convex/values";
  import type { Id } from "./_generated/dataModel";
  import { type MutationCtx, mutation } from "./_generated/server";
  import { requireUser } from "./lib/requireUser";

  export const SUBJECT_MAX_CHARS = 120;   // ask-founder.html subject input maxlength="120"
  export const BODY_MAX_CHARS = 4000;     // proposed cap; see OPEN
  export const PRIORITIES = ["low", "medium", "high"] as const;
  export type FounderPriority = (typeof PRIORITIES)[number];

  export const submit = mutation({
    args: { subject: v.string(), body: v.string(), priority: v.string() },
    returns: v.id("askFounderQueue"),
    handler: async (
      ctx: MutationCtx,
      args: { subject: string; body: string; priority: string },
    ): Promise<Id<"askFounderQueue">> => { /* rules below */ },
  });
  ```
  Rules, in this order:
  1. `const user = await requireUser(ctx);`
  2. `subject = args.subject.trim()`; `subject === ""` → `throw new Error("Subject is required")`; `[...subject].length > SUBJECT_MAX_CHARS` → `throw new Error("Subject is too long")`.
  3. `body = args.body.trim()`; `body === ""` → `throw new Error("Message is required")`; `[...body].length > BODY_MAX_CHARS` → `throw new Error("Message is too long")`.
  4. `!(PRIORITIES as readonly string[]).includes(args.priority)` → `throw new Error("Invalid priority")` (`priority` is `v.string()` so this message, not a validator error, reaches the UI).

    canToggle: boolean;                // false → no switch, an "Always on" badge instead
    onToggle: (change: { moduleId: string; on: boolean }) => void;
  };
  export function ModuleCard({ module, canToggle, onToggle }: ModuleCardProps): React.JSX.Element;

### TFV2-0274a — Pure helper: cron schedule in words (`apps/web/lib/cronText.ts`)
- **STATUS:** approved-unsent
- **Stage:** D · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** none · **Folds-in:** none
- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); web lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** first.
- **WHY:** design `docs/design/v3/screens/web/modules.html` (job schedules read "Mon–Fri 08:00", "Sun 18:00", in the person's local time); range-6 `jobs.list` (TFV2-0252a) returns `cron: string` (a UTC five-field cron) and `timeZone: string` and no schedule text ("format cron in the UI"); TRD §5d (stored in UTC, shown in the person's zone); CONVENTIONS §6 (web lib test `apps/web/lib/*.test.ts`), §12 (Hebrew day letters with geresh; numbers in LTR isolates are the caller's job). Code truth: no cron formatter exists in `apps/web/lib/` (`grep -rn "cron" apps/web/lib` finds none).
- **GOAL:** A pure function turns a UTC five-field cron plus an IANA time zone into short local schedule text in English or Hebrew, and returns `"<cron> UTC"` for any pattern it does not describe.
- **SCOPE:** `apps/web/lib/cronText.ts` · test: `apps/web/lib/cronText.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `apps/web/lib/cronText.ts` (new) · `apps/web/lib/cronText.test.ts` (new). No data.

  1. Code-map check: `test -e apps/web/lib/cronText.ts` fails (new).
  2. Create `apps/web/lib/cronText.ts` exactly as SPEC (no imports; uses only `Intl.DateTimeFormat`).
  3. Create `apps/web/lib/cronText.test.ts` (`bun:test`) with the 9 TESTS cases.
  4. Run DONE, then `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lint`.
- **DONE:** `bun test apps/web/lib/cronText.test.ts` → `9 pass`, `0 fail`.
- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test apps/web/lib/cronText.test.ts`, plus typecheck/lint exit codes, pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** add a cron library (no dependency change); read the browser clock or zone (the caller passes `nowMs` and `timeZone`); import React or Convex; touch other files.
- **REPORT:** AGENTS.md format — `status / ticket: TFV2-0274a / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: apps/web/lib/cronText.ts, apps/web/lib/cronText.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; STEPS 1–4 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type CronLang = "en" | "he";
  export const CRON_DAY_NAMES: Record<CronLang, readonly string[]> = {
    en: ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"],
    he: ["א׳", "ב׳", "ג׳", "ד׳", "ה׳", "ו׳", "ש׳"],
  };
  /** UTC five-field cron → local text at the zone offset in force at nowMs. */
  export function describeCron(cron: string, timeZone: string, lang: CronLang, nowMs: number): string;
  ```
  Algorithm:
  1. `fields = cron.trim().split(/\s+/)`; unless `fields.length === 5` → fallback. `[min, hour, dom, month, dow] = fields`. `min` must match `/^\d{1,2}$/` and be 0–59, `hour` `/^\d{1,2}$/` and 0–23, `month === "*"`; else fallback.
  2. `utc = new Date(nowMs)`; `instant = Date.UTC(utc.getUTCFullYear(), utc.getUTCMonth(), utc.getUTCDate(), hour, min)`. Local parts: `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).formatToParts(instant)`. `time = HH + ":" + mm` (two digits each). `shift` = (local calendar date − UTC calendar date of `instant`) in days, one of −1, 0, 1.
  3. `dom === "*" && dow === "*"` → daily.
  4. `dom === "*"` and `dow` matches `/^[0-7](-[0-7])?(,[0-7](-[0-7])?)*$/` → expand ranges and lists to a set of 0–6 (`7` → `0`; a range `a-b` with `a > b` → fallback); shift each day `(d + shift + 7) % 7`. Set size 7 → daily. Else sort ascending (0 = Sunday first); if the sorted days are consecutive and there are ≥ 3 → `names[first] + "–" + names[last]` (en dash U+2013); else `sorted.map((d) => names[d]).join(", ")`. Result `days + " " + time`.
  5. `dow === "*"` and `dom` matches `/^\d{1,2}$/` with value 1–28 and `shift === 0` → monthly. Anything else → fallback.
  Text: daily EN `"Every day " + time`, HE `"כל יום " + time`; weekly `days + " " + time` (both languages); monthly EN `"Day " + d + " of the month " + time`, HE `"ב־" + d + " בחודש " + time`; fallback `cron.trim() + " UTC"`. Never throws (an invalid `timeZone` makes `Intl` throw → catch → fallback).
- **TESTS:** (`const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 12, 12, 0);` — 12 Oct 2026, Israel on UTC+3, New York on UTC−4)
  1. `describeCron("0 5 * * *", "Asia/Jerusalem", "en", NOW)` → `"Every day 08:00"`; with `"he"` → `"כל יום 08:00"`.
  2. `describeCron("0 5 * * 1-5", "Asia/Jerusalem", "en", NOW)` → `"Mon–Fri 08:00"`; with `"he"` → `"ב׳–ו׳ 08:00"`.
  3. `describeCron("30 22 * * 0", "Asia/Jerusalem", "en", NOW)` → `"Mon 01:30"` (crosses local midnight).
  4. `describeCron("0 15 * * 0,3", "UTC", "en", NOW)` → `"Sun, Wed 15:00"`; and `"0 15 * * 1-3"` → `"Mon–Wed 15:00"`, `"0 15 * * 1-2"` → `"Mon, Tue 15:00"` (both `"UTC"`, `"en"`).
  5. `describeCron("0 6 1 * *", "UTC", "en", NOW)` → `"Day 1 of the month 06:00"`; with `"he"` → `"ב־1 בחודש 06:00"`; and `"0 6 28 * *"` → `"Day 28 of the month 06:00"`, `"0 6 29 * *"` → `"0 6 29 * * UTC"` (both `"UTC"`, `"en"`).
  6. `describeCron("0 22 1 * *", "Asia/Jerusalem", "en", NOW)` → `"0 22 1 * * UTC"` (monthly that crosses midnight falls back).
  7. `describeCron("*/15 * * * *", "UTC", "en", NOW)` → `"*/15 * * * * UTC"`, and `describeCron("bad", "UTC", "en", NOW)` → `"bad UTC"`; and with `"UTC"`, `"en"`: `"59 23 * * *"` → `"Every day 23:59"`, `"60 5 * * *"` → `"60 5 * * * UTC"`, `"0 24 * * *"` → `"0 24 * * * UTC"`.
  8. `describeCron("0 5 * * 0-6", "Asia/Jerusalem", "en", NOW)` → `"Every day 08:00"`.
  9. `describeCron("0 9 * * 1-5", "America/New_York", "en", NOW)` → `"Mon–Fri 05:00"`, and `describeCron("0 9 * * 1-5", "Not/AZone", "en", NOW)` → `"0 9 * * 1-5 UTC"`.
- **NUMBERS:** 9 of 9 tests pass (exact) · output covers every cron `jobs.scheduleJob` accepts as daily/weekday/weekly/monthly; others show the raw cron (no silent wrong time) · no performance number applies to a pure formatter (UNKNOWN, not a gate).

  import type React from "react";
  import type { ModuleCardModule } from "./ModuleCard";
  import type { ScheduledJob } from "./ScheduledJobRow";
  export type ModulesState = "default" | "loading" | "error";
  export type ModulesViewProps = {
    state: ModulesState;
    online: boolean;
    plainMode: boolean;
    modules: ModuleCardModule[];       // modules.list order: user rows (builtIn false) and built-ins (builtIn true)
    jobs: ScheduledJob[];              // scheduleText already formatted by the route (describeCron)
    nowMs: number;
    timeZone: string;
    canToggleBuiltIns: boolean;
    saveError: boolean;
    onAskCoach?: () => void;           // absent → no "Ask the coach" / "Talk to the coach" buttons
    onSetPlainMode: (on: boolean) => void;
    onToggleModule: (change: { moduleId: string; on: boolean }) => Promise<void>; // rejects when the save failed
    onToggleJob: (change: { jobId: string; enabled: boolean }) => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function ModulesView(props: ModulesViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```

Built in: `<section className="tp-section" aria-labelledby="md-builtin-title" data-component="Section"><div className="tp-section__head"><h2 className="tp-section__title" id="md-builtin-title">{builtInTitle}</h2></div><p className="tp-help">{canToggleBuiltIns ? builtInSubToggle : builtInSubFixed}</p><div className="tp-cards" role="list" data-component="CardGrid">` with one `<div role="listitem"><ModuleCard module={localise(m)} canToggle={canToggleBuiltIns} onToggle={toggle} /></div>` per built-in (`modules.filter((m) => m.builtIn)`, order kept). `localise(m)` = `{ ...m, name: BUILT_IN_COPY[lang][m.moduleId]?.name ?? m.name, does: BUILT_IN_COPY[lang][m.moduleId]?.does ?? m.does }`.
  5. Toasts: when `toasts.length > 0`, `<div className="tp-toast-region">` with `<UndoToast key={t.moduleId} title={t.name + " " + (t.on ? turnedOn : turnedOff)} undoUntilMs={t.undoUntilMs} onUndo={() => undo(t)} onClose={() => closeToast(t.moduleId)} />` each.
  **Behaviour:** local state `toasts: { moduleId: string; name: string; on: boolean; undoUntilMs: number }[]` (`useState`). `toggle(change)`: `await onToggleModule(change)`; on success replace any toast for that `moduleId` with `{ moduleId, name: <localised name of that module>, on: change.on, undoUntilMs: Date.now() + UNDO_WINDOW_MS }`; on rejection add no toast (the route shows `saveError`). `undo(t)`: `await onToggleModule({ moduleId: t.moduleId, on: !t.on })`, then `closeToast(t.moduleId)`; a rejection leaves the toast. `closeToast(id)` removes it.

  export type ModulePreviewViewProps = {
    state: ModulePreviewState;
    draft: ModuleDraft | null;          // non-null only in "default"
    online: boolean;

    onApprove: (templateId: string) => Promise<void>;      // rejects when it did not go through
    onUndoApprove: (templateId: string) => Promise<void>;
    onDiscard: (templateId: string) => Promise<void>;
    onAskCoachToFix?: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function ModulePreviewView(props: ModulePreviewViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```

"mp-blocked" : "mp-approve-help"} onClick={approve}><TpIcon name="check" size="sm" /><span>{approveCopy}</span></button>` and Discard `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" aria-expanded={confirmOpen} aria-controls="mp-confirm" ref={discardRef} onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}><TpIcon name="x" size="sm" /><span>{discard}</span></button>`, then `blocked` → `<p className="tp-help" id="mp-blocked" data-blocked="">{!draft.validation.ok ? blockedCopy : offlineBlocked}</p>` else `<p className="tp-help" id="mp-approve-help">{approveHelp}</p>` `</div>`. `blocked = !draft.validation.ok || !online`.

Ids `tpl-builtin` / `tpl-mine`. Empty texts: Built-in → `emptyBuiltIn`; Yours → `emptyMine` + hint `emptyMineHint` (while searching both use `noMatch` + `noMatchHint`).

Changing scope clears `pendingDeleteId`. Names in toasts and status use the template's `name` as given.

  ```ts
  import type React from "react";
  import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";
  export type BuilderPeriod = "daily" | "weekly" | "monthly" | "none";
  export type BuilderDraft = { name: string; description: string; periodType: BuilderPeriod; body: string };
  export type TemplateBuilderState = "default" | "loading" | "missing" | "error";
  export type TemplateBuilderViewProps = {
    state: TemplateBuilderState;
    online: boolean;
    mode: "create" | "edit";               // edit = the person's own template (?id=); create = blank, ?from= copy or ?outline= sketch
    note: "none" | "copy" | "sketch";      // which info line shows above the form (create mode only)
    copyOfName: string;                    // the source template's name for note "copy"; "" otherwise
    initial: BuilderDraft;                 // the draft as loaded; the View copies it into local state on mount (the route remounts with `key`)
    exampleIso: string | null;             // the person's local "today" as YYYY-MM-DD, from the route; null → no preview yet
    dark: boolean;                         // current resolved theme
    onToggleTheme: () => void;
    onSave: (draft: BuilderDraft) => Promise<void>;   // resolves when saved; rejects when it did not go through
    onRetry: () => void;                   // state "error" only
  };
  export function TemplateBuilderView(props: TemplateBuilderViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```

"sun" : "moon"} /></button>`, and in `default` only the Save button `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary tp-btn--sm" disabled={!canSave} onClick={save}><TpIcon name="check" size="sm" /><span>{pending ? saving : save}</span></button>`. Then `<main className="tp-app__main bld-main" id="main" tabIndex={-1}>` with `<h1 className="tp-sr-only">{title}</h1>`, then `!online` → the offline banner `<output className="tp-notice tp-offline" data-tone="caution" data-component="StateOffline"><span className="tp-notice__icon"><TpIcon name="wifi-off" size="sm" /></span><span className="tp-notice__text">{offline}</span></output>`, then the state body.

  **Behaviour:** local state `name`, `description`, `body` (from `initial`), `saved: BuilderDraft` (= `initial`), `pending`, `error: boolean`, `notice: boolean`. `dirty = name !== saved.name || description !== saved.description || body !== saved.body`; `canSave = name.trim() !== "" && !pending && (mode === "create" || dirty)`. Every field or body change clears `notice`. `save()`: return unless `canSave`; `setPending(true); setError(false); setNotice(false)`; `const draft = { name: name.trim(), description: description.trim(), periodType: initial.periodType, body }`; `try { await onSave(draft); setSaved({ ...initial, name, description, body }); setNotice(true); } catch { setError(true); } finally { setPending(false); }`. `status = mode === "edit" && !dirty ? saved : unsaved`. The body editor is uncontrolled after mount (`TemplateBodyEditor` takes `initialValue`).

  // apps/web/components/settings/ConfirmDialog.tsx ("use client")
  import type React from "react";
  import type { ReactNode, RefObject } from "react";
  export type ConfirmDialogTone = "neutral" | "danger";
  export type ConfirmDialogProps = {
    id: string;                      // section id; title id `${id}-title`, sentence id `${id}-body`
    open: boolean;
    title: string;                   // localised by the caller
    body: string;                    // the one plain sentence, localised
    children?: ReactNode;            // extra content under the sentence (a list, a tick box)
    confirmLabel: string;
    cancelLabel: string;
    tone: ConfirmDialogTone;
    confirmBlocked?: boolean;        // Confirm stays visible and focusable but does nothing yet
    confirmDescribedBy?: string;     // id of the hint that says how to unblock Confirm
    busy?: boolean;                  // the confirmed action is running
    busyLabel?: string;              // Confirm text while busy (default: confirmLabel)
    error?: string;                  // last attempt failed; shown as an alert in the body
    initialFocusRef?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>; // focused on open and when a blocked Confirm is pressed
    onConfirm: () => void;
    onCancel: () => void;
  };
  export function ConfirmDialog(props: ConfirmDialogProps): React.JSX.Element | null;
  ```
  - **Markup** (`open === false` → `null`):
    `<div className="tp-sheet-scrim" aria-hidden="true" data-testid={`${id}-scrim`} onClick={busy ? undefined : () => onCancel()} />` then
    `<section ref={sheetRef} className="tp-sheet tp-glass" id={id} role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`} aria-describedby={`${id}-body`} data-component="ConfirmDialog" data-tone={tone}>` containing
    `<span className="tp-sheet__grabber" aria-hidden="true" />`;
    `<div className="tp-sheet__head"><h2 className="tp-sheet__title" id={`${id}-title`}>{title}</h2><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost tp-btn--icon" aria-label={copy.close} onClick={() => onCancel()} disabled={busy}><TpIcon name="x" /></button></div>`;
    `<div className="tp-sheet__body"><p id={`${id}-body`} dir="auto">{body}</p>{children}{error ? <p className="tp-error-text" role="alert"><TpIcon name="alert" size="sm" /><span>{error}</span></p> : null}</div>`;
    `<div className="tp-sheet__foot"><button ref={cancelRef} type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={() => onCancel()} disabled={busy}>{cancelLabel}</button><button type="button" className={tone === "danger" ? "tp-btn tp-btn--danger" : "tp-btn tp-btn--primary"} aria-disabled={confirmBlocked || busy ? "true" : undefined} aria-describedby={confirmDescribedBy} aria-busy={busy ? "true" : undefined} onClick={onConfirmClick}>{busy ? (busyLabel ?? confirmLabel) : confirmLabel}</button></div>` `</section>`.
  - **Behaviour:** `onConfirmClick`: if `busy` → nothing; else if `confirmBlocked` → `initialFocusRef?.current?.focus()` and nothing else; else `onConfirm()`. On `open` turning `true`: store `document.activeElement` in `returnRef`, set `document.body.style.overflow = "hidden"` (previous value kept), then focus `initialFocusRef?.current ?? cancelRef.current`. While open, one `keydown` listener on `document` (capture phase): `Escape` → `preventDefault()`, and `onCancel()` unless `busy`; `Tab` → keep focus inside the section, cycling between the first and last element matching `button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([disabled]), select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])`. On `open` turning `false` (or unmount while open): restore `body.style.overflow` and focus `returnRef.current` when it is still in the document.
  - **Copy** (`COPY: Record<Lang, Record<"close", string>>`, CONVENTIONS §11): `close` EN "Close" / HE "סגירה" (the Close button's `aria-label`). Every other string is supplied localised.
  - **Styling** (tempo.css, unchanged): scrim fixed, `--tp-scrim`, `tp-fade` over `--tp-dur-base` (180 ms); sheet fixed at the bottom on phones with `--tp-radius-xl` top corners and `tp-rise` over `--tp-dur-slow` (240 ms); from 768 px it floats centred, `bottom: var(--tp-space-6)`, all corners `--tp-radius-xl`; head padding `--tp-space-2` / `--tp-space-5`; title `--tp-font-serif` `--tp-text-lg`; body grid gap `--tp-space-3`; foot flex-wrap gap `--tp-space-2` with a `--tp-glass-line` top border. Danger Confirm = `.tp-btn--danger` (`--tp-danger-wash` background, `--tp-danger` text and border); neutral Confirm = `.tp-btn--primary` (`--tp-accent`).
  - **States (harness order; each opens from its opener):** `neutral` (`id: "cd-discard"`, title "Discard this draft?", body "Your changes to this module are not saved.", confirm "Discard", cancel "Keep editing", tone `neutral`); `danger` (`id: "cd-delete"`, title "Delete your account?", body "This removes, right away:", children = `<label className="tp-choice"><input ref={tickRef} type="checkbox" className="tp-checkbox" id="cd-tick" aria-describedby="cd-need" checked={ticked} onChange={(e) => setTicked(e.target.checked)} /><span className="tp-choice__text"><span>I understand.</span><span className="tp-choice__hint" id="cd-need">Tick this to turn on the delete button.</span></span></label>` written inline in the harness, confirm "Delete my account", cancel "Keep my account", tone `danger`, `confirmBlocked={!ticked}`, `confirmDescribedBy="cd-need"`, `initialFocusRef={tickRef}`); `busy` (`id: "cd-busy"`, same texts as `neutral`, `busy`, `busyLabel: "Discarding…"`); `error` (`id: "cd-error"`, same texts as `neutral`, `error: "Couldn't discard. Nothing was changed, so you can try again."`). Closed is the default of every section. Loading / empty / offline: n/a (the caller decides when to open it).
  - **RTL:** logical properties only in tempo.css; the Close button sits at the inline end of the head; the foot buttons flow from the inline start. **Keyboard / screen reader:** announced as an alert dialog named by its title and described by its sentence; focus starts on the tick box or Cancel (never on a destructive Confirm), Tab cycles inside, Escape cancels, focus returns to the opener. **Breakpoints:** bottom sheet at 390; centred floating card at 768 / 1024 / 1280. **Motion:** `tp-rise` 240 ms and `tp-fade` 180 ms; both instant under reduced motion (tempo.css line 480).

  export type AskFounderPriority = "low" | "medium" | "high";
  export type AskFounderDraft = { subject: string; body: string; priority: AskFounderPriority };
  export type AskFounderState = "default" | "loading" | "error" | "signed-out";
  export type AskFounderSending = "idle" | "sending" | "sent" | "failed";
  export type AskFounderViewProps = {
    state: AskFounderState;          // "error" = the person's details failed to load
    online: boolean;
    email: string;                   // shown in "What gets sent"; "" outside "default"
    name: string | null;             // callMe ?? fullName; null → the Sent title has no name
    sending: AskFounderSending;
    sentSubject: string | null;      // the subject of the message just sent (Sent panel)
    onSend: (draft: AskFounderDraft) => void;   // draft is trimmed; called only when valid
    onWriteAnother: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;             // reload after "error"
  };
  export const ASK_FOUNDER_SUBJECT_MAX = 120;
  export function AskFounderView(props: AskFounderViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```

"af-subject" : "af-body"}`}>{e === "subject" ? copy.subjectErr : copy.bodyErr}</a></li>)}</ul></div>`; (b) `<TextInput id="af-subject" label={copy.subject} help={copy.subjectHelp} value={draft.subject} onChange={…} maxLength={ASK_FOUNDER_SUBJECT_MAX} error={errors.includes("subject") ? copy.subjectErr : undefined} />`; (c) `<Textarea id="af-body" label={copy.body} help={copy.bodyHelp} rows={6} value={draft.body} onChange={…} error={errors.includes("body") ? copy.bodyErr : undefined} />`; (d) `<RadioGroup legend={copy.priority}>` with three `<Radio id={`af-pri-${p}`} name="priority" value={p} label={copy[p]} hint={copy[`${p}Hint`]} checked={draft.priority === p} onChange={…} />` for `low`, `medium`, `high`; (e) `<Notice tone="info" title={copy.noticeTitle} body={copy.noticeBody.replace("{email}", "\u2068" + email + "\u2069")} live="off" />` (the email sits in a Unicode first-strong isolate so it stays LTR inside Hebrew); (f) when `sending === "sending" && !online` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={copy.queued} live="status" />`; (g) when `sending === "failed"` → `<Notice tone="danger" title={copy.failedTitle} body={copy.failedBody} live="alert" />`.
  - **Sent panel:** `<div className="tp-status-panel tp-surface" data-tone="done" data-component="StatusPanel"><span className="tp-status-panel__icon" aria-hidden="true"><TpIcon name="check" size="lg" /></span><h2 ref={sentTitleRef} className="tp-status-panel__title" tabIndex={-1}>{name ? copy.sentTitle.replace("{name}", name) : copy.sentTitlePlain}</h2><p className="tp-status-panel__body">{copy.sentBody}</p>{sentSubject ? <p className="tp-status-panel__meta" dir="auto">{sentSubject}</p> : null}<div className="tp-status-panel__actions"><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" data-component="Button" onClick={onWriteAnother}>{copy.another}</button><Link href="/today" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" data-component="Button">{copy.today}</Link></div></div>`. (The page's only `h1` stays in the header, so the panel title is an `h2`.)
  - **Behaviour:** local state `draft: AskFounderDraft` (initial `{ subject: "", body: "", priority: "medium" }`) and `errors: ("subject" | "body")[]` (initial `[]`). `submit()`: if `sending === "sending"` return; `subject = draft.subject.trim()`, `body = draft.body.trim()`; `next` = `"subject"` when `subject === ""`, then `"body"` when `body === ""`; if `next.length > 0` → `setErrors(next)` and, after render, `summaryRef.current?.focus()`; else `setErrors([])` and `onSend({ subject, body, priority: draft.priority })`. Typing into a field removes that field from `errors` once its trimmed value is not empty. When `sending` changes from any value other than `"sent"` to `"sent"` after the first render (a `useRef` holds the previous value; nothing happens on mount), focus `sentTitleRef`. When `sending` changes from `"sent"` to `"idle"` (Write another), reset `draft` to the initial value and focus `#af-subject`. `"failed"` keeps the draft so the person can press Send again.

  export type AskFounderFixtureState = "default" | "loading" | "error" | "signed-out" | "offline" | "failed" | "sent";
  const LOADING: AskFounderFixture = { state: "loading", online: true, email: "", name: null, sending: "idle", sentSubject: null };
  const NOOP = { onSend: () => {}, onWriteAnother: () => {}, onRetry: () => {} } satisfies Partial<AskFounderViewProps>;

  export default function Page() {
    return (<div data-testid="ask-founder-page"><Suspense fallback={null}><AskFounderRoute /></Suspense></div>);
  }
  class AskFounderBoundary extends Component<{ online: boolean; children: ReactNode }, { failed: boolean; attempt: number }> {

"true" : undefined}>` with `{/* biome-ignore lint/a11y/useSemanticElements: the v3 TaskRow check is a button with checkbox semantics (tp-check) */}<button className="tp-check" type="button" role="checkbox" aria-checked={done} aria-labelledby={titleId} tabIndex={-1}><span className="tp-check__box"><TpIcon name="check" /></span></button><span className="tp-task-row__body"><span className="tp-task-row__title" id={titleId}>{title}</span><span className="tp-task-row__meta"><span><span className="tp-num">{minutes}</span> {copy.min}</span></span></span>`; row 1: `task1`, done, 5 minutes; row 2: `task2` with 3, not done, 25 minutes; `titleId` = `` `${useId()}-t1` `` / `-t2` (one `useId()` call per figure).

  - **States:** `default`, `empty`, `loading`, `error` (all four render the full page: nothing on the page is a list the visitor owns, so there is no empty/error variant; design `@states`), `offline` (full page plus `landing-offline` banner; live: `useOnline()` false), `prices-loading` (full page with `landing-prices-loading` in place of the tier grid; live: `listTiers` still `undefined`). Testids: `landing-screen` (root, `data-state`), `landing-offline`, `landing-prices-loading`.
  - **RTL / keyboard / breakpoints / motion:** RTL: `<html dir>` and `lang` come from `LocaleProvider` (`?lang=`, then `localStorage["tempo-lang"]`); every component mirrors through logical properties; digits are U+2066/U+2069 isolates; "Tempo" stays Latin. Keyboard: skip link → header links → language switch → hero primary → secondary → pricing join link → FAQ summaries → footer links → footer switch; figures are inert; one `h1` (hero), `h2` per section, `h3` per feature/step. Choosing a language in either switch calls `setLang`, so the page re-renders in place with `<html lang dir>` updated and the choice stored. Breakpoints: 390 px base, components handle 768/1024/1280 (`.tp-feature` stacks below 1024, `.tp-site-link--wide` hides below 768, `.tp-tiers` 4-up at 1024+). Motion: none added by the screen; component transitions ≤ 250 ms and instant under reduced motion.
- **TESTS:** each case is one Playwright `test` in a file that imports `test`, `expect` from `@playwright/test` and `VIEWPORTS`, `openScreen`, `expectDir`, `trackConsoleErrors`, `expectTargetSize`, `expectMotionBudget`, `measureVitals` from `../helpers/harness`, and whose first statement is `test.skip(!!process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL, "local webServer only");`. Every case runs inside `for (const [vpName, vp] of [["mobile", VIEWPORTS.mobile], ["desktop", VIEWPORTS.desktop]] as const) for (const lang of ["en", "he"] as const)`: `await page.setViewportSize(vp)`, `const errors = trackConsoleErrors(page)`, `openScreen(page, "/", { state, lang })`, and at the end `await expectDir(page, lang)` and, after dropping messages matching `/example\.convex\.cloud|WebSocket/i`, `expect(errors).toEqual([])`. The spec holds its own `EXPECT: Record<"en" | "he", …>` with the SPEC copy it asserts and compares texts after `s.replace(/[\u2066\u2069]/g, "")`; test names include `vpName` and `lang` (7 × 4 = 28).

  2. Given state `default` / Then the ids of `main#main > section.ab-block` are, in order, `what`, `how`, `voice`, `who`, `pricing`, `faq`; `#what` holds 3 `[data-component="FeatureRow"]`, `#voice` 1, `#how` an `ol[data-component="HowItWorks"]` with 3 `li`, `#who` 2 `[data-component="Card"]`, `#faq` 6 `details`, and every `.tp-feature__figure` has `inert`.

  4. Given each of the states `empty`, `loading`, `error` in turn (one test that opens all three) / Then the `h1` is `heroTitle`, 4 TierCards are present and `landing-offline` is absent.

    ```tsx

      </Container>
      <SiteFooter current="changelog" languageSwitch={<LanguageSwitch current={lang} long onChoose={setLang} />} />
    </div>
