  export type OfflineLang = "en" | "he";
  export type OfflinePageSummary = { id: string; title: string; updatedAt: number; cachedAt: number };
  export type OfflinePage = OfflinePageSummary & { body: string };
  export type OfflineModel =
    | { view: "checking"; lang: OfflineLang }
    | { view: "list"; lang: OfflineLang; pages: OfflinePageSummary[] } // [] renders the empty state
    | { view: "page"; lang: OfflineLang; page: OfflinePage }
    | { view: "missing"; lang: OfflineLang }
    | { view: "error"; lang: OfflineLang };
  export function docAttrs(lang: OfflineLang): { lang: OfflineLang; dir: "ltr" | "rtl" }; // he → rtl
  export function escapeHtml(text: string): string; // & < > " ' → &amp; &lt; &gt; &quot; &#39;
  export function formatDate(ms: number, lang: OfflineLang): string; // Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(ms)
  export function renderOffline(model: OfflineModel): string;
  ```
  **Markup** (every dynamic string through `escapeHtml`; ids through `encodeURIComponent`): root `<main class="tp-offline-reader" data-view="<view>" id="main">`. Every view except `checking` starts with the banner `<div class="tp-offline-reader__banner" role="status"><p class="tp-offline-reader__banner-text">{banner}</p><button type="button" class="tp-offline-reader__btn" data-action="retry">{retry}</button></div>`.
  - `checking`: `<p class="tp-offline-reader__status" role="status" aria-busy="true">{checking}</p>` only.
  - `list` with pages: `<h1 class="tp-offline-reader__title">{listTitle}</h1><ul class="tp-offline-reader__list">` + per page `<li class="tp-offline-reader__item"><a class="tp-offline-reader__link" href="#page=<id>" dir="auto">{title || untitled}</a><span class="tp-offline-reader__meta"><span class="tp-num">{formatDate(updatedAt)}</span></span></li>` + `</ul>`.
  - `list` with `[]`: `<h1 class="tp-offline-reader__title">{listTitle}</h1><p class="tp-offline-reader__empty">{emptyTitle}</p><p class="tp-offline-reader__hint">{emptyBody}</p>`.
  - `page`: `<a class="tp-offline-reader__back" href="#">{back}</a><h1 class="tp-offline-reader__title" dir="auto">{title || untitled}</h1><p class="tp-offline-reader__meta">{saved with {date} = <span class="tp-num">formatDate(cachedAt)</span>}</p><p class="tp-offline-reader__hint">{readOnly}</p><pre class="tp-offline-reader__body" dir="auto">{body}</pre>`.
  - `missing`: `<a class="tp-offline-reader__back" href="#">{back}</a><p class="tp-offline-reader__empty">{missing}</p>`.
  - `error`: `<p class="tp-offline-reader__empty" role="alert">{error}</p><p class="tp-offline-reader__hint">{safe}</p>`.
  **COPY** (`type CopyKey = …`; `const COPY: Record<OfflineLang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`):
  | key | EN | HE |
  |---|---|---|
  | banner | You're offline. Pages you opened recently are here to read. | אין חיבור כרגע. הדפים שנפתחו לאחרונה זמינים כאן לקריאה. |
  | retry | Try again | לנסות שוב |
  | checking | Checking the connection… | בודקים את החיבור… |
  | listTitle | Offline pages | דפים לקריאה בלי חיבור |
  | untitled | Untitled | ללא כותרת |
  | emptyTitle | No pages saved yet. | עוד אין דפים שמורים. |
  | emptyBody | Pages you open while online are kept here for reading. | דפים שנפתחים כשיש חיבור נשמרים כאן לקריאה. |
  | back | Back | חזרה |
  | saved | Saved {date} | נשמר ב־{date} |
  | readOnly | Read only while offline. | קריאה בלבד כשאין חיבור. |
  | missing | This page isn't saved for offline reading. | הדף הזה לא נשמר לקריאה בלי חיבור. |
  | error | Couldn't open the offline pages. | לא הצלחנו לפתוח את הדפים השמורים. |
  | safe | Your data is safe. | המידע שלך שמור. |
  **Stylesheet `offline.css` (every rule; CONVENTIONS §10 Case B: every selector starts with `.tp-offline-reader`, no `html`/`body` or other element selector at top level — the page background, ink and font sit on the `.tp-offline-reader` root, and the bundled page's `body` margin belongs to CFG-048's `index.html`, not this file):**
  ```css
  .tp-offline-reader { display: grid; gap: var(--tp-space-4); max-inline-size: var(--tp-paper-max); margin-inline: auto; padding: var(--tp-space-6) var(--tp-space-4); background: var(--tp-ground); color: var(--tp-ink); font-family: var(--tp-font-sans); font-size: var(--tp-text-md); line-height: var(--tp-leading-body); }
  .tp-offline-reader__banner { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--tp-space-2) var(--tp-space-3); padding: var(--tp-space-3) var(--tp-space-4); border: 1px solid var(--tp-line); border-radius: var(--tp-radius-lg); background: var(--tp-caution-wash); }
  .tp-offline-reader__banner-text { flex: 1 1 auto; margin: 0; font-size: var(--tp-text-sm); }
  .tp-offline-reader__btn { min-block-size: var(--tp-touch); padding-inline: var(--tp-space-4); border: 1px solid var(--tp-line-control); border-radius: var(--tp-radius-md); background: var(--tp-paper); color: var(--tp-ink); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--tp-dur-fast) var(--tp-ease-out); }
  .tp-offline-reader__btn:hover { background: var(--tp-hover); }
  .tp-offline-reader__title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--tp-font-serif); font-size: var(--tp-text-2xl); font-weight: 500; line-height: var(--tp-leading-heading); }
  .tp-offline-reader__list { display: grid; gap: var(--tp-space-1); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  .tp-offline-reader__item { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--tp-space-2); border-block-end: 1px solid var(--tp-line); }
  .tp-offline-reader__link, .tp-offline-reader__back { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-block-size: var(--tp-touch); color: var(--tp-ink); text-underline-offset: var(--tp-space-1); }
  .tp-offline-reader__link { flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .tp-offline-reader__meta, .tp-offline-reader__hint { margin: 0; color: var(--tp-ink-muted); font-size: var(--tp-text-sm); }
  .tp-offline-reader__empty, .tp-offline-reader__status { margin: 0; font-size: var(--tp-text-lg); }
  .tp-offline-reader__body { margin: 0; padding: var(--tp-space-4); border: 1px solid var(--tp-line); border-radius: var(--tp-radius-md); background: var(--tp-paper); font-family: var(--tp-font-sans); white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .tp-offline-reader .tp-num { direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  @media (min-width: 768px) { .tp-offline-reader { padding: var(--tp-space-10) var(--tp-space-6); } }

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  import { docAttrs, type OfflineLang, type OfflineModel, type OfflinePage, type OfflinePageSummary, renderOffline } from "./offline";
  export const WEB_ORIGIN = "https://www.tempoflow.dev"; // CFG-048 OPEN: origin
  export const HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS = 4_000;
  export type BootSettings = { onboarded: boolean; lang: OfflineLang };
  export type BootDeps = {
    checkHealth: () => Promise<boolean>;
    getSettings: () => Promise<BootSettings>;
    listPages: () => Promise<OfflinePageSummary[]>;
    getPage: (id: string) => Promise<OfflinePage | null>;
  };
  export type BootDecision = { kind: "online"; url: string } | { kind: "offline"; lang: OfflineLang };
  /** getSettings rejects → { onboarded: true, lang: "en" }. checkHealth true → online, url = WEB_ORIGIN + (onboarded ? "/today" : "/desktop/welcome"); false or rejects → offline with settings.lang. */
  export function decideStart(deps: BootDeps): Promise<BootDecision>;
  /** "#page=<encoded>" → decodeURIComponent(<encoded>) (a decode error → null); any other hash → null. */
  export function pageIdFromHash(hash: string): string | null;
  /** id = pageIdFromHash(hash): id → getPage → { view: "page" } or { view: "missing" }; no id → listPages → { view: "list" }; any rejection → { view: "error" }. */
  export function offlineModel(deps: BootDeps, lang: OfflineLang, hash: string): Promise<OfflineModel>;
  /** fetchFn(WEB_ORIGIN + "/api/health", { cache: "no-store", credentials: "omit", signal }) aborted after timeoutMs; true only when res.ok and (await res.json()).ok === true; any error → false. */
  export function checkHealth(fetchFn?: typeof fetch, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<boolean>;
  /** Browser entry: deps from window.__TAURI__.core.invoke ("desktop_settings_get", "desktop_page_cache_list", "desktop_page_cache_get" with { id }).
   *  Renders { view: "checking", lang: "en" } into #app, then decideStart: online → location.replace(url);
   *  offline → sets document.documentElement lang/dir from docAttrs, renders offlineModel(deps, lang, location.hash),
   *  re-renders on "hashchange", and a click on [data-action="retry"] runs main() again. */
  export function main(): void;
  if (typeof document !== "undefined" && document.getElementById("app")) main();
  ```
  No copy of its own (all strings come from `offline.ts`); errors are never thrown to the page (every failure maps to a view).
- **TESTS:** (`bun:test`; stub deps built per case)
  1. Given `checkHealth → true`, settings `{ onboarded: true, lang: "he" }` / When `decideStart` / Then `{ kind: "online", url: "https://www.tempoflow.dev/today" }`.
  2. Given `checkHealth → true`, `onboarded: false` / Then url `https://www.tempoflow.dev/desktop/welcome`.
  3. Given `checkHealth → false`, lang `he` / Then `{ kind: "offline", lang: "he" }`; and given `checkHealth` rejecting / Then offline too.
  4. Given `getSettings` rejecting and `checkHealth → true` / Then url ends `/today`.
  5. Given `pageIdFromHash("#page=n%202")`, `("#page=")`, `("#x")`, `("#page=%E0%A4%A")` / Then `"n 2"`, `null`, `null`, `null`.
  6. Given hash `""` and `listPages → [P1]` / When `offlineModel(deps, "en", "")` / Then `{ view: "list", lang: "en", pages: [P1] }`.
  7. Given hash `#page=n1` and `getPage → page` / Then `{ view: "page", … }`; with `getPage → null` / Then `{ view: "missing", lang }`.
  8. Given `listPages` rejecting / Then `{ view: "error", lang }`.
  9. Given a fake fetch resolving `{ ok: true, json: async () => ({ ok: true }) }` / Then `checkHealth(fake, 50)` is `true` and the fake was called with `"https://www.tempoflow.dev/api/health"` and `{ cache: "no-store", credentials: "omit", signal }`; a fake resolving `{ ok: false }` gives `false`; a fake that never resolves gives `false` after 50 ms.
- **NUMBERS:** health check timeout 4,000 ms (product value; pass = `HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS === 4000`, abort proven by test 9 with 50 ms). Time to first paint of the boot page: UNKNOWN (no baseline; not a gate). 9 of 9 tests pass.

  import type React from "react";
  import type { DesktopSettings, DesktopUpdateStatus } from "@/lib/desktop/bridge";
  export type DesktopSettingsState = "default" | "loading" | "error" | "not-desktop";
  export type DesktopToggleKey = "launchAtLogin" | "closeToTray" | "autoUpdate";
  export type DesktopSettingsPending = DesktopToggleKey | "restart" | "clear" | null;
  export type DesktopSettingsNotice = "saveError" | "restartError" | "cleared" | "clearError" | null;
  export type DesktopSettingsViewProps = {
    state: DesktopSettingsState;
    settings: DesktopSettings | null; // null unless state === "default"
    update: DesktopUpdateStatus;
    pending: DesktopSettingsPending;
    notice: DesktopSettingsNotice;
    onToggle: (change: { key: DesktopToggleKey; next: boolean }) => void;
    onRestart: () => void;
    onClearPages: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export const OFFLINE_PAGES_MAX = 200; // shown in the help text; equals PAGE_CACHE_MAX_PAGES (TFV2-0421a)
  export function DesktopSettingsView(props: DesktopSettingsViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<div className="tp-page" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="DesktopSettingsView">`. 1) `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader"><div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{title}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{sub}</p></div></header>`. 2) `notice !== null` → `<div className="tp-notice" data-component="Notice" data-tone={notice === "cleared" ? "done" : "caution"} role={notice === "cleared" ? "status" : "alert"}><div className="tp-notice__text"><p className="tp-notice__title">{copy[notice]}</p></div></div>`. 3) `loading` → `<div className="tp-state" role="status" aria-busy="true"><p className="tp-state__body">{loading}</p></div>`; `error` → `<div className="tp-state tp-state--error" data-component="StateError" role="alert"><p className="tp-state__title">{error}</p><p className="tp-state__body">{safe}</p><div className="tp-state__actions"><button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--secondary" onClick={onRetry}>{retry}</button></div></div>`; `not-desktop` → `<div className="tp-state" data-state="not-desktop"><p className="tp-state__title">{notDesktopTitle}</p><p className="tp-state__body">{notDesktopBody}</p></div>`. 4) `default` → three `<section className="tp-settings-section" data-component="SettingsSection" aria-labelledby="<id>">` each with `<div className="tp-settings-section__head"><h2 className="tp-settings-section__title" id="<id>">…</h2></div>` then rows `<div className="tp-setting-row" data-component="SettingRow" data-key="<key>"><div className="tp-setting-row__text"><span className="tp-setting-row__label" id="<rowId>">{label}</span><span className="tp-small tp-muted" id="<rowId>-help">{help}</span></div><div className="tp-setting-row__control">{control}</div></div>`:
  - section `ds-app` {appSection}: row `launchAtLogin` (rowId `ds-launch`, control `<SettingsSwitch id="ds-launch-switch" checked={settings.launchAtLogin} labelledBy="ds-launch" describedBy="ds-launch-help" locked={pending !== null} onChange={(next) => onToggle({ key: "launchAtLogin", next })} />`); row `closeToTray` (rowId `ds-tray`, same pattern).

FIXTURES.error` (set in an effect keyed on `forced`); handlers act locally: `onToggle({ key, next })` sets `settings[key] = next`; `onRestart` and `onClearPages` set `notice: "cleared"` for clear and nothing for restart; `onRetry` does nothing. After a successful load, if `!langSynced.current && settings.lang !== lang` → `langSynced.current = true; setDesktopSettings({ lang })` → on success replace `settings` (errors ignored).
  - **Live handlers:** `onToggle({ key, next })` → `pending: key`, `setDesktopSettings({ [key]: next })` → `settings` = reply, `notice: null`; rejection → `notice: "saveError"`; finally `pending: null`. `onRestart` → `pending: "restart"`, `restartToUpdate()` (the app restarts); rejection → `notice: "restartError"`, `pending: null`. `onClearPages` → `pending: "clear"`, `clearPageCache()` → `notice: "cleared"`; rejection → `notice: "clearError"`; finally `pending: null`. `onRetry` → `attempt + 1` with `FIXTURES.loading`.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type DesktopWelcomeStep = "welcome" | "choices";
  export type DesktopWelcomeToggleKey = "launchAtLogin" | "closeToTray";
  export type DesktopWelcomeViewProps = {
    step: DesktopWelcomeStep;
    lang: "en" | "he";            // the language chosen in step 1
    launchAtLogin: boolean;
    closeToTray: boolean;
    saving: boolean;              // Start and Skip disabled; Start reads "Saving…"
    saveError: boolean;
    onLang: (lang: "en" | "he") => void;
    onNext: () => void;
    onBack: () => void;
    onToggle: (change: { key: DesktopWelcomeToggleKey; next: boolean }) => void;
    onFinish: () => void;
    onSkip: () => void;
  };
  export function DesktopWelcomeView(props: DesktopWelcomeViewProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  **Layout:** root `<main className="tp-page" id="main" data-component="PageLayout" data-view="DesktopWelcomeView" data-step={step}>`. 1) `<p className="tp-small tp-muted" aria-live="polite">{stepOf}</p>` with `{n}` = 1 or 2 and `{total}` = 2, each in `<span className="tp-num">`. 2) `<header className="tp-pagehead" data-component="PageHeader"><div className="tp-pagehead__text"><h1 className="tp-pagehead__title">{step === "welcome" ? welcomeTitle : choicesTitle}</h1><p className="tp-pagehead__sub">{step === "welcome" ? welcomeBody : choicesBody}</p></div></header>`. 3) `saveError` → `<div className="tp-notice" data-component="Notice" data-tone="caution" role="alert"><div className="tp-notice__text"><p className="tp-notice__title">{saveErrorText}</p></div></div>`.
  - `welcome`: `<section className="tp-settings-section" data-component="SettingsSection" aria-labelledby="dw-lang"><div className="tp-setting-row" data-component="SettingRow"><div className="tp-setting-row__text"><span className="tp-setting-row__label" id="dw-lang">{language}</span></div><div className="tp-setting-row__control"><Segmented labelledBy="dw-lang" value={lang} onChange={onLang} options={[{ value: "en", label: "English", lang: "en" }, { value: "he", label: "עברית", lang: "he" }]} /></div></div></section>`; actions `<div className="tp-pagehead__actions">` = `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--primary" onClick={onNext}>{continueLabel}</button>` and `<button type="button" className="tp-btn tp-btn--ghost" disabled={saving} onClick={onSkip}>{skip}</button>`.

- **STATUS:** open — inherits CFG-050 (new: May Tempo run the person's own Claude subscription token on a Tempo-operated VPS (Anthropic's Agent SDK docs say third-party products may not offer claude.ai login or its rate limits without Anthropic's prior approval; PRD §6 also forbids Anthropic keys in third-party code)? If yes: which VPS host and region, which pinned `claude` CLI version (npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` latest was 2.1.316 on 2 Nov 2026, installed on the image, not in the repo), and is `apps/claude-runner` in this repo the right place for the runner code?)

- **FOR:** Tempo Flow (`Levidavidspublic/tempo-rhythm`); area `claude-runner` (Bun service for the VPS, new workspace from CFG-050); lane per `factory/SLOTS.md`.
- **WHEN:** after CFG-050.
- **WHY:** PRD §3.3 / F-123 ("a minimal VPS that spawns the real `claude` binary on the user's own OAuth"). Convex functions cannot start OS processes, so the spawner cannot live in `convex/` (the old `convex/lib/claude-spawn.ts` path was also invalid: Convex file names allow no hyphens, CONVENTIONS §7 E). It lives in the runner service `apps/claude-runner` (CFG-050), which uses only Bun built-ins (`Bun.spawn`): no npm dependency, and never the `@anthropic-ai/*` packages (blocked by `scripts/scan-forbidden-tech.ts` line 40; PRD §6 "Never: Anthropic keys in third-party code"). The `claude` binary is installed on the VPS image, outside the repo, at `CLAUDE_BIN`. Tests live in `tests/unit/claude_runner_*.test.ts` so `bun run test:unit` runs them (same pattern as `tests/unit/mobile_*.test.ts`).
- **GOAL:** `spawnClaude` validates a run request, starts `claude` in print mode with only the Tempo MCP tools allowed, passes the prompt on stdin and the person's token only in the process environment, enforces a 60 s timeout and a 32 KiB output cap, and returns the output, proven by tests that never start a real process.

- **MUTATES:** `apps/claude-runner/src/spawn.ts` (new) · `tests/unit/claude_runner_spawn.test.ts` (new). No data; at runtime it starts the `claude` process on the VPS.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const CLAUDE_OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES = 32_768;
  export const CLAUDE_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS = 60_000;
  export const CLAUDE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES = 16_384;
  export const CLAUDE_MAX_TURNS = 8;
  export const TOOL_PATTERN = /^mcp__tempo__[a-z_]+$/;
  export const CHILD_PATH = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin";
  export type SpawnRequest = { prompt: string; allowedTools: readonly string[]; mcpConfigPath: string; timeoutMs: number; oauthToken: string; home: string };
  export type RunnerResult = { stdout: string; exitCode: number; timedOut: boolean };
  export type ProcessRunner = (cmd: string[], opts: { env: Record<string, string>; stdin: string; timeoutMs: number }) => Promise<RunnerResult>;
  export type SpawnResult = { output: string; truncated: boolean };
  /** [bin, "-p", "--output-format", "text", "--max-turns", String(CLAUDE_MAX_TURNS), "--tools", "", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", req.mcpConfigPath, "--allowedTools", req.allowedTools.join(",")] */
  export function buildClaudeArgs(bin: string, req: SpawnRequest): string[];
  /** Cuts to at most maxBytes UTF-8 bytes on a character boundary. */
  export function truncateUtf8(text: string, maxBytes: number): { text: string; truncated: boolean };
  /** Validates in this order, each failing with new Error(<message>) before run is called:
   *  prompt.trim() === "" → "Prompt is empty"; UTF-8 bytes(prompt) > CLAUDE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES → "Prompt is too long";
   *  !Number.isInteger(timeoutMs) || timeoutMs < 1 || timeoutMs > CLAUDE_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS → "Invalid timeout";
   *  allowedTools empty or any tool not matching TOOL_PATTERN → "Tool not allowed"; oauthToken === "" → "Missing Claude sign-in".
   *  Then run(buildClaudeArgs(bin, req), { env: { CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: oauthToken, HOME: home, PATH: CHILD_PATH }, stdin: prompt, timeoutMs }):
   *  timedOut → "Claude run timed out"; exitCode !== 0 → `Claude run failed (exit ${exitCode})`;
   *  else truncateUtf8(stdout, CLAUDE_OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES) → { output, truncated }. */
  export function spawnClaude(bin: string, req: SpawnRequest, run: ProcessRunner): Promise<SpawnResult>;
  /** Bun.spawn(cmd, { env, stdin: new Blob([stdin]), stdout: "pipe", stderr: "ignore" }); kills the child after timeoutMs (timedOut: true);
   *  reads stdout up to CLAUDE_OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES + 4 bytes, then kills the child (the cap marks truncated). */
  export function bunProcessRunner(): ProcessRunner;
  ```
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Prompt is empty"`; `"Prompt is too long"` (> 16,384 bytes); `"Invalid timeout"`; `"Tool not allowed"`; `"Missing Claude sign-in"`; `"Claude run timed out"`; `"Claude run failed (exit <n>)"`. No user-facing copy (Convex maps runner errors, TFV2-0420c).

  export const TEMPO_MCP_TOOLS = ["tasks_list", "task_create", "task_update", "notes_list", "note_create", "note_update", "calendar_list", "calendar_create", "calendar_update", "today_plan_get", "brain_dump"] as const;

  export const RUN_BODY_MAX_BYTES = 32_768;
  export const RUN_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
  export const MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS = 2;

  export type ServerDeps = {

  export function mcpConfigJson(mcpUrl: string, mcpToken: string): string;
  /** Returns a handler bound to deps with its own in-flight counter. */

  Handler order (every response `Content-Type: application/json`, body `{ "error": <message> }` unless 200): not `POST` or path not `/run` → 404 `"Not found"`; `Authorization` header not exactly `Bearer <runnerToken>` (compared with `crypto.timingSafeEqual` from `node:crypto` on equal-length buffers; unequal length → mismatch) → 401 `"Unauthorized"`; in-flight runs ≥ `MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS` → 429 `"Runner is busy"`; body UTF-8 bytes > `RUN_BODY_MAX_BYTES` → 413 `"Request too large"`; body not JSON, any of the four fields missing or not a string, or `new URL(mcpUrl).protocol !== "https:"` → 400 `"Invalid request"`; then `dir = await makeTempDir()`, `writeFile(\`${dir}/mcp.json\`, mcpConfigJson(…))`, `spawnClaude(claudeBin, { prompt, allowedTools: TEMPO_ALLOWED_TOOLS, mcpConfigPath: \`${dir}/mcp.json\`, timeoutMs: RUN_TIMEOUT_MS, oauthToken, home: dir }, run)` → 200 `{ "output": …, "truncated": … }`; spawn errors `"Prompt is empty"`, `"Prompt is too long"`, `"Missing Claude sign-in"` → 400 with that message; `"Claude run timed out"` → 504 `"Claude run timed out"`; any other error → 502 `"Claude run failed"`; `removeDir(dir)` in `finally`. `main.ts`: reads `CLAUDE_RUNNER_TOKEN` (missing or shorter than 32 characters → `console.error("CLAUDE_RUNNER_TOKEN is missing or too short")`, `process.exit(1)`), `CLAUDE_BIN` (default `"claude"`), `PORT` (default `8787`); `Bun.serve({ port, fetch: createRunHandler({ …, run: bunProcessRunner(), makeTempDir: () => mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "tempo-claude-")), writeFile: (p, t) => Bun.write(p, t).then(() => undefined), removeDir: (p) => rm(p, { recursive: true, force: true }) }) })` with `mkdtemp`/`rm` from `node:fs/promises`.

  1. Given `GET /run` or `POST /other` / Then 404 `{"error":"Not found"}`.
  2. Given `POST /run` with no or a wrong `Authorization` / Then 401 `{"error":"Unauthorized"}` and `run` was never called.
  3. Given a body over 32,768 bytes / Then 413 `{"error":"Request too large"}`.
  4. Given `"not json"`, a body missing `mcpToken`, or `mcpUrl: "http://x/mcp"` / Then each 400 `{"error":"Invalid request"}`.
  5. Given a valid body and a fake run resolving `{ stdout: "Done.", exitCode: 0, timedOut: false }` / Then 200 `{"output":"Done.","truncated":false}`; `writeFile` got `<dir>/mcp.json` with exactly `mcpConfigJson("https://example.convex.site/mcp", "tmcp_x")`; the run's argv contains `"--allowedTools"` followed by the 11 `mcp__tempo__…` names joined by commas; `removeDir` got `<dir>`.
  6. Given prompt `""` / Then 400 `{"error":"Prompt is empty"}` and `removeDir` was still called.
  7. Given a fake run with `timedOut: true` / Then 504 `{"error":"Claude run timed out"}`.
  8. Given a fake run with `exitCode: 1` / Then 502 `{"error":"Claude run failed"}`.
  9. Given two runs in flight (fake runs that resolve only when released) / When a third valid request arrives / Then 429 `{"error":"Runner is busy"}`; after one is released, a new request is accepted.
  10. Given `mcpConfigJson("https://a/mcp", "t")` / Then it equals `{"mcpServers":{"tempo":{"type":"http","url":"https://a/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer t"}}}}`.
- **NUMBERS:** body ≤ 32,768 bytes; run ≤ 60,000 ms; ≤ 2 concurrent runs per runner (product bounds; tests 3, 9). Allowed tools = 11 (test 5). 10 of 10 tests pass. Runner p95 latency: UNKNOWN (no VPS; not a gate).

  export const CLAUDE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES = 16_384;

  export type ClaudeCallDeps = {

    reserve: () => Promise<{ userId: Id<"users">; oauthTokenCipher: string; mcpTokenCipher: string }>;
    loadKey: () => Promise<CryptoKey | null>;
    decrypt: (key: CryptoKey, cipher: string, aad: string) => Promise<string>;

  export function callClaudeRunner(deps: ClaudeCallDeps, prompt: string): Promise<ClaudeRunResult>;
  // convex/claudeRunner.ts (added)
  export const run = action({
    args: { prompt: v.string() },
    returns: v.object({ output: v.string(), truncated: v.boolean() }),
    handler: async (ctx: ActionCtx, args: { prompt: string }): Promise<ClaudeRunResult> =>
      callClaudeRunner({
        assertApproved: () => requireApprovedForAi(ctx),
        reserve: () => ctx.runMutation(internal.claudeRunner.reserveRun, {}),
        loadKey: () => loadConnectionsKey(),
        decrypt: decryptSecret,
        env: process.env,
        fetch,
      }, args.prompt),
  });

  `callClaudeRunner` order: 1) `await deps.assertApproved()` (its errors propagate unchanged — signed out gives `"Not authenticated"` from the approval query). 2) `prompt.trim() === ""` → `"Prompt is empty"`; UTF-8 bytes > 16,384 → `"Prompt is too long"`. 3) any of the three env values empty/undefined, or `await deps.loadKey()` is `null` → `"Claude runs are not configured"`. 4) `r = await deps.reserve()` (its errors propagate unchanged: tier, not connected, daily limit). 5) `oauthToken = await deps.decrypt(key, r.oauthTokenCipher, secretAad(r.userId, "claude.oauthToken"))`, `mcpToken = … secretAad(r.userId, "claude.mcpToken")`; any decrypt error → `"Claude sign-in could not be read"`. 6) `deps.fetch(\`${CLAUDE_RUNNER_URL}/run\`, { method: "POST", headers: { Authorization: \`Bearer ${CLAUDE_RUNNER_TOKEN}\`, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt, oauthToken, mcpUrl: \`${CONVEX_SITE_URL}/mcp\`, mcpToken }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CLAUDE_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS) })`; a rejection named `"TimeoutError"` or `"AbortError"`, or status 504 → `"Claude run timed out"`; status 200 with JSON `{ output: string, truncated: boolean }` → that object (only those two keys); anything else (other status, other rejection, bad JSON) → `"Claude run failed"`. - **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // apps/mobile/lib/push.ts — pure; imports nothing
  export type PushPermission = "granted" | "denied" | "undetermined";
  export type PushRegistration =
    | { status: "granted"; token: string }
    | { status: "granted-no-token" } // permission given, but no token (simulator, Android without FCM, network)
    | { status: "undetermined" }     // never asked and ask was false
    | { status: "denied" }
    | { status: "unsupported" };     // Expo web: no push
  export type PushDeps = {
    platform: "ios" | "android" | "web";
    getPermission: () => Promise<PushPermission>;
    requestPermission: () => Promise<PushPermission>;
    ensureAndroidChannel: () => Promise<void>;
    getExpoToken: () => Promise<string>;
  };
  export const PUSH_TOKEN_MAX = 512;
  export async function registerForPush(deps: PushDeps, opts: { ask: boolean }): Promise<PushRegistration>;
  ```
  Rules, in order: (1) `platform === "web"` → `{ status: "unsupported" }` and no dep is called. (2) `platform === "android"` → `await ensureAndroidChannel()` first (Android 13+ shows the prompt only once a channel exists); a rejection here is caught and ignored. (3) `let perm = await getPermission()` (a rejection → treat as `"undetermined"`). (4) `perm === "undetermined" && opts.ask` → `perm = await requestPermission()` (a rejection → `"denied"`). `requestPermission` is never called when `perm` is `"denied"` (iOS shows the system prompt once; Settings re-enables it). (5) `perm === "undetermined"` → `{ status: "undetermined" }`; `perm === "denied"` → `{ status: "denied" }`. (6) `token = (await getExpoToken()).trim()`; a rejection, an empty string or `token.length > PUSH_TOKEN_MAX` → `{ status: "granted-no-token" }`; otherwise `{ status: "granted", token }`. The function never throws.
  ```ts
  // apps/mobile/lib/push-native.ts
  import Constants from "expo-constants";
  import * as Notifications from "expo-notifications";
  import { Platform } from "react-native";
  import type { PushDeps, PushPermission } from "./push";
  export const ANDROID_CHANNEL_ID = "default";
  /** Real dependencies for registerForPush. */
  export function nativePushDeps(): PushDeps;
  /** Shows a banner for a push that arrives while the app is open; no sound, no badge. */
  export function configurePushHandler(): void;
  ```
  `nativePushDeps()`: `platform` = `Platform.OS === "ios" ? "ios" : Platform.OS === "android" ? "android" : "web"`; `getPermission` = `(await Notifications.getPermissionsAsync()).status` mapped `"granted"`→`"granted"`, `"denied"`→`"denied"`, anything else → `"undetermined"`; `requestPermission` = same mapping over `Notifications.requestPermissionsAsync()`; `ensureAndroidChannel` = `Notifications.setNotificationChannelAsync(ANDROID_CHANNEL_ID, { name: "Tempo", importance: Notifications.AndroidImportance.DEFAULT })` (the channel name is the product name, so it needs no translation); `getExpoToken` = `(await Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId: String(Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.eas?.projectId ?? "") })).data`. `configurePushHandler()` = `Notifications.setNotificationHandler({ handleNotification: async () => ({ shouldShowBanner: true, shouldShowList: true, shouldPlaySound: false, shouldSetBadge: false }) })`. No user-facing copy in this ticket (screens TFV2-0428b and TFV2-0429d own the copy).
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `platform: "web"` / When `registerForPush(deps, { ask: true })` runs / Then it resolves `{ status: "unsupported" }` and `calls` is `[]`.
  2. Given `platform: "ios"`, `getPermission` → `"granted"`, `getExpoToken` → `"ExponentPushToken[abc]"` / When `ask: false` / Then `{ status: "granted", token: "ExponentPushToken[abc]" }` and `calls` is `["getPermission", "getExpoToken"]`.
  3. Given `platform: "android"`, `getPermission` → `"undetermined"`, `requestPermission` → `"granted"`, token `"ExponentPushToken[x]"` / When `ask: true` / Then `{ status: "granted", token: "ExponentPushToken[x]" }` and `calls` is `["ensureAndroidChannel", "getPermission", "requestPermission", "getExpoToken"]`.
  4. Given `getPermission` → `"undetermined"` / When `ask: false` / Then `{ status: "undetermined" }` and `requestPermission` was not called.
  5. Given `getPermission` → `"denied"` / When `ask: true` / Then `{ status: "denied" }` and `requestPermission` was not called.
  6. Given `getPermission` → `"granted"` and `getExpoToken` rejects with `new Error("no fcm")` / Then `{ status: "granted-no-token" }` (resolves, does not reject).
  7. Token length at n and n + 1 (`PUSH_TOKEN_MAX` = 512): given `getPermission` → `"granted"` and `getExpoToken` → `"x".repeat(512)` / Then `{ status: "granted", token: "x".repeat(512) }`; with `"x".repeat(513)` / Then `{ status: "granted-no-token" }`; and with `"   "` / Then `{ status: "granted-no-token" }`.
  8. Given `platform: "android"` and `ensureAndroidChannel` rejects / When `getPermission` → `"granted"`, token `"ExponentPushToken[y]"` / Then `{ status: "granted", token: "ExponentPushToken[y]" }`.

Token length ≤ 512 characters (`PUSH_TOKEN_MAX`, product bound; case 7 at 512 and 513; Expo tokens are ~41 characters, Expo push docs https://docs.expo.dev/push-notifications/sending-notifications/). Prompt shown at most once per install (deterministic: rule 4). Latency: n/a (no network in tests).

  ```ts
  export const DEVICE_TOKEN_MAX = 512;
  export const DEVICE_TOKENS_PER_USER_MAX = 10;
  const EXPO_TOKEN_PATTERN = /^Expo(nent)?PushToken\[[^\]\s]+\]$/;
  const platformValidator = v.union(v.literal("ios"), v.literal("android"));
  export const register = mutation({
    args: { token: v.string(), platform: platformValidator },
    returns: v.id("deviceTokens"),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { token: string; platform: "ios" | "android" }): Promise<Id<"deviceTokens">> => { … },
  });
  ```
  Auth: `const user = await requireUser(ctx);` first. Steps: `token = args.token.trim()`; reject when empty, longer than `DEVICE_TOKEN_MAX`, or not matching `EXPO_TOKEN_PATTERN`. Look up `ctx.db.query("deviceTokens").withIndex("by_token", (q) => q.eq("token", token)).first()`. Found (any owner, live or soft-deleted) → `ctx.db.patch(row._id, { userId: user._id, platform: args.platform, updatedAt: now, deletedAt: undefined })` and return `row._id` (a token identifies one device; the device now belongs to the caller, so the previous account stops getting pushes there). Not found → count the caller's live rows with `.withIndex("by_userId_deletedAt", (q) => q.eq("userId", user._id).eq("deletedAt", undefined)).take(DEVICE_TOKENS_PER_USER_MAX)`; at the cap → error; else `insert("deviceTokens", { userId: user._id, token, platform: args.platform, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now })`.
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Not authenticated"` / `"User not found"` / `"This account is not active"` (from `requireUser`); `"Invalid push token"` → trimmed token empty, over 512 characters, or not an Expo token; `"Too many devices for push"` → a new token while the caller already has 10 live rows. No user-facing copy (English errors; the screen maps them, CONVENTIONS §11).
- **TESTS:** (`describe("push.register")`)
  1. Given `makeSignedOutCtx()` / When `run(register, ctx, { token: "ExponentPushToken[a1]", platform: "ios" })` / Then it rejects with `"Not authenticated"`.
  2. Given `makeFakeCtx("users:1")` / When it registers `" ExponentPushToken[a1] "` on `"ios"` / Then the returned id's row has `userId: "users:1"`, `token: "ExponentPushToken[a1]"`, `platform: "ios"`, `createdAt` and `updatedAt` numbers and no `deletedAt`.
  3. Given a live `users:1` row for `"ExponentPushToken[a1]"` on `"ios"` / When `users:1` registers the same token on `"android"` / Then the same id is returned, `deviceTokens` still has exactly one row, and its `platform` is `"android"`.
  4. Given a `users:2` row for `"ExponentPushToken[a1]"` with `deletedAt: 5` / When `users:1` registers it / Then that row's `userId` is `"users:1"` and `deletedAt` is `undefined` (one row in the table).
  5. Given `makeFakeCtx("users:1")` / When it registers `""`, `"x".repeat(513)` and `"not-a-token"` (three calls) / Then each rejects with `"Invalid push token"` and no row exists.
  6. Given 10 live `users:1` rows with distinct tokens / When `users:1` registers an 11th new token / Then it rejects with `"Too many devices for push"` and there are still 10 rows.
- **NUMBERS:** 6 of 6 cases pass (exact). Token ≤ 512 characters (`DEVICE_TOKEN_MAX`); ≤ 10 live devices per person (`DEVICE_TOKENS_PER_USER_MAX`, product bound, case 6 seeds cap and asserts the rejection). Reads ≤ 11 documents. Backend p95 latency: UNKNOWN (no baseline; not a gate — CONVENTIONS §20).

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const EXPO_PUSH_SEND_URL = "https://exp.host/--/api/v2/push/send";
  export const EXPO_PUSH_BATCH_MAX = 100;
  export const PUSH_TITLE_MAX = 65;
  export const PUSH_BODY_MAX = 240;
  export type ExpoPushMessage = {
    to: string;
    title: string;
    body: string;
    data: { url: string };
    priority: "default";
    channelId: "default";
  };
  export function buildExpoPushBatches(
    tokens: readonly string[],
    message: { title: string; body: string; url: string },
  ): ExpoPushMessage[][];
  ```
  Rules: tokens are de-duplicated keeping first-seen order; `title` and `body` are trimmed, then cut to `PUSH_TITLE_MAX` / `PUSH_BODY_MAX` code points (`[...s]`), and a cut string ends with `…` within that limit (keep `max - 1` code points, then `…`); every message carries the same `data: { url }`, `priority: "default"`, `channelId: "default"` (the Android channel from TFV2-0425); batches hold at most `EXPO_PUSH_BATCH_MAX` messages in token order; an empty token list returns `[]`. Errors: none (the caller validates text and url). No user-facing copy (the text is the caller's).

  3. Given `["t1", "t2", "t1"]` / Then the single batch has 2 messages with `to` `"t1"` then `"t2"`.
  4. Title at n and n + 1 (`PUSH_TITLE_MAX` = 65): given `"a".repeat(65)` / Then the title is unchanged; given `"a".repeat(66)` / Then the title is `"a".repeat(64) + "…"` (exactly 65 code points).
  5. Body at n and n + 1 (`PUSH_BODY_MAX` = 240), Hebrew letters: given `"א".repeat(240)` / Then the body is unchanged; given `"א".repeat(241)` / Then the body is `"א".repeat(239) + "…"` (exactly 240 code points).
  6. Given `[]` / Then it returns `[]`.

  ```ts
  export const sendToUser = internalAction({
    args: { userId: v.id("users"), title: v.string(), body: v.string(), url: v.string() },
    returns: v.object({
      sent: v.number(),
      failed: v.number(),
      retired: v.number(),
      skipped: v.union(v.null(), v.literal("push_off"), v.literal("no_tokens")),
    }),
    handler: async (
      ctx: ActionCtx,
      args: { userId: Id<"users">; title: string; body: string; url: string },
    ): Promise<{ sent: number; failed: number; retired: number; skipped: null | "push_off" | "no_tokens" }> => { … },
  });
  ```
  Order: (1) `args.title.trim()` or `args.body.trim()` empty → error; `args.url` not starting with `"tempo-rhythm://"` → error. (2) `const targets = await ctx.runQuery(internal.push.targetsFor, { userId })`; `!targets.pushEnabled` → `{ sent: 0, failed: 0, retired: 0, skipped: "push_off" }`; no tokens → same with `skipped: "no_tokens"`. (3) For each batch from `buildExpoPushBatches(tokens.map((t) => t.token), args)`, in sequence: `fetch(EXPO_PUSH_SEND_URL, { method: "POST", headers, body: JSON.stringify(batch) })` with `headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" }` plus `Authorization: \`Bearer ${process.env.EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN}\`` only when that variable is a non-empty string. A thrown fetch or a non-2xx status → `failed += batch.length`; otherwise `readExpoPushTickets(batch, await response.json())` (a JSON parse failure → `failed += batch.length`). (4) For each dead token, `await ctx.runMutation(internal.push.retireToken, { token })` and `retired += 1` when it returns `true`. (5) Return `{ sent, failed, retired, skipped: null }`.
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Push message is empty"` → title or body blank after trim; `"Invalid push link"` → url without the `tempo-rhythm://` scheme. No identity: internal actions run without a user, so the signed-out and other-user cases do not apply; `targetsFor` scopes every read to `args.userId`. Secret name used: `EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN` (optional; name only).

Given `targetsFor` → `{ pushEnabled: true, tokens: [{ token: "ExponentPushToken[a]", platform: "ios" }, { token: "ExponentPushToken[b]", platform: "android" }] }` and `fetch` resolving `200` with `{ data: [{ status: "ok", id: "1" }, { status: "ok", id: "2" }] }` / When `run(sendToUser, ctx, { userId: "users:1", title: "Water", body: "A glass now", url: "tempo-rhythm://today" })` / Then it returns `{ sent: 2, failed: 0, retired: 0, skipped: null }`, `fetch` was called once with `EXPO_PUSH_SEND_URL`, method `"POST"`, and the parsed body's two `to` values are the two tokens with `body: "A glass now"`.
  2. Given `targetsFor` → `{ pushEnabled: false, tokens: [] }` / Then it returns `skipped: "push_off"` and `fetch` was not called.
  3. Given `{ pushEnabled: true, tokens: [] }` / Then it returns `skipped: "no_tokens"` and `fetch` was not called.
  4. Given two tokens and a response whose second ticket is `{ status: "error", message: "gone", details: { error: "DeviceNotRegistered" } }`, and `retireToken` returning `true` / Then it returns `{ sent: 1, failed: 1, retired: 1, skipped: null }` and `retireToken` was called once with `{ token: "ExponentPushToken[b]" }`.
  5. Given `fetch` rejecting with `new Error("network")`, and separately resolving status `500` / Then each run resolves `{ sent: 0, failed: 2, retired: 0, skipped: null }` (no throw).
  6. Given title `"  "`, and separately url `"https://evil.test"` / Then the first rejects with `"Push message is empty"`, the second with `"Invalid push link"`, and `targetsFor` was never called.
  7. Given `process.env.EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN = "test-expo-token"` / Then the request headers include `Authorization: "Bearer test-expo-token"`; and with the variable deleted / Then no `Authorization` header is sent.

- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0427d / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: convex/lib/localTime.ts, convex/lib/localTime.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; list STEPS 1–4 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const MINUTES_PER_DAY = 1440;
  /** First instant > nowMs whose wall clock in timeZone reads minuteOfDay (0–1439). */
  export function nextLocalMinuteAt(nowMs: number, minuteOfDay: number, timeZone: string): number;
  ```
  Algorithm (exact): validate `Number.isInteger(minuteOfDay) && minuteOfDay >= 0 && minuteOfDay < MINUTES_PER_DAY`, else `throw new Error("Invalid minute of day")`. Build `fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone, hourCycle: "h23", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" })`; a `RangeError` → `throw new Error("Invalid time zone")`. `parts(ms)` = the numeric `year, month, day, hour, minute, second` from `fmt.formatToParts(new Date(ms))`. `offsetMin(ms) = (Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, d, h, mi, s) - Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000) / 60000`. `wallToUtc(y, mo, d) { const guess = Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, d, 0, minuteOfDay); const t1 = guess - offsetMin(guess) * 60000; return guess - offsetMin(t1) * 60000; }`. Let `p = parts(nowMs)`; `cand = wallToUtc(p.year, p.month, p.day)`; if `cand <= nowMs`, take the next calendar date `n = new Date(Date.UTC(p.year, p.month - 1, p.day + 1))` and return `wallToUtc(n.getUTCFullYear(), n.getUTCMonth() + 1, n.getUTCDate())`; else return `cand`. A minute that does not exist that day (spring-forward gap) returns whatever this two-pass rule gives (within one hour of the missing time); no test asserts it.
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Invalid minute of day"` → not an integer in 0–1439; `"Invalid time zone"` → `Intl` rejects `timeZone`. No copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `nowMs = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 8, 0)`, `540`, `"UTC"` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 9, 0)`.
  2. Given `nowMs = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 9, 0)`, `540`, `"UTC"` (exactly 09:00) / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 10, 3, 9, 0)` (strictly after).
  3. Given `nowMs = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 6, 0)` (08:00 in Israel, UTC+2), `540`, `"Asia/Jerusalem"` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 7, 0)`.
  4. Given `nowMs = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 21, 30)` (23:30 in Israel), `15`, `"Asia/Jerusalem"` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 22, 15)` (00:15 on 3 Nov local).
  5. Given `nowMs = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 31, 14, 0)` (10:00 EDT, the day before US clocks go back on 1 Nov 2026), `540`, `"America/New_York"` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 10, 1, 14, 0)` (09:00 EST).
  6. Minute range at both ends (0–1439): given `nowMs = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 8, 0)`, `"UTC"` and minute `1439` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 23, 59)`; minute `0` / Then `Date.UTC(2026, 10, 3, 0, 0)`; minute `1440`, `-1` and `2.5` / Then each throws `"Invalid minute of day"`; given minute `540` and `"Mars/Base"` / Then it throws `"Invalid time zone"`.
- **NUMBERS:** 6 of 6 cases pass (exact instants above, checked against the IANA tz database through Python `zoneinfo` on 2 Nov 2026). Latency: n/a (pure).

  export const NAG_PUSH_LINK = "tempo-rhythm://today";

  export const sweep = internalMutation({

  `now = Date.now()`. Due rows: `ctx.db.query("nags").withIndex("by_nextPushAt", (q) => q.gte("nextPushAt", 0).lt("nextPushAt", now + 1)).take(NAG_PUSH_SWEEP_MAX)`. For each row: (a) `deletedAt !== undefined`, `enabled === false`, `pushAtMinute === undefined` or no phrase with `status === "accepted"` → `patch(row._id, { nextPushAt: undefined })`, `cleared += 1`, next row. (c) When `pref?.notifyReminders !== false`: `accepted = row.phrases.filter((p) => p.status === "accepted")`; `phrase = accepted[Math.floor(now / DAY_MS) % accepted.length]`; `await ctx.scheduler.runAfter(0, internal.push.sendToUser, { userId: row.userId, title: row.label, body: phrase.text, url: NAG_PUSH_LINK })`; `scheduled += 1`. (d) `patch(row._id, { nextPushAt: next })` where `next = nextLocalMinuteAt(now, row.pushAtMinute, tz)`, falling back to `"UTC"` when that throws `"Invalid time zone"`.   ```ts
  export const notificationKeyValidator = v.union(v.literal("notifyReminders"), v.literal("notifyCalendar"), v.literal("notifyCoach"), v.literal("pushEnabled"));
  export const set = mutation({
    args: { key: notificationKeyValidator, value: v.boolean() },
    returns: v.null(),
    handler: async (ctx: MutationCtx, args: { key: keyof NotificationPrefs; value: boolean }): Promise<null> => { … },
  });
  ```
  `requireUser` first; `existing = withIndex("by_userId", (q) => q.eq("userId", user._id)).unique()`; `now = Date.now()`. Live row → `patch(existing._id, { [args.key]: args.value, updatedAt: now })`. Soft-deleted row → `patch(existing._id, { ...PREFERENCE_DEFAULTS, [args.key]: args.value, updatedAt: now, deletedAt: undefined })` (a revived row starts from defaults, as `preferences.update` does). No row → `insert("userPreferences", { userId: user._id, ...PREFERENCE_DEFAULTS, [args.key]: args.value, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now })`. Errors: `"Not authenticated"` / `"User not found"` / `"This account is not active"` (requireUser); an unknown key is rejected by the argument validator before the handler runs. No copy.

  Imports: `Bell`, `BellOff`, `Check`, `WifiOff` from `lucide-react-native`; `View` from `react-native`; `usePrefs` from `./prefs`; `Button`, `Card`, `T` from `./primitives`; `StateLoading` from `./states`; `type Lang` from `@/lib/v3/i18n`; `import type React from "react";` (the return type is `React.JSX.Element`, CONVENTIONS §22).
  Markup: root `<View testID="enable-push-card">`. `loading` renders only `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={3} />`. Every other status renders `<Card>` holding: a head row `<View testID="enable-push-card-head" style={{ flexDirection: p.row, alignItems: "center", gap: 12 }}>` with the icon (`size={24}`, `color={c.accent}`; `Check` for granted, `BellOff` for denied and unsupported, `WifiOff` for offline, `Bell` otherwise) and `<T size="xl" serif weight="500" accessibilityRole="header">{title}</T>`; then `<T tone="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{body}</T>`; then `<View style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>` with the buttons below (`Button` from primitives, `block`). `p = usePrefs()`, `c = p.colors`, `copy = COPY[p.lang]`.
  Per status (title · body · buttons in order, `variant`):
  - `default`: `title` · `body` · [`allow` primary → `onAllow`] [`notNow` ghost → `onNotNow`].
  - `requesting`: `title` · `body` · [`asking` primary, `disabled`] [`notNow` ghost, `disabled`].
  - `granted`: `grantedTitle` · `grantedBody` · [`done` primary → `onDone`].
  - `denied`: `deniedTitle` · `deniedBody` · [`openSettings` primary → `onOpenSettings`] [`notNow` ghost → `onNotNow`].
  - `unsupported`: `unsupportedTitle` · `unsupportedBody` · [`done` primary → `onDone`].
  - `error`: `errorTitle` · `errorBody` · [`retry` primary → `onAllow`] [`notNow` ghost → `onNotNow`]; the `Card`'s first child is wrapped in `<View accessibilityRole="alert">` so the title is announced.
  - `offline`: `title` · `offline` · [`allow` primary, `disabled`] [`notNow` ghost → `onNotNow`]; the body `T` has `accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"`.
  COPY (`type CopyKey`, `const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`):
  - `title` EN: "Turn on reminders" / HE: "להפעיל תזכורות"
  - `body` EN: "Tempo can send your reminders to this phone, in your own words. You choose which ones in Settings." / HE: "Tempo יכול לשלוח את התזכורות שלך לטלפון הזה, במילים שלך. בוחרים אילו בהגדרות."
  - `allow` EN: "Allow reminders" / HE: "לאפשר תזכורות"
  - `notNow` EN: "Not now" / HE: "לא עכשיו"
  - `asking` EN: "Asking your phone…" / HE: "מבקשים אישור מהטלפון…"
  - `grantedTitle` EN: "Reminders are on" / HE: "התזכורות פועלות"
  - `grantedBody` EN: "Your reminders will reach this phone." / HE: "התזכורות שלך יגיעו לטלפון הזה."
  - `done` EN: "Done" / HE: "סיום"
  - `deniedTitle` EN: "Reminders are off on this phone" / HE: "התזכורות כבויות בטלפון הזה"
  - `deniedBody` EN: "You can turn them on any time in your phone's settings." / HE: "אפשר להפעיל אותן מתי שרוצים בהגדרות של הטלפון."
  - `openSettings` EN: "Open phone settings" / HE: "לפתוח את הגדרות הטלפון"
  - `unsupportedTitle` EN: "Reminders need the phone app" / HE: "תזכורות פועלות רק באפליקציה בטלפון"
  - `unsupportedBody` EN: "This device can't receive reminders. Install Tempo on your phone to get them." / HE: "המכשיר הזה לא יכול לקבל תזכורות. אפשר להתקין את Tempo בטלפון כדי לקבל אותן."
  - `errorTitle` EN: "That didn't go through" / HE: "זה לא עבר"
  - `errorBody` EN: "Your data is safe. Try again in a moment." / HE: "המידע שלך שמור. אפשר לנסות שוב בעוד רגע."
  - `retry` EN: "Try again" / HE: "לנסות שוב"
  - `offline` EN: "You're offline. Changes save when you're back." / HE: "אין חיבור כרגע. השינויים יישמרו כשהחיבור יחזור."
  - `loading` EN: "Loading…" / HE: "בטעינה…"
  States: default, loading, requesting, granted, denied, unsupported, error, offline (all above); empty: n/a (the card always has content); disabled: the `requesting` and `offline` buttons; success: `granted`.
  RTL: the head row uses `usePrefs().row` (on Expo web `I18nManager.isRTL` is `false`, so `row` is `"row-reverse"` in Hebrew and `"row"` in English — `rowDirection` in `apps/mobile/lib/v3/i18n.ts`); `T` aligns text to the language's start. Keyboard (Expo web) and switch access: each button is a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"` reached in reading order; a disabled button reports `aria-disabled="true"`. Screen reader: the title is a header; `error` is an alert; the offline line is a polite live region; `loading` is a `progressbar` labelled "Loading…". Breakpoints: one column; the card fills the width up to the screen padding (390 px and 1280 px viewports render the same column). Motion: none (no animation; reduced motion changes nothing). Tokens: `colors.accent` (icon), `colors.inkMuted` via `tone="muted"`, `Card` (`colors.paper`, `colors.line`, `RADIUS.lg`), button heights `TOUCH` (44).
  Harness `apps/mobile/app/e2e/enable-push-card.tsx` (default export `EnablePushCardHarness`): returns `null` unless `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TEMPO_E2E === "1"`; reads `const { lang } = useLocalSearchParams<{ lang?: string }>()` and in a `useEffect` calls `usePrefs().setLang(lang)` when `lang` is `"en"` or `"he"`; renders a `ScrollView` with one `<View testID="enable-push-card-<status>">` per status in the order default, loading, requesting, granted, denied, unsupported, error, offline, each holding `<EnablePushCard status="<status>" … />`; the call log is the CONVENTIONS §13 helper, word for word: `const [logText, setLog] = useState("");` and `const log = (name: string) => (...args: unknown[]) => setLog(args.length === 0 ? `${name}:` : `${name}:${JSON.stringify(args.length === 1 ? args[0] : args)}`);`, shown in `<Text testID="enable-push-card-log">{logText}</Text>`. The four callbacks are wired with no argument, `onAllow={() => log("onAllow")()}`, `onNotNow={() => log("onNotNow")()}`, `onOpenSettings={() => log("onOpenSettings")()}`, `onDone={() => log("onDone")()}` (the primitives `Button` hands its `Pressable` press event to `onPress`, which `JSON.stringify` cannot serialise), so the log reads `onAllow:`, `onNotNow:`, `onOpenSettings:`, `onDone:`. It imports only the component, React (`useEffect`, `useState`), `ScrollView`/`Text`/`View` from `react-native`, `useLocalSearchParams` from `expo-router`, `usePrefs` and types.
  Spec skeleton: imports `{ test, expect }` from `@playwright/test` and `{ VIEWPORTS, trackConsoleErrors, expectTargetSize, expectMotionBudget }` from `../helpers/harness`; first statement `test.skip(!!process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL, "local webServer only");`; every bullet is one `test()` per combination of `for (const [vpName, vp] of [["mobile", VIEWPORTS.mobile], ["desktop", VIEWPORTS.desktop]] as const) for (const lang of ["en", "he"] as const)`, named `"<bullet name> · ${vpName} · ${lang}"`, which calls `page.setViewportSize(vp)`, `page.goto(\`/e2e/enable-push-card?lang=${lang}\`)` and waits for `page.getByTestId("enable-push-card-default")` to be visible; each test starts `const errors = trackConsoleErrors(page);` and ends `expect(errors.filter((e) => !/example\.convex\.cloud|WebSocket/i.test(e))).toEqual([])` (the root layout opens a Convex client on the placeholder URL CFG-031 sets). react-native-web renders `testID` as `data-testid`, `accessibilityRole="button"` as `role="button"` and a disabled `Pressable` as `aria-disabled="true"`. Every locator is scoped to its state: `page.getByTestId("enable-push-card-<state>").getByRole(…)`.

  1. Default: Given `enable-push-card-default` / Then the header reads `Turn on reminders` / `להפעיל תזכורות` and the body is the `body` copy; When `Allow reminders` / `לאפשר תזכורות` is clicked / Then the log reads `onAllow:`; When `Not now` / `לא עכשיו` is clicked / Then the log reads `onNotNow:`.
  2. Requesting and offline: Given `enable-push-card-requesting` / Then its two buttons have `aria-disabled="true"` and the first reads `Asking your phone…` / `מבקשים אישור מהטלפון…`; Given `enable-push-card-offline` / Then the offline copy is shown, the allow button has `aria-disabled="true"`, and clicking `Not now` / `לא עכשיו` logs `onNotNow:`.
  3. Granted and unsupported: Given `enable-push-card-granted` / Then the header is `Reminders are on` / `התזכורות פועלות` and clicking `Done` / `סיום` logs `onDone:`; Given `enable-push-card-unsupported` / Then the header is the `unsupportedTitle` copy and the section has exactly one button.

  export type NotificationPrefsValues = { notifyReminders: boolean; notifyCalendar: boolean; notifyCoach: boolean; pushEnabled: boolean };
  export type PushPermissionView = "granted" | "denied" | "undetermined" | "unsupported";
  export type NotificationPrefsListProps = {
    state: "default" | "loading" | "error" | "offline";
    values: NotificationPrefsValues;
    permission: PushPermissionView;
    onToggle: (change: { key: keyof NotificationPrefsValues; value: boolean }) => void;
    onEnablePush: () => void;
    onOpenSettings: () => void;
    onRetry: () => void;
  };
  export function NotificationPrefsList(props: NotificationPrefsListProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  Imports (CONVENTIONS §11 mobile, §22): `import type React from "react";`; `View` from `react-native`; `usePrefs` from `./prefs`; `Button`, `Notice`, `RADIUS`, `SettingRow`, `SwitchControl` from `./primitives`; `OfflineNotice`, `StateError`, `StateLoading` from `./states`; `type Lang` from `@/lib/v3/i18n`. Copy is `type CopyKey = <the COPY keys below>; const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>`, read in the body as `const p = usePrefs(); const c = p.colors; const copy = COPY[p.lang];`.
  Markup: root `<View testID="notification-prefs-list" style={{ gap: 16 }}>`.
  - `loading` → only `<StateLoading label={copy.loading} rows={4} />`.
  - `error` → only `<StateError title={copy.errTitle} safe={copy.safe} body={copy.errBody} retryLabel={copy.retry} onRetry={onRetry} />`.
  - `default` and `offline` → (offline first adds `<OfflineNotice title={copy.offlineTitle} body={copy.offlineBody} />`) then the permission notice, then a card `<View style={{ backgroundColor: c.paper, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: c.line, borderRadius: RADIUS.lg, overflow: "hidden" }}>` with four `SettingRow`s, the first with `first`. Each row's child is `<SwitchControl value={…} label={…} onWord={copy.on} offWord={copy.off} disabled={…} onChange={(value) => onToggle({ key, value })} />`.
  Rows (key · label · help):
  1. `pushEnabled` · `push` · `pushHelp`; disabled when `state === "offline"` or `permission !== "granted"`.
  2. `notifyReminders` · `reminders` · `remindersHelp`; disabled when offline or `!values.pushEnabled`.
  3. `notifyCalendar` · `calendar` · `calendarHelp`; same rule.
  4. `notifyCoach` · `coach` · `coachHelp`; same rule.
  Permission notice (above the card): `granted` → none; `undetermined` → `<Notice tone="info" title={copy.askTitle} body={copy.askBody} action={<Button small variant="primary" label={copy.turnOn} onPress={onEnablePush} />} />`; `denied` → `<Notice tone="caution" title={copy.deniedTitle} body={copy.deniedBody} action={<Button small label={copy.openSettings} onPress={onOpenSettings} />} />`; `unsupported` → `<Notice tone="neutral" title={copy.unsupportedTitle} body={copy.unsupportedBody} />`. In `offline` the notice buttons are `disabled`.
  COPY:

  ```ts
  export type CameraCaptureStatus = "requesting" | "denied" | "ready" | "capturing" | "captured" | "error" | "unsupported";
  export type CapturedPhoto = { uri: string; width: number; height: number };
  export type CameraCaptureProps = {
    status: CameraCaptureStatus;
    purpose: "note" | "scan";
    photo: CapturedPhoto | null; // required when status is "captured"
    viewfinder: ReactNode;       // the live camera, shown in ready and capturing
    onAllow: () => void;
    onOpenSettings: () => void;
    onShutter: () => void;
    onRetake: () => void;        // captured (Retake) and error (Try again)
    onUse: (photo: CapturedPhoto) => void;
    onCancel: () => void;
  };
  export const SHUTTER_SIZE = 72;
  export function CameraCapture(props: CameraCaptureProps): React.JSX.Element;
  ```
  Copy is `type CopyKey = <the COPY keys below>; const COPY: Record<Lang, Record<CopyKey, string>>` (CONVENTIONS §11 mobile), read in the body as `const p = usePrefs(); const c = p.colors; const copy = COPY[p.lang];`.
  Markup: root `<View testID="camera-capture" style={{ gap: 16 }}>`; first child `<T size="xl" serif weight="500" accessibilityRole="header">{purpose === "note" ? copy.titleNote : copy.titleScan}</T>`. Then per status:

In `capturing`, `<T size="sm" tone="muted" accessibilityLiveRegion="polite">{copy.capturing}</T>` sits under the row.

Keyboard and screen reader: every action is a `role="button"` with a text label; the shutter's name is "Take photo" / "לצלם תמונה" and it reports `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy` while capturing; the photo is an image with alt text; the error notice is an alert.   const PHOTO: CapturedPhoto = { uri: "data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7", width: 3, height: 4 };
  const SECTIONS: { name: string; status: CameraCaptureStatus; purpose: "note" | "scan"; photo: CapturedPhoto | null }[] = [
    { name: "requesting", status: "requesting", purpose: "note", photo: null },
    { name: "denied", status: "denied", purpose: "note", photo: null },
    { name: "ready", status: "ready", purpose: "note", photo: null },
    { name: "capturing", status: "capturing", purpose: "note", photo: null },

The call log is the CONVENTIONS §13 helper, word for word: `const [logText, setLog] = useState("");`, `const log = (name: string) => (...args: unknown[]) => setLog(args.length === 0 ? `${name}:` : `${name}:${JSON.stringify(args.length === 1 ? args[0] : args)}`);`, shown in `<Text testID="camera-capture-log">{logText}</Text>`. Wiring: `onUse={log("onUse")}` (one argument, the photo); the no-argument callbacks are wrapped, `onAllow={() => log("onAllow")()}`, `onOpenSettings={() => log("onOpenSettings")()}`, `onShutter={() => log("onShutter")()}`, `onRetake={() => log("onRetake")()}`, `onCancel={() => log("onCancel")()}` (the primitives `Button` and the shutter `Pressable` hand their press event to `onPress`, which `JSON.stringify` cannot serialise). So the log reads `onAllow:`, `onOpenSettings:`, `onShutter:`, `onRetake:`, `onCancel:` and `onUse:{"uri":"data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7","width":3,"height":4}`.

### TFV2-0430b — Camera capture state + hook (`apps/mobile/lib/camera-state.ts`, `useCameraCapture.ts`)
- **STATUS:** approved-unsent
- **Stage:** F · **Pass:** 1 · **Depends:** CFG-053, TFV2-0430a · **Folds-in:** none

Two screens use the camera (attach a photo TFV2-0431d, scan a page TFV2-0432c), so the flow lives once: a pure reducer bun can test (`tests/unit/`), and a thin hook over `expo-camera` (`useCameraPermissions`, `CameraView.takePictureAsync`).
- **GOAL:** `cameraReducer` decides every camera status change, and `useCameraCapture()` drives it from `expo-camera`, returning the state and actions the `CameraCapture` props need.
- **SCOPE:** `apps/mobile/lib/camera-state.ts` · `apps/mobile/lib/useCameraCapture.ts` · test: `tests/unit/mobile_camera_state.test.ts`.
- **MUTATES:** `apps/mobile/lib/camera-state.ts` (new) · `apps/mobile/lib/useCameraCapture.ts` (new) · `tests/unit/mobile_camera_state.test.ts` (new). No data.
- **STEPS:**
  1. Code-map check: `grep -n '"expo-camera"' apps/mobile/package.json` prints `"expo-camera": "17.0.10"` (CFG-053); `grep -n "export type CameraCaptureStatus\|export type CapturedPhoto" apps/mobile/components/v3/CameraCapture.tsx` (TFV2-0430a).
  2. Create `camera-state.ts` exactly as SPEC; its only import is `import type { CameraCaptureStatus, CapturedPhoto } from "../components/v3/CameraCapture";` (erased at runtime, so bun never loads React Native).
  3. Create `useCameraCapture.ts` exactly as SPEC.
  4. Create `tests/unit/mobile_camera_state.test.ts` importing only `../../apps/mobile/lib/camera-state`, with the 8 TESTS cases.
  5. Run DONE, then `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lint`.
- **DONE:** `bun test tests/unit/mobile_camera_state.test.ts` → `8 pass`, `0 fail`; `bun run typecheck` → exit 0.
- **EVIDENCE:** the `bun test` summary and the typecheck and lint exit codes, pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** upload, save to the photo library or persist the picture; request the microphone; open the camera before the person taps Allow; edit `CameraCapture.tsx` or `app.json`.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0430b / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: apps/mobile/lib/camera-state.ts, apps/mobile/lib/useCameraCapture.ts, tests/unit/mobile_camera_state.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; list STEPS 1–5 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  // apps/mobile/lib/camera-state.ts (pure)
  export type CameraState = { status: CameraCaptureStatus; photo: CapturedPhoto | null };
  export type CameraEvent =
    | { type: "unsupported" }
    | { type: "permission"; granted: boolean; canAskAgain: boolean }
    | { type: "shutter" }
    | { type: "captured"; photo: CapturedPhoto }
    | { type: "failed" }
    | { type: "retake" };
  export const CAMERA_INITIAL: CameraState = { status: "requesting", photo: null };
  export const CAMERA_QUALITY = 0.7;
  export function cameraReducer(state: CameraState, event: CameraEvent): CameraState;
  ```
  Transitions (anything not listed returns `state` unchanged; `unsupported` is final):
  - `unsupported` (from any status) → `{ status: "unsupported", photo: null }`.
  - `permission` while `requesting`, `denied` or `ready`: `granted` → `ready`; not granted and `canAskAgain` → `requesting`; not granted and `!canAskAgain` → `denied` (photo `null`).
  - `shutter` while `ready` → `capturing`.
  - `captured` while `capturing` → `{ status: "captured", photo }`.
  - `failed` while `ready` or `capturing` → `{ status: "error", photo: null }`.
  - `retake` while `captured` or `error` → `{ status: "ready", photo: null }`.
  ```ts
  // apps/mobile/lib/useCameraCapture.ts
  import { type CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from "expo-camera";
  import { type RefObject, useCallback, useEffect, useReducer, useRef } from "react";
  import { Platform } from "react-native";
  import { CAMERA_INITIAL, type CameraState, cameraReducer } from "./camera-state";
  export function useCameraCapture(): {
    state: CameraState;
    cameraRef: RefObject<CameraView | null>;
    allow: () => Promise<void>;
    shutter: () => Promise<void>;
    retake: () => void;
  };
  ```
  Hook rules: `useReducer(cameraReducer, CAMERA_INITIAL)`; `const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions()`; effect: `Platform.OS === "web"` → dispatch `unsupported`; else when `permission` is not `null` → dispatch `{ type: "permission", granted: permission.granted, canAskAgain: permission.canAskAgain }`. `allow` → `const res = await requestPermission()` then the same `permission` event. `shutter` → dispatch `shutter`, then `const pic = await cameraRef.current?.takePictureAsync({ quality: CAMERA_QUALITY })`; a result → `captured` with `{ uri: pic.uri, width: pic.width, height: pic.height }`; `undefined` or a thrown error → `failed`. `retake` → dispatch `retake`. The screen renders `<CameraView ref={cameraRef} style={{ flex: 1 }} facing="back" />` as `CameraCapture`'s `viewfinder`. No copy (the component owns it).
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `CAMERA_INITIAL` and `{ type: "permission", granted: true, canAskAgain: true }` / Then `{ status: "ready", photo: null }`.
  2. Given `requesting` and `{ type: "permission", granted: false, canAskAgain: false }` / Then `denied`; and with `canAskAgain: true` / Then `requesting`.
  3. Given `ready` and `shutter` / Then `capturing`; given `requesting` and `shutter` / Then unchanged (`requesting`).
  4. Given `capturing` and `{ type: "captured", photo: { uri: "file:///a.jpg", width: 3024, height: 4032 } }` / Then `{ status: "captured", photo: { uri: "file:///a.jpg", width: 3024, height: 4032 } }`.
  5. Given `capturing` and `failed` / Then `{ status: "error", photo: null }`.
  6. Given `captured` (with a photo) and `retake` / Then `{ status: "ready", photo: null }`; given `error` and `retake` / Then `ready`.
  7. Given `captured` and `{ type: "permission", granted: true, canAskAgain: true }` / Then the state is unchanged (the photo is kept).
  8. Given `ready` and `unsupported` / Then `{ status: "unsupported", photo: null }`; and then `{ type: "permission", granted: true, canAskAgain: true }` / Then still `unsupported`.
- **NUMBERS:** 8 of 8 cases pass (exact). JPEG quality 0.7 (`CAMERA_QUALITY`; product bound that keeps a 12 MP photo well under the 8 MiB upload cap of TFV2-0431b — size per photo on real devices UNKNOWN until measured). Latency: n/a.
- **GATES:** 1 Build/typecheck/lint · 2 own TESTS green · 3 NUMBERS in range · 4 Google style formatting/naming · 5 secret + forbidden-tech scan · 6 scope guard · 7 config guard · 8 never weaken/skip/lower/delete a check · 9 Jev judge (~typesafe/jev-latest): instruction-following, formatting, naming, clean code each >= 0.85; a massive violation fails · 10 Process check: REPORT lists every STEP and DONE item with evidence; a missing item fails.
- **OPEN:** none.

- **EVIDENCE:** the summary of `bun test convex/noteImages.test.ts` and the `bun run typecheck` exit code, pasted into the PR.
- **DO NOT:** store image bytes in a table; insert into another person's note; throw after `ctx.storage.delete` (a thrown mutation rolls back, so refusals return a result instead); edit `convex/notes.ts` or `convex/schema.ts`.
- **REPORT:** `status / ticket: TFV2-0431b / evidence: <DONE output> / changed: convex/noteImages.ts, convex/noteImages.test.ts / unknowns / notes for ticket sync`; list STEPS 1–4 with evidence.
- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const NOTE_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
  export const NOTE_IMAGE_ALT_MAX = 200;
  export const NOTE_IMAGE_TYPES = ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/heic"] as const;
  export const attach = mutation({
    args: { noteId: v.id("notes"), storageId: v.id("_storage"), alt: v.string() },
    returns: v.union(
      v.object({ ok: v.literal(true), url: v.string() }),
      v.object({ ok: v.literal(false), reason: v.union(v.literal("too_large"), v.literal("unsupported_type")) }),
    ),
    handler: async (
      ctx: MutationCtx,
      args: { noteId: Id<"notes">; storageId: Id<"_storage">; alt: string },
    ): Promise<{ ok: true; url: string } | { ok: false; reason: "too_large" | "unsupported_type" }> => { … },
  });
  ```
  Order: `user = await requireUser(ctx)`; `alt = args.alt.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()` — empty or longer than `NOTE_IMAGE_ALT_MAX` code points → error; `note = await ctx.db.get(args.noteId)` — missing, `userId !== user._id` or `deletedAt` set → error; `meta = await ctx.db.system.get(args.storageId)` — `null` → error; `meta.size > NOTE_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES` → `await ctx.storage.delete(args.storageId)`, return `{ ok: false, reason: "too_large" }`; `meta.contentType` not in `NOTE_IMAGE_TYPES` (including missing) → delete, return `{ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_type" }`; `url = await ctx.storage.getUrl(args.storageId)` — `null` → error; `safeAlt = alt.replace(/[\\[\]]/g, "\\$&")`; `body = note.body.trimEnd()`; `next = (body ? \`${body}\n\n\` : "") + \`![${safeAlt}](${url})\n\``; `patch(note._id, { body: next, updatedAt: Date.now() })`; return `{ ok: true, url }`.
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"Not authenticated"` / `"User not found"` / `"This account is not active"` (requireUser); `"Describe the photo in 1 to 200 characters."` → alt empty after collapsing spaces, or over 200; `"Note not found"` → missing, other user's or deleted note; `"Image not found"` → no `_storage` row, or `getUrl` returns `null`. Refusals that delete the file are results, not errors (above).
- **TESTS:** (`describe("noteImages.attach")`; `users:1` note seeded as `{ userId: "users:1", title: "Trip", body: "Packing list", pinned: false, periodType: "none", createdAt: 1, updatedAt: 1 }`; `META["_storage:1"] = { _id: "_storage:1", size: 1000, contentType: "image/jpeg", sha256: "x" }`; `URLS["_storage:1"] = "https://files.test/s1"`)
  1. Given `makeSignedOutCtx()` with the stubs / When `run(attach, ctx, { noteId, storageId: "_storage:1", alt: "Tent" })` / Then it rejects with `"Not authenticated"`.
  2. Given the seeded note / When `alt: "  Tent  by the  lake "` / Then it returns `{ ok: true, url: "https://files.test/s1" }` and the body is exactly `"Packing list\n\n![Tent by the lake](https://files.test/s1)\n"`.
  3. Given an empty-body note and `alt: "a [b] c"` / Then the body is exactly `"![a \\[b\\] c](https://files.test/s1)\n"` (brackets escaped).
  4. Given a `users:2` note, and separately a `users:1` note with `deletedAt: 5` / Then both reject with `"Note not found"` and no file was deleted.
  5. Limit at n and n + 1 (`NOTE_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES`): given `META["_storage:1"].size = 8 * 1024 * 1024` (n) / Then it returns `{ ok: true, url: "https://files.test/s1" }` and `deleted` is `[]`; given `META["_storage:1"].size = 8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1` (n + 1) / Then it returns `{ ok: false, reason: "too_large" }`, `deleted` equals `["_storage:1"]` and the body is unchanged; and `contentType: "application/pdf"` / Then `{ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_type" }` and the file was deleted.
  6. Given `alt: "x".repeat(200)` (n = `NOTE_IMAGE_ALT_MAX`) / Then it returns `{ ok: true, url: "https://files.test/s1" }`; given `alt: "   "`, and separately `"x".repeat(201)` (n + 1) / Then each rejects with `"Describe the photo in 1 to 200 characters."`.
  7. Given no `META` entry for `"_storage:9"`, and separately a `META` entry with `URLS` missing / Then each rejects with `"Image not found"`.
- **NUMBERS:** 7 of 7 cases pass; whole file 9 of 9 (exact). Photo ≤ 8 MiB = 8,388,608 bytes (`NOTE_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES`, proposed; OPEN) — case 5 uses the cap (accepted) and cap + 1 (refused); case 6 uses 200 (accepted) and 201 (rejected). Alt text 1–200 characters (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1 requires a text alternative; 200 is a product bound). Backend p95 latency: UNKNOWN (no baseline; not a gate).
- **GATES:** n/a — OPEN (not buildable until Amit answers).
- **OPEN:** new: Keep note photos in Convex file storage with an 8 MiB cap per photo, no per-plan storage quota and no automatic deletion of photos whose markdown is later removed from the note (proposed)? — Amit.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export type FetchLike = (input: string, init?: { method?: string; headers?: Record<string, string>; body?: Blob }) => Promise<Response>;
  export const UPLOAD_FAILED = "Upload failed";
  /** GET the local file, POST it to uploadUrl, return the storageId Convex answers. */
  export async function uploadPhoto(uri: string, uploadUrl: string, fetchImpl: FetchLike = fetch): Promise<string>;
  ```
  Rules: `const file = await (await fetchImpl(uri)).blob()`; `const res = await fetchImpl(uploadUrl, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": file.type || "image/jpeg" }, body: file })`; `!res.ok` → throw; `const json = await res.json()`; `typeof json?.storageId !== "string" || json.storageId === ""` → throw; return `json.storageId`. Any thrown error from either fetch or `json()` is re-thrown as `new Error(UPLOAD_FAILED)`. No copy (the screen shows its own message).
- **TESTS:** (helper declared at the top of the test file exactly as here (origin: this ticket, §16 d); call `i` returns `responses[i]`, or throws it when it is an `Error`):
  ```ts
  function fakeFetch(responses: (Response | Error)[]) {
    const calls: { url: string; init?: Parameters<FetchLike>[1] }[] = [];
    const impl: FetchLike = async (url, init) => {
      calls.push({ url, init });
      const r = responses[calls.length - 1];
      if (r instanceof Error) throw r;
      return r;
    };
    return { impl, calls };
  }
  ```
  1. Given `const { impl, calls } = fakeFetch([...])` whose first response is `new Response(new Blob(["abc"], { type: "image/png" }))` and second is `new Response(JSON.stringify({ storageId: "kg2abc" }), { status: 200 })` / When `uploadPhoto("file:///p.png", "https://upload.test/u1", impl)` / Then it resolves `"kg2abc"`, `calls[0].url` is `"file:///p.png"`, `calls[1].url` is `"https://upload.test/u1"`, `calls[1].init?.method` is `"POST"`, `calls[1].init?.headers?.["Content-Type"]` is `"image/png"`, and `calls[1].init?.body?.size` is `3`.
  2. Given responses `[new Response(new Blob(["abc"])), new Response(JSON.stringify({ storageId: "kg2abc" }))]` (a type-less blob) / Then `calls[1].init?.headers?.["Content-Type"]` is `"image/jpeg"`.
  3. Given responses `[new Response(new Blob(["abc"], { type: "image/png" })), new Response("err", { status: 500 })]` / Then it rejects with `"Upload failed"`.
  4. Given responses `[new Response(new Blob(["abc"], { type: "image/png" })), new Response("{}")]` (no `storageId`), and separately `[new Error("offline")]` (the first fetch rejects) / Then each rejects with `"Upload failed"`.

- **SPEC:**
  ```ts
  export const OCR_TEXT_MAX = 8_000;
  export const OCR_MALFORMED = "OCR response was malformed";
  export function readOcrPages(response: unknown): { text: string; truncated: boolean };
  ```
  Rules: `response` must be an object whose `pages` is an array of objects each with a numeric `index` and a string `markdown`, else throw `OCR_MALFORMED`. Pages are sorted by `index` and joined with `"\n\n"`. Then: remove markdown images `/!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)/g`; replace `\r\n` with `\n`; collapse 3 or more newlines to exactly 2; trim. If the result has more than `OCR_TEXT_MAX` code points, keep the first `OCR_TEXT_MAX` code points (`[...text].slice(0, OCR_TEXT_MAX).join("")`), trim the end, and set `truncated: true`; else `truncated: false`. An empty `pages` array returns `{ text: "", truncated: false }`.
  Errors (exact → trigger): `"OCR response was malformed"` → the shape rule fails. No copy.
- **TESTS:**
  1. Given `{ pages: [{ index: 1, markdown: "second" }, { index: 0, markdown: "first" }] }` / Then `{ text: "first\n\nsecond", truncated: false }`.
  2. Given one page `"Buy milk\n\n\n\n![img-0.jpeg](img-0.jpeg)\nCall Dana"` / Then `text` is `"Buy milk\n\nCall Dana"`.
  3. Given one page of `"א".repeat(8_005)` / Then `text` has exactly 8,000 code points and `truncated` is `true`.
  4. Given `{ pages: [] }` / Then `{ text: "", truncated: false }`.
  5. Given `null`, `{}` and `{ pages: [{ index: "0", markdown: "x" }] }` / Then each throws `"OCR response was malformed"`.
  6. Given one page `"  line one\r\nline two  "` / Then `text` is `"line one\nline two"`.
- **NUMBERS:** 6 of 6 cases pass (exact). Text ≤ 8,000 code points (`OCR_TEXT_MAX`, product bound carried from the old ticket). Latency: n/a (pure).
